sourceRange.text: 宣統元年，甘肅全省亢旱。順治元年十一月十二日，鹽亭山頂崩一大石，如數間房，橫截路口，是夕大風雨，居民避張獻忠者得脫大半。先是有童謠云「入洞數，鑽岩怪，沿山走的後還在」，至是果應。康熙十四年，藩王尚可喜於粵秀山築壘，土中得一石碑，其碑文云：「抱破老龍傷粵秀，八風吹箭入陀城，種柳昔年曾有恨，看花今日豈無情？殘花已自傷零落，折柳何須關廢興，可憐野鬼黃沙跡，直待劉終班馬鳴。」似詩似讖，未有能識者。五十七年八月初一，鍾祥火災，先是有童謠云：「八月初一火龍過」，至是果應。乾隆六年，知州林良銓改修諸葛忠武祠，掘地得二石人，一背銘字云「守土守三分辛苦」，一背鐫字云「遇隆則興。」光緒五年，文縣有童謠云「兩個土地會說話，兩個石人會撻架」，未幾即山崩地震。順治七年正月朔，衢州黑熊入城，是年多火災。

manualTranslations.zh: 宣統元年，甘肅全省亢旱。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong, severe drought afflicted all of Gansu Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong, severe drought struck all of Gansu Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 順治元年十一月十二日，鹽亭山頂崩一大石，如數間房，橫截路口，是夕大風雨，居民避張獻忠者得脫大半。
manualTranslations.literal: On the twelfth day of the eleventh month of the first year of Shunzhi, a great stone collapsed from the summit of Yanting Mountain, as large as several rooms, blocking the road crossing; that evening there were great wind and rain, and among the residents fleeing Zhang Xianzhong, more than half escaped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the twelfth day of the eleventh month of the first year of Shunzhi, a great stone collapsed from the summit of Yanting Mountain, as large as several rooms and blocking the road crossing; that evening brought great wind and rain, and of the residents fleeing Zhang Xianzhong, more than half escaped.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是有童謠云「入洞數，鑽岩怪，沿山走的後還在」，至是果應。
manualTranslations.literal: Previously there had been a children's rhyme saying, "Enter the caves and count them; drilling the rocks is strange—the one who walks along the mountain is still behind," and at this time it was indeed fulfilled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Previously there had been a children's rhyme saying, "Enter the caves and count them; drilling the rocks is strange—the one who walks along the mountain is still behind," and at this time it was indeed fulfilled.

manualTranslations.zh: 康熙十四年，藩王尚可喜於粵秀山築壘，土中得一石碑，其碑文云：「抱破老龍傷粵秀，八風吹箭入陀城，種柳昔年曾有恨，看花今日豈無情？
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, the feudal prince Shang Kexi built fortifications on Yuexiu Mountain; in the soil a stone stele was found, its inscription reading: "Embracing the broken old dragon wounds Yuexiu; the eight winds blow arrows into Tuocheng; planting willows in former years held grief—viewing flowers today, how could there be no feeling?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Kangxi, the feudal prince Shang Kexi built fortifications on Yuexiu Mountain; digging in the earth he obtained a stone stele whose inscription read: "Embracing the broken old dragon wounds Yuexiu; the eight winds blow arrows into Tuocheng; planting willows in former years held grief—viewing flowers today, how could there be no feeling?

manualTranslations.zh: 殘花已自傷零落，折柳何須關廢興，可憐野鬼黃沙跡，直待劉終班馬鳴。」
manualTranslations.literal: Fallen blossoms already grieve their scattering; why need breaking willows concern decline and rise? Pitiable wild ghosts on yellow-sand trails—wait until Liu Zhong and Ban Ma cry out."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fallen blossoms already grieve their scattering; why need breaking willows concern decline and rise? Pitiable wild ghosts on yellow-sand trails—wait until Liu Zhong and Ban Ma cry out."

manualTranslations.zh: 似詩似讖，未有能識者。
manualTranslations.literal: It seemed like poetry and like a prophecy; none could interpret it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It seemed both like poetry and like a prophecy, and none could interpret it.

manualTranslations.zh: 五十七年八月初一，鍾祥火災，先是有童謠云：「八月初一火龍過」，至是果應。
manualTranslations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month of the fifty-seventh year, Zhongxiang suffered a fire disaster; previously there had been a children's rhyme saying, "On the first of the eighth month a fire dragon passes," and at this time it was indeed fulfilled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month of the fifty-seventh year, Zhongxiang suffered a fire disaster; previously there had been a children's rhyme saying, "On the first of the eighth month a fire dragon passes," and at this time it was indeed fulfilled.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾隆六年，知州林良銓改修諸葛忠武祠，掘地得二石人，一背銘字云「守土守三分辛苦」，一背鐫字云「遇隆則興。」
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year of Qianlong, Magistrate Lin Liangquan renovated the Zhuge Zhongwu Shrine; digging in the earth he obtained two stone figures—on one's back the inscribed characters read "Guarding the soil, guarding is three parts hardship"; on the other's back the carved characters read "When encountering prosperity, then rise."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Qianlong, Magistrate Lin Liangquan renovated the Zhuge Zhongwu Shrine; digging in the earth he obtained two stone figures—one bore the inscription "Guarding the soil, guarding is three parts hardship," and the other was carved with the words "When encountering prosperity, then rise."

manualTranslations.zh: 光緒五年，文縣有童謠云「兩個土地會說話，兩個石人會撻架」，未幾即山崩地震。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu, in Wen County there was a children's rhyme saying, "Two earth gods can speak; two stone men can brawl," and before long there were mountain collapses and earthquakes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Guangxu, in Wen County there was a children's rhyme saying, "Two earth gods can speak; two stone men can brawl," and before long there were mountain collapses and earthquakes.

manualTranslations.zh: 順治七年正月朔，衢州黑熊入城，是年多火災。
manualTranslations.literal: On the first day of the first month of the seventh year of Shunzhi, a black bear entered the city of Quzhou; that year saw many fire disasters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of the seventh year of Shunzhi, a black bear entered the city of Quzhou; that year saw many fire disasters.

items.acceptedSourceText: 宣統元年，甘肅全省亢旱。順治元年十一月十二日，鹽亭山頂崩一大石，如數間房，橫截路口，是夕大風雨，居民避張獻忠者得脫大半。先是有童謠云「入洞數，鑽岩怪，沿山走的後還在」，至是果應。康熙十四年，藩王尚可喜於粵秀山築壘，土中得一石碑，其碑文云：「抱破老龍傷粵秀，八風吹箭入陀城，種柳昔年曾有恨，看花今日豈無情？殘花已自傷零落，折柳何須關廢興，可憐野鬼黃沙跡，直待劉終班馬鳴。」似詩似讖，未有能識者。五十七年八月初一，鍾祥火災，先是有童謠云：「八月初一火龍過」，至是果應。乾隆六年，知州林良銓改修諸葛忠武祠，掘地得二石人，一背銘字云「守土守三分辛苦」，一背鐫字云「遇隆則興。」光緒五年，文縣有童謠云「兩個土地會說話，兩個石人會撻架」，未幾即山崩地震。順治七年正月朔，衢州黑熊入城，是年多火災。

sourceRange.text: 康熙四十五年二月，蕭縣民家犬作人言。乾隆二年，利津民家犬生一畜，一首二尾七足。咸豐十一年，來鳳民家犬作人言。同治十一年，大埔民家犬生六足。順治元年二月，興國寺前出白氣一道。六年三月，江陰白氣亙天，彌月始滅。七年正月二十六夜，昆山西方有白氣如練，十餘日始滅；蕭縣白氣見西方，二十餘日始滅。六月甲申，泰安見白氣亙天，益都見白氣亙天。十二月三十日，蕭縣見白氣如練數十條，寒光射人。十八年十二月十二日，棲霞白氣亙天。康熙二年夏，萊陽有白氣衝天。七年正月，廣平見白氣亙天，西出指東，越二十日方滅；內丘夜見白氣如銀河，經五六日方滅；溫江有白氣，自西直亙數十丈，下銳上闊，光如銀，形如竹，經四晝夜方散；威縣見白氣亙天。二月，廣州有白氣如槍，長十餘丈，四十日乃滅；武邑夜白氣亙天，夜半始散；唐山見白氣亙天。七月，高邑夜見白氣如疋布，亙西方。九年三月乙丑，廬陵白氣現自西方。十一月，通渭夜見白氣如虹，自南而北。十一年七月十四日夜，交河有白氣自西南向東北，其疾如飛，聲如風。十六年七月壬申夜，盧龍有白氣如霓，自東向日。十八年六月二十四日，武定見白氣貫天。十一月，玉田有白氣自西南來。十九年十月，全椒見白氣於西方，月餘始滅。十一月朔，滄州有白氣如帚，自西南向東北，浹旬方滅；盧龍有白氣如雲，長亙向東，越數夕色淡，而高起如帚芒狀；絳縣夜見白氣如虹。初二日，鎮洋西方見白氣亙天，長數丈，移時乃滅；臨淄見白氣自西而東。初四日，溫州夜見白氣如練，長十餘丈，月餘始滅。二十年六月二十一日夜，望江見白氣亙天，至八月十一日方滅。十一月，山陽見白氣亙天，一月始滅；漢中西方見白氣亙天如練。二十二年五月己未夜，清河有白氣數道如虹。三十九年九月，江夏見白氣如練，六七日始滅。四十一年二月，沛縣見白氣於西方。六十年十一月十九日，遵化有白氣如練，聚於西南，移時方滅。六十一年六月十四日，嘉定有白氣亙天。雍正九年閏五月二十七日夜，南宮有白氣一道南行有聲。乾隆十八年九月癸丑，東流有氣如虹著天，色紫白，久而沒。三十五年七月二十八日，肥城有白氣十三道，至夜半乃退。嘉慶二十年五月，武定有白氣亙天向西，長數丈。道光十三年四月十八日，棲霞有白氣亙天。二十年，昌黎夜見白氣亙天，逾月乃滅。二十二年春，莘縣有白氣如練數丈，月餘乃滅。冬，玉田有白氣亙天。二十三年三月，黃州有白氣如練，斜指西南，經月始散。四月，滕縣有白氣亙天，月餘乃滅。二十四年夏，登州有白氣亙天。二十五年春，即墨有白氣西北亙天。二十六年秋，寧津夜有白氣長竟天。咸豐七年秋，黃安有白光如電，燭暗室，有聲。十一年六月，棲霞有白光如疋練，橫亙西北，十餘日始滅。同治七年九月十五日，玉田有火光至空際化為白氣，長丈許，其中有聲如鼓。光緒元年秋，海陽有白氣突起，移時始滅。

manualTranslations.zh: 康熙四十五年二月，蕭縣民家犬作人言。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the forty-fifth year of Kangxi, at a common household in Xiaoxian a dog spoke in human words.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the forty-fifth year of Kangxi, a dog at a common household in Xiaoxian spoke in human words.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾隆二年，利津民家犬生一畜，一首二尾七足。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, at a common household in Lijin a dog gave birth to a creature with one head, two tails, and seven legs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianlong, a dog at a common household in Lijin whelped a creature with one head, two tails, and seven legs.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸豐十一年，來鳳民家犬作人言。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year of Xianfeng, at a common household in Laifeng a dog spoke in human words.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Xianfeng, a dog at a common household in Laifeng spoke in human words.

manualTranslations.zh: 同治十一年，大埔民家犬生六足。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, at a common household in Dapu a dog gave birth to [a pup with] six legs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Tongzhi, a dog at a common household in Dapu whelped a pup with six legs.

manualTranslations.zh: 順治元年二月，興國寺前出白氣一道。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Shunzhi, a streak of white vapor appeared before Xingguo Temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Shunzhi, a streak of white vapor appeared before Xingguo Temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年三月，江陰白氣亙天，彌月始滅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year, white vapor in Jiangyin spanned heaven and did not vanish until a full month had passed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year, white vapor in Jiangyin spanned heaven and did not vanish until a full month had passed.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年正月二十六夜，昆山西方有白氣如練，十餘日始滅；
manualTranslations.literal: On the night of the twenty-sixth day of the first month of the seventh year, in the west of Kunshan there was white vapor like spun silk; after more than ten days it vanished;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-sixth day of the first month of the seventh year, white vapor like spun silk appeared in the west of Kunshan and did not vanish for more than ten days;

manualTranslations.zh: 蕭縣白氣見西方，二十餘日始滅。
manualTranslations.literal: in Xiaoxian white vapor appeared in the west and did not vanish for more than twenty days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: in Xiaoxian white vapor appeared in the west and did not vanish for more than twenty days.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月甲申，泰安見白氣亙天，益都見白氣亙天。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiashen day, white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Tai'an and in Yidu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiashen day, white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Tai'an and in Yidu.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月三十日，蕭縣見白氣如練數十條，寒光射人。
manualTranslations.literal: On the thirtieth day of the twelfth month, in Xiaoxian dozens of streaks of white vapor like spun silk were seen, their cold light striking people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the thirtieth day of the twelfth month, dozens of streaks of white vapor like spun silk were seen in Xiaoxian, their cold light striking people.

manualTranslations.zh: 十八年十二月十二日，棲霞白氣亙天。
manualTranslations.literal: On the twelfth day of the twelfth month of the eighteenth year, white vapor in Qixia spanned heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the twelfth day of the twelfth month of the eighteenth year, white vapor in Qixia spanned heaven.

manualTranslations.zh: 康熙二年夏，萊陽有白氣衝天。
manualTranslations.literal: In the summer of the second year of Kangxi, in Laiyang white vapor rushed to heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the summer of the second year of Kangxi, white vapor rushed to heaven in Laiyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年正月，廣平見白氣亙天，西出指東，越二十日方滅；
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year, in Guangping white vapor spanning heaven appeared, issuing from the west and pointing east; after more than twenty days it vanished;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year, white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Guangping, issuing from the west and pointing east; it did not vanish for more than twenty days;

manualTranslations.zh: 內丘夜見白氣如銀河，經五六日方滅；
manualTranslations.literal: at night in Neiqiu white vapor like the Milky Way was seen and vanished after five or six days;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: at night in Neiqiu white vapor like the Milky Way was seen and vanished after five or six days;

manualTranslations.zh: 溫江有白氣，自西直亙數十丈，下銳上闊，光如銀，形如竹，經四晝夜方散；
manualTranslations.literal: in Wenjiang there was white vapor extending straight from the west for several tens of zhang, sharp below and broad above, its light like silver and its form like bamboo; after four days and nights it dispersed;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: in Wenjiang white vapor extended straight from the west for several tens of zhang, sharp below and broad above, its light like silver and its form like bamboo; it dispersed only after four days and nights;

manualTranslations.zh: 威縣見白氣亙天。
manualTranslations.literal: in Weixian white vapor spanning heaven was seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Weixian.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月，廣州有白氣如槍，長十餘丈，四十日乃滅；
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month, in Guangzhou there was white vapor like a spear, more than ten zhang long; after forty days it vanished;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, white vapor like a spear more than ten zhang long appeared in Guangzhou and did not vanish for forty days;

manualTranslations.zh: 武邑夜白氣亙天，夜半始散；
manualTranslations.literal: at night in Wuyi white vapor spanned heaven and did not disperse until midnight;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: at night white vapor spanned heaven in Wuyi and did not disperse until midnight;

manualTranslations.zh: 唐山見白氣亙天。
manualTranslations.literal: in Tangshan white vapor spanning heaven was seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Tangshan.

manualTranslations.zh: 七月，高邑夜見白氣如疋布，亙西方。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month, at night in Gaoyi white vapor like a bolt of cloth was seen spanning the west.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, at night white vapor like a bolt of cloth was seen spanning the west in Gaoyi.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年三月乙丑，廬陵白氣現自西方。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year, on yichou day, white vapor appeared in Luling from the west.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year, on yichou day, white vapor appeared in Luling from the west.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，通渭夜見白氣如虹，自南而北。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, at night in Tongwei white vapor like a rainbow was seen, running from south to north.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, at night white vapor like a rainbow was seen in Tongwei, running from south to north.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一年七月十四日夜，交河有白氣自西南向東北，其疾如飛，聲如風。
manualTranslations.literal: On the night of the fourteenth day of the seventh month of the eleventh year, in Jiaohe there was white vapor from southwest to northeast, swift as flight and sounding like wind.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the night of the fourteenth day of the seventh month of the eleventh year, white vapor ran from southwest to northeast in Jiaohe, swift as flight and sounding like wind.

manualTranslations.zh: 十六年七月壬申夜，盧龍有白氣如霓，自東向日。
manualTranslations.literal: On the night of renshen day in the seventh month of the sixteenth year, in Lulong there was white vapor like a secondary rainbow, from the east toward the sun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the night of renshen day in the seventh month of the sixteenth year, white vapor like a secondary rainbow appeared in Lulong, running from the east toward the sun.

manualTranslations.zh: 十八年六月二十四日，武定見白氣貫天。
manualTranslations.literal: On the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month of the eighteenth year, in Wuding white vapor piercing heaven was seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month of the eighteenth year, white vapor piercing heaven was seen in Wuding.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，玉田有白氣自西南來。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, in Yutian white vapor came from the southwest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, white vapor came from the southwest in Yutian.

manualTranslations.zh: 十九年十月，全椒見白氣於西方，月餘始滅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth month of the nineteenth year, in Quanjiao white vapor was seen in the west and did not vanish until more than a month had passed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the nineteenth year, white vapor was seen in the west in Quanjiao and did not vanish for more than a month.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月朔，滄州有白氣如帚，自西南向東北，浹旬方滅；
manualTranslations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, in Cangzhou there was white vapor like a broom, from southwest to northeast; after ten days it vanished;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, white vapor like a broom ran from southwest to northeast in Cangzhou and did not vanish for ten days;

manualTranslations.zh: 盧龍有白氣如雲，長亙向東，越數夕色淡，而高起如帚芒狀；
manualTranslations.literal: in Lulong there was white vapor like clouds, long and spanning eastward; after several nights its color faded, yet it rose high in the shape of broom bristles;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: in Lulong white vapor like clouds spanned eastward; after several nights its color faded, yet it rose high in the shape of broom bristles;

manualTranslations.zh: 絳縣夜見白氣如虹。
manualTranslations.literal: at night in Jiangxian white vapor like a rainbow was seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: at night white vapor like a rainbow was seen in Jiangxian.

manualTranslations.zh: 初二日，鎮洋西方見白氣亙天，長數丈，移時乃滅；
manualTranslations.literal: On the second day, in the west of Zhenyang white vapor spanning heaven was seen, several zhang long; after a while it vanished;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the second day, white vapor several zhang long spanned heaven in the west of Zhenyang and vanished after a while;

manualTranslations.zh: 臨淄見白氣自西而東。
manualTranslations.literal: in Linzi white vapor was seen from west to east.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: white vapor was seen from west to east in Linzi.

manualTranslations.zh: 初四日，溫州夜見白氣如練，長十餘丈，月餘始滅。
manualTranslations.literal: On the fourth day, at night in Wenzhou white vapor like spun silk was seen, more than ten zhang long; after more than a month it vanished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the fourth day, at night white vapor like spun silk more than ten zhang long was seen in Wenzhou and did not vanish for more than a month.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十年六月二十一日夜，望江見白氣亙天，至八月十一日方滅。
manualTranslations.literal: On the night of the twenty-first day of the sixth month of the twentieth year, in Wangjiang white vapor spanning heaven was seen; it did not vanish until the eleventh day of the eighth month.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-first day of the sixth month of the twentieth year, white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Wangjiang and did not vanish until the eleventh day of the eighth month.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，山陽見白氣亙天，一月始滅；
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month, in Shanyang white vapor spanning heaven was seen and did not vanish until a month had passed;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Shanyang and did not vanish for a month;

manualTranslations.zh: 漢中西方見白氣亙天如練。
manualTranslations.literal: in the west of Hanzhong white vapor spanning heaven like spun silk was seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: white vapor like spun silk spanning heaven was seen in the west of Hanzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十二年五月己未夜，清河有白氣數道如虹。
manualTranslations.literal: On the night of jiwei day in the fifth month of the twenty-second year, in Qinghe several streaks of white vapor like rainbows were seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the night of jiwei day in the fifth month of the twenty-second year, several streaks of white vapor like rainbows were seen in Qinghe.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十九年九月，江夏見白氣如練，六七日始滅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirty-ninth year, in Jiangxia white vapor like spun silk was seen and did not vanish for six or seven days.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the thirty-ninth year, white vapor like spun silk was seen in Jiangxia and did not vanish for six or seven days.

manualTranslations.zh: 四十一年二月，沛縣見白氣於西方。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the forty-first year, in Peixian white vapor was seen in the west.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the forty-first year, white vapor was seen in the west in Peixian.

manualTranslations.zh: 六十年十一月十九日，遵化有白氣如練，聚於西南，移時方滅。
manualTranslations.literal: On the nineteenth day of the eleventh month of the sixtieth year, in Zunhua there was white vapor like spun silk, gathering in the southwest; after a while it vanished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the nineteenth day of the eleventh month of the sixtieth year, white vapor like spun silk gathered in the southwest in Zunhua and vanished after a while.

manualTranslations.zh: 六十一年六月十四日，嘉定有白氣亙天。
manualTranslations.literal: On the fourteenth day of the sixth month of the sixty-first year, in Jiading white vapor spanning heaven was seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth day of the sixth month of the sixty-first year, white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Jiading.

manualTranslations.zh: 雍正九年閏五月二十七日夜，南宮有白氣一道南行有聲。
manualTranslations.literal: On the night of the twenty-seventh day of the intercalary fifth month of the ninth year of Yongzheng, in Nangong one streak of white vapor moved southward with sound.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-seventh day of the intercalary fifth month of the ninth year of Yongzheng, one streak of white vapor moved southward with sound in Nangong.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾隆十八年九月癸丑，東流有氣如虹著天，色紫白，久而沒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of the eighteenth year of Qianlong, on guichou day, in Dongliu vapor like a rainbow clung to heaven, purple and white in color, and after a long time vanished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the eighteenth year of Qianlong, on guichou day, vapor like a rainbow clung to heaven in Dongliu, purple and white in color, and vanished after a long time.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十五年七月二十八日，肥城有白氣十三道，至夜半乃退。
manualTranslations.literal: On the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month of the thirty-fifth year, in Feicheng there were thirteen streaks of white vapor; they withdrew only at midnight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day of the seventh month of the thirty-fifth year, thirteen streaks of white vapor appeared in Feicheng and withdrew only at midnight.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘉慶二十年五月，武定有白氣亙天向西，長數丈。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month of the twentieth year of Jiaqing, in Wuding white vapor spanning heaven ran westward, several zhang long.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twentieth year of Jiaqing, white vapor several zhang long spanned heaven westward in Wuding.

manualTranslations.zh: 道光十三年四月十八日，棲霞有白氣亙天。
manualTranslations.literal: On the eighteenth day of the fourth month of the thirteenth year of Daoguang, in Qixia white vapor spanning heaven was seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the eighteenth day of the fourth month of the thirteenth year of Daoguang, white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Qixia.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十年，昌黎夜見白氣亙天，逾月乃滅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twentieth year, at night in Changli white vapor spanning heaven was seen and did not vanish until more than a month had passed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, at night white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Changli and did not vanish for more than a month.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十二年春，莘縣有白氣如練數丈，月餘乃滅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-second year, in Shenxian there was white vapor like spun silk several zhang long; after more than a month it vanished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-second year, white vapor like spun silk several zhang long appeared in Shenxian and did not vanish for more than a month.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬，玉田有白氣亙天。
manualTranslations.literal: In winter, in Yutian white vapor spanning heaven was seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In winter, white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Yutian.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十三年三月，黃州有白氣如練，斜指西南，經月始散。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-third year, in Huangzhou there was white vapor like spun silk, slanting toward the southwest; after a month it dispersed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-third year, white vapor like spun silk slanting toward the southwest appeared in Huangzhou and dispersed only after a month.

manualTranslations.zh: 四月，滕縣有白氣亙天，月餘乃滅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month, in Tengxian white vapor spanning heaven was seen and did not vanish until more than a month had passed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Tengxian and did not vanish for more than a month.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十四年夏，登州有白氣亙天。
manualTranslations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-fourth year, in Dengzhou white vapor spanning heaven was seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the summer of the twenty-fourth year, white vapor spanning heaven was seen in Dengzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十五年春，即墨有白氣西北亙天。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-fifth year, in Jimo white vapor spanned heaven in the northwest.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-fifth year, white vapor spanned heaven in the northwest in Jimo.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十六年秋，寧津夜有白氣長竟天。
manualTranslations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-sixth year, at night in Ningjin white vapor long enough to fill heaven was seen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-sixth year, at night white vapor long enough to fill heaven was seen in Ningjin.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸豐七年秋，黃安有白光如電，燭暗室，有聲。
manualTranslations.literal: In the autumn of the seventh year of Xianfeng, in Huang'an there was white light like lightning, illuminating a dark room, with sound.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the seventh year of Xianfeng, white light like lightning appeared in Huang'an, illuminating a dark room, with sound.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一年六月，棲霞有白光如疋練，橫亙西北，十餘日始滅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month of the eleventh year, in Qixia there was white light like a bolt of silk, spanning the northwest horizontally; after more than ten days it vanished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eleventh year, white light like a bolt of silk spanned the northwest horizontally in Qixia and did not vanish for more than ten days.

manualTranslations.zh: 同治七年九月十五日，玉田有火光至空際化為白氣，長丈許，其中有聲如鼓。
manualTranslations.literal: On the fifteenth day of the ninth month of the seventh year of Tongzhi, in Yutian firelight reached the sky and transformed into white vapor about one zhang long, within which there was sound like a drum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth day of the ninth month of the seventh year of Tongzhi, firelight in Yutian reached the sky and transformed into white vapor about one zhang long, within which there was sound like a drum.

manualTranslations.zh: 光緒元年秋，海陽有白氣突起，移時始滅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Guangxu, in Haiyang white vapor suddenly rose and did not vanish until after a while.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the first year of Guangxu, white vapor suddenly rose in Haiyang and did not vanish until after a while.

items.acceptedSourceText: 康熙四十五年二月，蕭縣民家犬作人言。乾隆二年，利津民家犬生一畜，一首二尾七足。咸豐十一年，來鳳民家犬作人言。同治十一年，大埔民家犬生六足。順治元年二月，興國寺前出白氣一道。六年三月，江陰白氣亙天，彌月始滅。七年正月二十六夜，昆山西方有白氣如練，十餘日始滅；蕭縣白氣見西方，二十餘日始滅。六月甲申，泰安見白氣亙天，益都見白氣亙天。十二月三十日，蕭縣見白氣如練數十條，寒光射人。十八年十二月十二日，棲霞白氣亙天。康熙二年夏，萊陽有白氣衝天。七年正月，廣平見白氣亙天，西出指東，越二十日方滅；內丘夜見白氣如銀河，經五六日方滅；溫江有白氣，自西直亙數十丈，下銳上闊，光如銀，形如竹，經四晝夜方散；威縣見白氣亙天。二月，廣州有白氣如槍，長十餘丈，四十日乃滅；武邑夜白氣亙天，夜半始散；唐山見白氣亙天。七月，高邑夜見白氣如疋布，亙西方。九年三月乙丑，廬陵白氣現自西方。十一月，通渭夜見白氣如虹，自南而北。十一年七月十四日夜，交河有白氣自西南向東北，其疾如飛，聲如風。十六年七月壬申夜，盧龍有白氣如霓，自東向日。十八年六月二十四日，武定見白氣貫天。十一月，玉田有白氣自西南來。十九年十月，全椒見白氣於西方，月餘始滅。十一月朔，滄州有白氣如帚，自西南向東北，浹旬方滅；盧龍有白氣如雲，長亙向東，越數夕色淡，而高起如帚芒狀；絳縣夜見白氣如虹。初二日，鎮洋西方見白氣亙天，長數丈，移時乃滅；臨淄見白氣自西而東。初四日，溫州夜見白氣如練，長十餘丈，月餘始滅。二十年六月二十一日夜，望江見白氣亙天，至八月十一日方滅。十一月，山陽見白氣亙天，一月始滅；漢中西方見白氣亙天如練。二十二年五月己未夜，清河有白氣數道如虹。三十九年九月，江夏見白氣如練，六七日始滅。四十一年二月，沛縣見白氣於西方。六十年十一月十九日，遵化有白氣如練，聚於西南，移時方滅。六十一年六月十四日，嘉定有白氣亙天。雍正九年閏五月二十七日夜，南宮有白氣一道南行有聲。乾隆十八年九月癸丑，東流有氣如虹著天，色紫白，久而沒。三十五年七月二十八日，肥城有白氣十三道，至夜半乃退。嘉慶二十年五月，武定有白氣亙天向西，長數丈。道光十三年四月十八日，棲霞有白氣亙天。二十年，昌黎夜見白氣亙天，逾月乃滅。二十二年春，莘縣有白氣如練數丈，月餘乃滅。冬，玉田有白氣亙天。二十三年三月，黃州有白氣如練，斜指西南，經月始散。四月，滕縣有白氣亙天，月餘乃滅。二十四年夏，登州有白氣亙天。二十五年春，即墨有白氣西北亙天。二十六年秋，寧津夜有白氣長竟天。咸豐七年秋，黃安有白光如電，燭暗室，有聲。十一年六月，棲霞有白光如疋練，橫亙西北，十餘日始滅。同治七年九月十五日，玉田有火光至空際化為白氣，長丈許，其中有聲如鼓。光緒元年秋，海陽有白氣突起，移時始滅。

items.acceptedSourceText: 康平：繁，難。府西一百二十里。明屬福餘衞。國朝為科爾沁左翼後旗地。舊名康家屯，光緒三年移八家鎮經歷治此。六年，析科爾沁左翼中、後二旗南境，前賓圖王旗東境，改置縣，隸府。無城。南北巴虎山在西南。遼河自遼源入，其遼河岔入為老背河。右合公河，會𤛘牛河注之，入開原。西：秀水河自科爾沁左翼後旗入，南入法庫。西南：後新秋，主簿舊駐鄭家屯，二十八年移駐。舊設鋪司三：東南吳家店入開原；東小塔子入府；北太平街接科爾沁。又有道由縣西哈拉沁屯赴賓圖王府；迤西至青溝達熱河綏東；由縣北六家子赴達爾罕王府。

manualTranslations.zh: 元聖周公順治十七年，給事中黏本盛奏請文廟後別立傳聖祠。
manualTranslations.literal: The Original Sage Duke of Zhou—in the seventeenth year of Shunzhi, Supervising Secretary Nian Bensheng memorialized requesting that a separate Chuan Sheng Shrine be established behind the Confucian temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Regarding the Original Sage Duke of Zhou, in Shunzhi 17 Supervising Secretary Nian Bensheng memorialized to establish a separate Chuan Sheng Shrine behind the Confucian temple.

sourceRange.text: 乾隆三十三年，以壯繆原諡，未孚定論，更命神勇，加號靈佑。殿及大門，易綠瓦為黃。四十一年，詔言：「關帝力扶炎漢，志節懍然，陳壽撰志，多存私見。正史存諡，猶寓譏評，曷由傳信？今方錄四庫書，改曰忠義。武英殿可刊此旨傳末，用彰大公。」嘉慶十八年，以林清擾禁城，靈顯翊衛，命皇子報祀如儀，加封仁勇。道光中，加威顯。咸豐二年，加護國。明年，加保民。於是躋列中祀，行禮三跪九叩，樂六奏，舞八佾，如帝王廟儀。五月告祭，承祭官前一日齋，不作樂，不徹饌，供鹿、兔、果、酒。旋追封三代王爵，祭品視崇聖祠。加精誠綏靖封號，御書「萬世人極」額，摹勒頒行。同治九年，加號翊贊。光緒五年，加號宣德。

sourceRange.text: 乾隆八年，定闕里聖廟樂章。二十三年，東巡親祭如往制。遣大臣祭顏、曾、思、孟專廟。勒御制四賢贊於石。其盛京學宮所需樂器，乾隆中始敕府尹遵皇朝禮器圖造作，鎛鍾、特磬，制出內廷，特頒太學暨各省學宮，並令府丞選佾生精音律者送太常習舞。厥後以熱河為時巡所，黌序肇興，定大成殿龕案如太學式，祭器、樂器亦如之。

context.afterSource: 至各省府、州、縣釋奠，以所在印官承祭，禮如太學，順治初行之。

manualTranslations.zh: 乾隆八年，定闕里聖廟樂章。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year of Qianlong, the music chapters for the Qufu sage temple were fixed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 8 the music chapters for the Qufu sage temple were fixed.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十三年，東巡親祭如往制。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-third year, on the eastern tour he personally sacrificed as in former practice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, on the eastern tour he personally sacrificed as in former practice.

manualTranslations.zh: 遣大臣祭顏、曾、思、孟專廟。
manualTranslations.literal: Ministers were dispatched to sacrifice at the dedicated temples of Yan, Zeng, Si, and Meng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ministers were dispatched to sacrifice at the dedicated temples of Yan, Zeng, Si, and Meng.

manualTranslations.zh: 勒御制四賢贊於石。
manualTranslations.literal: Imperial compositions praising the four sages were carved on stone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Imperial compositions praising the four sages were carved on stone.

manualTranslations.zh: 其盛京學宮所需樂器，乾隆中始敕府尹遵皇朝禮器圖造作，鎛鍾、特磬，制出內廷，特頒太學暨各省學宮，並令府丞選佾生精音律者送太常習舞。
manualTranslations.literal: For the musical instruments needed at the Shenjing academy, only in the Qianlong period were provincial governors ordered to make them according to the dynasty ritual-vessel diagrams—bell-chimes and special lithophones were made within the inner court and specially issued to the Grand Academy and provincial academies; academy vice-directors were also directed to select ceremonial dancers skilled in pitch and send them to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to practice dance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For musical instruments needed at the Shenjing academy, only in the Qianlong period were provincial governors ordered to make them according to the dynasty ritual-vessel diagrams—bell-chimes and special lithophones were made within the inner court and issued to the Grand Academy and provincial academies; academy vice-directors were also directed to select dancers skilled in pitch and send them to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to practice dance.

manualTranslations.zh: 厥後以熱河為時巡所，黌序肇興，定大成殿龕案如太學式，祭器、樂器亦如之。
manualTranslations.literal: Later, when Rehe became a seasonal touring residence, schools were established; the Great Completion Hall niches and cases were fixed like the Grand Academy, and ritual vessels and instruments likewise.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later, when Rehe became a seasonal touring residence, schools were established; the Great Completion Hall niches and cases were fixed like the Grand Academy, and ritual vessels and instruments likewise.

sourceRange.text: 咸豐三年，更定䘏典，文四品、武三品官得再入京祠，並獲祀陣亡所在地。其文五品、武四品以下，凡贈職銜及當例䘏者，並祀之。是時軍興，死事揚烈者踵起，略舉其所入者。都統烏蘭泰、霍隆武，將軍佟鑒、祥厚、蘇布通阿、扎拉芬、和春，總督吳文鎔、陸建瀛，提督長瑞、長壽、董光甲、邵鶴齡、恩長、福珠洪阿、陳勝元、雙福、王錦繡、常祿、雙來、瞿騰龍、佟攀梅、鄧紹良、德安、周天培、史榮椿、張國樑、周天受、王浚、樂善、褚克昌，一等男阿爾精阿，一等子左炘，侍郎呂賢基、戴熙，巡撫常大淳、江忠源、陶思培、鄒鳴鶴、吉爾杭阿、徐有壬，學政孫銘恩、張錫庚，副都統伊勒東阿、哲克東阿、達洪阿、貴升、繃闊、博奇、常壽、西林布、多隆武、托克通阿、格繃額、伊興額、舒明安，頭等侍衛達崇阿，布政使岳興阿、劉裕珍、塗文鈞、李續賓、李孟群、王友端，按察使李卿穀、周玉衡，贊善趙振祚，郎中宋蔚謙，總兵博春、福諴、馬濟美、玉山、程三光、劉開泰、桂林、王國才、蔣福長、虎坤元、羅玉斌、邱聯恩、田興奇、承惠、陳大富、滕家勝、郭啟元、王之敬，道員羅澤南、硃鎮、金光箸、帥遠燡、溫紹原、何桂珍、王訓、趙印川、郭沛霖、黃淳熙、繆梓，知府謝子澄、劉騰鶴、江炳琳，副將謝升恩、膺保、李成虎、彭三元、周雲耀、龍汝元。同治朝，則親王僧格林沁，大學士曾國籓，都統海全、舒通額，將軍多隆阿，統領舒保，參贊大臣錫霖、武隆額，領隊大臣色普詩、惠慶、達春泰、穆克登額，辦事大臣扎克當阿，頭等侍衛隆春、奇克塔善，內閣學士金順，提督占泰、李臣典、向榮、塔齊布、林文察、蕭河清、周顯承、羅朝雲、蕭德揚、楊得勝、曹仁美、毛福益、張仁泗、劉松山、譚玉龍、羅雨春、張紹武、胡良作、姚連升、饒得勝、劉長槐、榮維善、楊春祥、張萬美、魯光明、閻定邦、劉祥發、曹德喜，巡撫王有齡、羅遵殿、鄧爾恆，副都統錫齡阿、蘇倫保、恆齡，按察使黃運昌，總兵郝上庠、雷升、熊建益、林向榮、余際昌、郎桂芳、江福山、何建鼇、羅應貴、毛芳恆、張樹珊、唐殿魁、周兆麒、李大櫆、陳清彥、鄧鴻超、江登雲、傅先宗，道員福咸、俞焜、趙景賢、張同登、趙國澍、瑞春、周縉、秦聚奎、彭毓橘、葛承霖、鄧子垣，知府硃鈞、姜錫恩、竇天灝、於醇儒，副將劉神山、黃金友、周學貴、羅春鵬、王夢齡、張起鳳、劉勝龍。光緒間，則大學士左宗棠，總督恆春、曾國荃，將軍明緒，領隊大臣崇熙、烏勒德春、托克托布、博勒果素、托克托奈、喀爾莽阿，參贊大臣額騰額、覺羅奎棟，辦事大臣奎英、薩凌阿，提督硃南英、李秀山、湛其英、楊世俊、王子龍、文德盛、陳忠德、滕學義、何明海、魏金闕、文德昌、李登第、王慶福、楊萬義、楊必耀、李大洪、鍾興發、張宗久、楊玉科、劉思河、李其森、梁善明，鹽運使陶士霖，總兵石紹文、陳登雲、鄧仁和、黃應斗、周友山、硃希廣、王茂連、王春和、譚聲俊、達年、剛安泰、向集梧、鄧承恩、韋和禮、劉節高、陳嘉、左寶貴、周康祿、黃鼎、葉維籓、侯雲登，戶部主事玉潤，知府龔秉琳、侯學雲、馬椿齡、張瀚中，副將王世晉、李天和、章茂、張定邦、尤正廷、楊隆輝、張玉秋、王碧庭、徐安邦、李啟榮、裕廉、王宗高。二十六年，尚書崇綺，將軍延茂，總督李秉衡，併入祀。尋罷秉衡。凡祠祭諸臣，大都效命戎行，守陴徇義，或積勞沒身。褒忠節，勸來者，會典綦詳。茲錄什一，以見例焉。

manualTranslations.zh: 咸豐三年，更定䘏典，文四品、武三品官得再入京祠，並獲祀陣亡所在地。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng the mourning rites regulations were revised: civil officials of the fourth rank and military officials of the third rank were permitted to be enshrined again in the capital temple and also to receive worship at the place where they fell in battle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Xianfeng reign the mourning regulations were revised so that civil officials of the fourth rank and military officials of the third rank could again be enshrined in the capital temple and also receive worship where they had fallen in battle.

manualTranslations.zh: 其文五品、武四品以下，凡贈職銜及當例䘏者，並祀之。
manualTranslations.literal: Civil officials of the fifth rank and military officials of the fourth rank and below—all who received posthumous titles or qualified for mourning rites by regulation—were likewise enshrined.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Civil officials of the fifth rank and military officials of the fourth rank and below, including all who received posthumous titles or qualified for mourning rites under the regulations, were likewise enshrined.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時軍興，死事揚烈者踵起，略舉其所入者。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time military campaigns were underway; those who died in service and had their exploits proclaimed arose in succession, and a selection of those enshrined follows.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time campaigns were in progress and men who died in service and had their deeds proclaimed followed one after another; what follows is a selection of those enshrined.

sourceRange.text: 乾隆二年，諭凡產銅山場，實有裨鼓鑄，准報開採。其金銀礦悉行封閉。先是，五年允魯撫硃定元請，開章丘、淄川、泰安、新泰、萊蕪、肥城、寧陽、滕、嶧、泗水、蘭山、剡城、費、莒、蒙陰、益都、臨朐、博山、萊陽、海陽各州縣煤礦，而藁城知縣高崶請自備貲開嶧、滕、費、淄、沂、平陰、泰安銀銅鉛礦則禁之。然貴州思安之天慶寺、鎮遠之中峰嶺，陝西之哈布塔海哈拉山，甘肅之扎馬圖、敦煌、沙洲南北山，伊犁之皮里沁山、古內、雙樹子，烏魯木齊之迪化、奎騰河、呼圖壁、瑪納斯、庫爾喀喇烏蘇、條金溝各金礦，貴州法都、平遠、達摩山，雲南三嘉、麗江之回龍、昭通之樂馬各銀礦，相繼開採。嘉慶四年，給事中明繩奏言民人潘世恩、蘇廷祿請開直隸邢台銀礦。上謂：「國家經費自有正供，潘世恩、蘇廷祿覬覦礦利，敢藉納課為詞，實屬不安本分。」命押遞迴籍，明繩下部議。六年，保寧以請開塔爾巴哈台金礦，明安以請開平泉州銅礦，均奉旨申飭。道光初年，封禁甘肅金廠、直隸銀廠。蓋其時歲入有常，不輕言利。惟雲南之南安、石羊、臨安、箇舊銀廠，歲課銀五萬八千餘兩；其餘金礦歲至數十兩，銀礦歲至數千兩而止。又旋開旋停，興廢不常，賦入亦鮮。銅鉛利關鼓鑄，開採者多邀允准，間有蠲除課稅者。廣東自康熙五十四年封禁礦山，至乾隆初年，英德、陽春、歸善、永安、曲江、大埔、博羅等縣，廣州、肇慶兩府，銅鉛礦均行開採。百餘年來，雲、貴、兩湖、兩粵、四川、陝西、江西、直隸報開銅鉛礦以百數十計，而雲南銅礦尤甲各行省。蓋鼓鑄鉛銅並重，而銅尤重。秦、鄂、蜀、桂、黔、贛皆產銅，而滇最饒。滇銅自康熙四十四年官為經理，嗣由官給工本。

localRange.text: 滇銅自官為經理，嗣由官給工本。

context.beforeSource: 故其時礦東開礦，較他省尤為厲禁。
context.afterSource: 雍正初，歲出銅八九十萬，不數年，且二三百萬，歲供本路鼓鑄。

manualTranslations.zh: 乾隆二年，諭凡產銅山場，實有裨鼓鑄，准報開採。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, an edict stated that wherever mountain fields producing copper genuinely aided drum casting, reporting and opening for extraction was permitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 2, an edict permitted reporting and opening copper mines wherever production genuinely aided coin casting.

manualTranslations.zh: 其金銀礦悉行封閉。
manualTranslations.literal: All gold and silver mines were entirely closed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All gold and silver mines were closed.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是，五年允魯撫硃定元請，開章丘、淄川、泰安、新泰、萊蕪、肥城、寧陽、滕、嶧、泗水、蘭山、剡城、費、莒、蒙陰、益都、臨朐、博山、萊陽、海陽各州縣煤礦，而藁城知縣高崶請自備貲開嶧、滕、費、淄、沂、平陰、泰安銀銅鉛礦則禁之。
manualTranslations.literal: Previously, in the fifth year, at the request of Shandong Governor Zhu Dingyuan, coal mines in the counties of Zhangqiu, Zichuan, Tai'an, Xintai, Laiwu, Feicheng, Ningyang, Teng, Yi, Sishui, Lanshan, Yancheng, Fei, Ju, Mengyin, Yidu, Linqu, Boshan, Laiyang, and Haiyang were opened; but when Gaocheng county magistrate Gao Feng requested to open silver, copper, and lead mines at Yi, Teng, Fei, Zi, Yi, Pingyin, and Tai'an at his own expense, the request was forbidden.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, in Qianlong 5, at Shandong Governor Zhu Dingyuan's request, coal mines were opened in Zhangqiu, Zichuan, Tai'an, Xintai, Laiwu, Feicheng, Ningyang, Teng, Yi, Sishui, Lanshan, Yancheng, Fei, Ju, Mengyin, Yidu, Linqu, Boshan, Laiyang, and Haiyang; but Gaocheng magistrate Gao Feng's petition to open silver, copper, and lead mines at his own expense in Yi, Teng, Fei, Zi, Yi, Pingyin, and Tai'an was denied.

manualTranslations.zh: 然貴州思安之天慶寺、鎮遠之中峰嶺，陝西之哈布塔海哈拉山，甘肅之扎馬圖、敦煌、沙洲南北山，伊犁之皮里沁山、古內、雙樹子，烏魯木齊之迪化、奎騰河、呼圖壁、瑪納斯、庫爾喀喇烏蘇、條金溝各金礦，貴州法都、平遠、達摩山，雲南三嘉、麗江之回龍、昭通之樂馬各銀礦，相繼開採。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet gold mines at Tianqing Temple in Si'an, Guizhou; Zhongfeng Ridge in Zhenyuan; Habutahaihala Mountain in Shaanxi; Zhamatu, Dunhuang, and the north and south mountains of Shazhou in Gansu; Piliqin Mountain, Gunei, and Shuangshuzi in Ili; and at Dihua, Kuiteng River, Hutubi, Manas, Kuerkala Wusu, and Tiaojin Gully in Urumqi, together with silver mines at Fadu, Pingyuan, and Damo Mountain in Guizhou and at Sanjia, Huilong in Lijiang, and Lema in Zhaotong, Yunnan, were opened in succession.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gold mines at Tianqing Temple in Si'an, Guizhou; Zhongfeng Ridge in Zhenyuan; Habutahaihala Mountain in Shaanxi; Zhamatu, Dunhuang, and the north and south mountains of Shazhou in Gansu; Piliqin Mountain, Gunei, and Shuangshuzi in Ili; and Dihua, Kuiteng River, Hutubi, Manas, Kuerkala Wusu, and Tiaojin Gully in Urumqi, together with silver mines at Fadu, Pingyuan, and Damo Mountain in Guizhou and at Sanjia, Huilong in Lijiang, and Lema in Zhaotong, Yunnan, were then opened in succession.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘉慶四年，給事中明繩奏言民人潘世恩、蘇廷祿請開直隸邢台銀礦。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing, Censor Ming Sheng memorialized that commoners Pan Shi'en and Su Tinglu had requested to open silver mines at Xingtai in Zhili.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4, Censor Ming Sheng reported that Pan Shi'en and Su Tinglu had petitioned to open silver mines at Xingtai in Zhili.

manualTranslations.zh: 上謂：「國家經費自有正供，潘世恩、蘇廷祿覬覦礦利，敢藉納課為詞，實屬不安本分。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor said: "State revenue has its regular sources; Pan Shi'en and Su Tinglu, coveting mining profits and daring to use payment of duties as a pretext, are truly failing to know their place.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "State revenue has its regular sources. Pan Shi'en and Su Tinglu, coveting mining profits and daring to cite tax payment as a pretext, are truly overstepping their station.

manualTranslations.zh: 」命押遞迴籍，明繩下部議。
manualTranslations.literal: " He ordered them escorted back to their native places, and Ming Sheng's memorial was referred to the Board for deliberation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " He ordered them escorted back to their native places and referred Ming Sheng's memorial to the Board for deliberation.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，保寧以請開塔爾巴哈台金礦，明安以請開平泉州銅礦，均奉旨申飭。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year, Baoning's request to open gold mines at Tarbagatai and Ming'an's request to open copper mines at Pingquan Prefecture both received edicts of stern rebuke.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 6, petitions to open gold mines at Tarbagatai and copper mines at Pingquan Prefecture both received stern imperial rebukes.

manualTranslations.zh: 道光初年，封禁甘肅金廠、直隸銀廠。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of the Daoguang reign, Gansu gold works and Zhili silver works were closed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Daoguang, Gansu gold works and Zhili silver works were closed.

manualTranslations.zh: 蓋其時歲入有常，不輕言利。
manualTranslations.literal: For at that time regular annual revenue was stable, and profit was not lightly discussed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Regular revenue was then stable, and profit was not lightly pursued.

manualTranslations.zh: 惟雲南之南安、石羊、臨安、箇舊銀廠，歲課銀五萬八千餘兩；
manualTranslations.literal: Only the silver works at Nan'an, Shiyang, Lin'an, and Gejiu in Yunnan yielded over fifty-eight thousand taels of silver duty yearly;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only the silver works at Nan'an, Shiyang, Lin'an, and Gejiu in Yunnan yielded more than fifty-eight thousand taels yearly;

manualTranslations.zh: 其餘金礦歲至數十兩，銀礦歲至數千兩而止。
manualTranslations.literal: Other gold mines yielded only dozens of taels yearly, and silver mines only thousands of taels at most.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Other gold mines yielded only dozens of taels a year and silver mines only a few thousand.

manualTranslations.zh: 又旋開旋停，興廢不常，賦入亦鮮。
manualTranslations.literal: They were also opened and stopped in turn, with irregular rise and fall, and tax revenue was likewise meager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mines were opened and shut in turn, revenue was irregular, and yields remained slight.

manualTranslations.zh: 銅鉛利關鼓鑄，開採者多邀允准，間有蠲除課稅者。
manualTranslations.literal: Because copper and lead bore on coin casting, many mining petitions were granted approval, and duties were occasionally remitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because copper and lead bore on coin casting, many opening petitions were approved and duties were sometimes remitted.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣東自康熙五十四年封禁礦山，至乾隆初年，英德、陽春、歸善、永安、曲江、大埔、博羅等縣，廣州、肇慶兩府，銅鉛礦均行開採。
manualTranslations.literal: Guangdong, after mines were closed in the fifty-fourth year of Kangxi, saw copper and lead mines opened again early in Qianlong in the counties of Yingde, Yangchun, Guishan, Yong'an, Qujiang, Dapu, Boluo, and elsewhere in Guangzhou and Zhaoqing prefectures.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guangdong, closed since Kangxi 54, reopened copper and lead mines early in Qianlong in Yingde, Yangchun, Guishan, Yong'an, Qujiang, Dapu, Boluo, and other counties of Guangzhou and Zhaoqing.

manualTranslations.zh: 百餘年來，雲、貴、兩湖、兩粵、四川、陝西、江西、直隸報開銅鉛礦以百數十計，而雲南銅礦尤甲各行省。
manualTranslations.literal: For more than a hundred years, Yunnan, Guizhou, Huguang, Liangguang, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, and Zhili reported over a hundred copper and lead mines opened, with Yunnan copper mines ranking first among all provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Over more than a century, Yunnan, Guizhou, Huguang, Liangguang, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, and Zhili reported well over a hundred copper and lead mines opened, with Yunnan copper leading all provinces.

manualTranslations.zh: 蓋鼓鑄鉛銅並重，而銅尤重。
manualTranslations.literal: For coin casting placed equal weight on lead and copper, but copper above all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Coin casting valued lead and copper alike, but copper above all.

manualTranslations.zh: 秦、鄂、蜀、桂、黔、贛皆產銅，而滇最饒。
manualTranslations.literal: Qin, E, Shu, Gui, Qian, and Gan all produced copper, but Yunnan was the most abundant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shaanxi, Hubei, Sichuan, Guangxi, Guizhou, and Jiangxi all produced copper, but Yunnan was richest.

manualTranslations.zh: 滇銅自康熙四十四年官為經理，嗣由官給工本。
manualTranslations.literal: Yunnan copper had been managed by the state since the forty-fourth year of Kangxi; afterward the government supplied working capital.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since Kangxi 44 Yunnan copper had been state-managed; afterward the government supplied operating capital.

sourceRange.text: 道光二十四年，詔雲南、貴州、四川、廣東等省，除現在開採外，如尚有他礦原開採者，准照現開各廠一律辦理。二十八年，復詔「四川、雲、貴、兩廣、江西各督撫，於所屬境內確切查勘，廣為曉諭。其餘各省督撫，亦著留心訪查，酌量開採，不準託詞觀望。至官辦、民辦、商辦，應如何統轄彈壓稽查之處，朝廷不為遙制」。一時礦禁大弛。咸豐二年，以寬籌軍餉，招商開採熱河、新疆及各省金銀諸礦。三年，詔曰：「開採礦產，以天地自然之利還之天地，較之一切權宜弊政，無傷體制，有裨民生。當此軍餉浩繁，左藏支絀，各督撫務當權衡緩急，於礦苗豐旺之區，奏明試辦。」時軍興餉乏，當時開採者，僅新疆噶爾，蒙古達拉圖、噶順、紅花溝之金礦，直隸珠窩山、遍山線、室溝、土槽子、錫蠟片、牛圈子溝，蒙古哈勒津、羅圈溝、庫察山、長杭溝之銀礦，新疆迪化、羅布淖爾、三個山之銅錫礦數處。同治七年，吉林請開火石嶺子等處煤礦，以伏莽未靖，格部議不果行。十三年，以滇礦經兵燹久廢，諭飭開辦，從滇督岑毓英請也。

context.beforeSource: 故滇省銅政，累葉程功，非他項礦產可比。
context.afterSource: 是年海防議起，直隸總督李鴻章、船政大臣沈葆楨請開採煤鐵以濟軍需，上允其請，命於直隸磁州、福建台灣試辦。

manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Daoguang, an edict to Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, Guangdong, and other provinces stated that aside from presently operating mines, any other mines originally opened might be handled according to the same rules as currently operating works.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 24, an edict to Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, Guangdong, and other provinces allowed any previously opened mines not now operating to be handled under the same rules as active works.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十八年，復詔「四川、雲、貴、兩廣、江西各督撫，於所屬境內確切查勘，廣為曉諭。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, a further edict ordered: "Governors-general and governors of Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Liangguang, and Jiangxi shall thoroughly survey and widely announce within their jurisdictions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 28, a further edict ordered: "Governors-general and governors of Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Liangguang, and Jiangxi shall thoroughly survey their jurisdictions and make this widely known.

manualTranslations.zh: 其餘各省督撫，亦著留心訪查，酌量開採，不準託詞觀望。
manualTranslations.literal: Governors-general and governors of the remaining provinces are also to investigate attentively, open mines as appropriate, and may not plead excuses and wait.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Governors-general and governors of the remaining provinces must also investigate attentively, open mines as appropriate, and may not plead excuses and delay.

manualTranslations.zh: 至官辦、民辦、商辦，應如何統轄彈壓稽查之處，朝廷不為遙制」。
manualTranslations.literal: As for whether mines are run by the state, by the people, or by merchants, and how they should be governed, suppressed, and inspected, the court will not control these matters from afar."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As for state-run, privately run, or merchant-run mines and how they should be governed, suppressed, and inspected, the court would not micromanage from afar."

manualTranslations.zh: 一時礦禁大弛。
manualTranslations.literal: For a time mining restrictions were greatly relaxed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mining restrictions were greatly relaxed for a time.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸豐二年，以寬籌軍餉，招商開採熱河、新疆及各省金銀諸礦。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng, to broaden military funding, merchants were recruited to open gold and silver mines in Rehe, Xinjiang, and various provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 2, to broaden military funding, merchants were recruited to open gold and silver mines in Rehe, Xinjiang, and the provinces.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，詔曰：「開採礦產，以天地自然之利還之天地，較之一切權宜弊政，無傷體制，有裨民生。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, an edict stated: "Opening mines returns to the realm the natural bounty of Heaven and Earth; compared with all expedient abusive policies, it does not harm the institutional order and benefits the people's livelihood.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3, an edict stated: "Opening mines returns Heaven and Earth's natural bounty to the realm. Compared with expedient abusive policies, it does not harm the institutional order and benefits the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 當此軍餉浩繁，左藏支絀，各督撫務當權衡緩急，於礦苗豐旺之區，奏明試辦。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time military expenses are vast and treasury disbursements strained; each governor-general and governor must weigh urgency, and where ore deposits are rich and thriving, memorialize and trial operations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With military expenses vast and treasury disbursements strained, each governor-general and governor must weigh priorities and, where ore deposits are rich, memorialize for trial operations.

manualTranslations.zh: 」時軍興餉乏，當時開採者，僅新疆噶爾，蒙古達拉圖、噶順、紅花溝之金礦，直隸珠窩山、遍山線、室溝、土槽子、錫蠟片、牛圈子溝，蒙古哈勒津、羅圈溝、庫察山、長杭溝之銀礦，新疆迪化、羅布淖爾、三個山之銅錫礦數處。
manualTranslations.literal: " At that time, with war arising and funds scarce, the mines actually opened were only a few: gold mines at G'ar, Dala Tu, Gashun, and Honghuagou in Xinjiang and Mongolia; silver mines at Zhujia Mountain, Bianshanxian, Shigou, Tucao Zi, Xilapian, and Niujuanzi Gully in Zhili, and at Halejin, Luoquan Gully, Kucha Mountain, and Changhang Gully in Mongolia; and several copper and tin mines at Dihua, Lop Nur, and Sange Mountain in Xinjiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " With war under way and funds scarce, only a few mines were actually opened: gold mines at G'ar, Dala Tu, Gashun, and Honghuagou in Xinjiang and Mongolia; silver mines at Zhujia Mountain, Bianshanxian, Shigou, Tucao Zi, Xilapian, and Niujuanzi Gully in Zhili and at Halejin, Luoquan Gully, Kucha Mountain, and Changhang Gully in Mongolia; and several copper and tin mines at Dihua, Lop Nur, and Sange Mountain in Xinjiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 同治七年，吉林請開火石嶺子等處煤礦，以伏莽未靖，格部議不果行。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi, Jilin requested opening coal mines at Huoshilingzi and elsewhere, but because bandits had not yet been pacified, the Board's deliberation blocked implementation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7, Jilin requested opening coal mines at Huoshilingzi and elsewhere, but because bandits had not yet been pacified, the Board blocked the plan.

manualTranslations.zh: 十三年，以滇礦經兵燹久廢，諭飭開辦，從滇督岑毓英請也。

sourceRange.text: 粵督張之洞請緩辦津通，改建腹省幹路，疏言：今日鐵路之用，以開通土貨為急。進口外貨，歲逾出口土貨二千萬兩。若聽其耗漏，以後萬不可支，惟有設法多出土貨、多銷土貨以濟之。有鐵路，則機器可入，笨貨可出，山鄉邊郡之產，悉可致諸江岸海壖，流行於九洲四瀛之外矣。而沿江沿海、遼東三省、秦隴沿邊，強鄰窺伺，防不勝防。若無鐵路應援赴敵，以靜待動，安得無數良將精兵利砲巨餉而守之？宜先擇四達之衢，首建幹路，為經營全局之計。至津通鐵路，則關係甚鉅，不便尤多。設此路創造之時，稍有紛擾，則習常蹈故者，益將執為口實，視為畏途。以後他處續造，集股之官商必裹足，疑沮之愚民必有辭，則鐵路之功終無由成，而鐵路之效終無由見矣。翁同龢請試行於邊地以便運兵，徐會灃等請改設於德州、濟寧以便運漕，均擬緩辦津通，為另闢一路之計。但邊地偏遠，無裨全局，效亦難見；且非商賈輻輳之所，鐵路費無所出，不足以自存。德濟一路，黃河岸闊沙松，工費太鉅。臣以為宜自京城外之盧溝橋起，經河南達於湖北漢口鎮。豫、鄂居天下之腹，中原綰轂，胥出其塗。鐵路取道，宜自保定、正定、磁州，歷彰、衛、懷等府，北岸在清化鎮以南，南岸在滎澤口以上，擇黃河上游灘窄岸堅經流不改之處，作橋以渡河，則三晉之轍下於井陘，關隴之驂交於洛口，西北聲息刻期可通。自河以南，則由鄭、許、信陽驛路以抵漢口，東引淮、吳，南通湘、蜀。語其便利，約有數事。內處腹地，不近海口，無引敵之慮，利一。南北三千餘里，原野廣漠，編戶散處，不似近郊之稠密，一屋一墳易於勘避，利二。幹路袤遠，廠盛站多，經路生理既繁，緯路枝流必旺。執鞭之徒，列肆之賈，生計甚寬，舍舊謀新，決無失所，利三。以一路控八九省之沖，人貨輻輳，貿易必旺。將來汴洛、荊襄、濟東、淮泗，經緯縱橫，各省旁通，四達不悖。豈惟有養路之資費，實可裕無窮之餉源，利四。近畿有事，三楚舊部，兩淮精兵，電檄一傳，不崇朝而雲集都下。或內地偶有土寇竊發，發兵征討，旬日立可蕩平。徵兵之道，莫此為便，利五。中國礦利，惟煤鐵最有把握。太行以北，煤鐵最旺而最精，而質最重、路最艱。既有鐵路，則輦機器以開採，用西法以煎鎔，礦產日多。大開三晉之利源，永塞中華之漏卮，利六。海上用兵，首慮梗漕。東南漕米百餘萬石，由鎮江輪船溯江而上，三日而抵漢口，又二日而達京城。由盧溝橋運赴京倉，道里與通縣相等，足以備河海之不虞，辟飛輓之坦道，而又省挑河剝運之浮糜。較之東道王家營一路礙於黃河下流者，辦理轉有把握，利七。若慮費鉅難成，則分北京至正定為首段，次至黃河北岸，又次至信陽州為二三段，次至漢口為末段。每里不過五六千金，每段不過四百萬內外，合計四段之工，須八年造成，款亦八年分籌。中國之大，每年籌二百萬之款，似尚不至無策。籌款之法，除由鐵路公司照常招股外，應酌擇各省口岸較盛、鹽課較旺之地，由籓運兩司、關道轉發印票股單，設法勸集。鐵料運自晉省，置爐鍊冶，以供取用，庶施工有序，而藏富在民。

sourceRange.text: 雍正五年秋九月，與俄訂恰克圖互市界約十一條。俄察罕汗卒後，其妃代臨朝，為叩肯汗。遣使臣薩瓦暨俄官伊立禮，與理籓院尚書圖禮善、喀爾喀親王策淩在恰克圖議定。喀爾喀北界，自楚庫河以西，沿布林固特山至博移沙嶺為兩國邊境，而互市於恰克圖。議定，陳兵鳴砲，謝天立誓。是月，定俄人來京就學額數。俄國界近大西洋者崇天主教，其南境近哈薩克者崇回教，其東境近蒙古者崇佛教。康熙間，嘗遣人至中國學喇嘛經典，並遣子弟入國子監，習滿、漢語言文字，居舊會同館，以滿、漢助教各一人教習之。至是，定俄人來學喇嘛者，額數六人，學生額數四人，十年更代為例。乾隆二十三年春正月，俄人獻叛人阿睦爾撒納屍。初，厄魯特輝特部阿睦爾撒納背準噶爾來附，帝封為親王，命副定北將軍班第征準噶爾，降其部眾。已復叛歸，逃入俄，索之，以渡河溺死聞。既而患痘死，遂移屍至恰克圖來獻。未幾，厄魯特台吉舍楞戕中國都統唐喀祿，叛逃入俄，索之又不與，絕其恰克圖貿易。三十年秋八月，俄綽爾濟喇嘛丹巴達爾紮等請附，又恐俄人追索，中國擒送，遣人來探。瑚圖靈阿以聞，帝命納之。三十三年秋八月，復俄恰克圖互市，理籓院設庫倫辦事大臣掌之。四十四年，再停互市，次年復之。五十四年，又以納叛人閉市，嚴禁大黃、茶葉出口，俄人復以為請。五十七年，乃與訂恰克圖市約五條。嘉慶七年秋七月，喀爾喀親王蘊端多爾濟請巡查恰克圖兩國邊界，帝命逾十年與庫倫辦事大臣輪次往查。十年冬十二月，俄商船來粵請互市，不許。道光二十五年，俄進呈書籍三百餘種。二十八年，俄商船來上海求互市，不許。初嘉、道間，俄由黑海沿裏海南侵遊牧各回部。英吉利既據東南兩印度，漸拓及溫都斯坦而北。於是蔥嶺西自布哈爾、浩罕諸部皆併於俄，夾恆河城郭回國半屬於英，英、俄邊界僅隔印度歌士一大山，連年爭戰。俄思結援中國，遣使約中國以兵二萬由緬甸、西藏夾攻印度。事未行。英旋助土耳其與俄戰，始講和而罷。逮江寧撫議定，法、美未與議者，亦照英例，並在五口通商。而俄人自嘉慶十一年商船來粵駮回後，至是有一船亦來上海求市，經疆臣奏駮，後遂有四國聯盟合從稱兵之事。咸豐元年，俄人請增伊犁、塔爾巴哈台、喀什噶爾互市，經理籓院議允伊、塔而拒喀什噶爾。文宗即位，命伊犁將軍奕山等與之定約，成通商章程十七條。三年，俄人請在上海通商，不許。又請立格爾畢齊河界牌，許之。至五年，俄帝尼哥拉斯一世始命木喇福岳福等來畫界。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Russian tsar died, his consort ruled in his stead as Koken Khan.

manualTranslations.zh: 遣使臣薩瓦暨俄官伊立禮，與理籓院尚書圖禮善、喀爾喀親王策淩在恰克圖議定。
manualTranslations.literal: Envoy Sawa and the Russian officer Yilili were sent to negotiate at Kyakhta with Minister of the Lifan Yuan Tu Shan and Khalkha Prince Celeng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Envoy Sawa and Russian officer Yilili negotiated at Kyakhta with Lifan Yuan Minister Tu Shan and Khalkha Prince Celeng.

manualTranslations.zh: 喀爾喀北界，自楚庫河以西，沿布林固特山至博移沙嶺為兩國邊境，而互市於恰克圖。
manualTranslations.literal: Khalkha's northern border, from west of the Chiku River along Mount Bulintegut to the Boyishaling ridge, was fixed as the boundary of both states, with trade at Kyakhta.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Khalkha's northern border ran west from the Chiku River along Mount Bulintegut to Boyishaling Ridge, with trade at Kyakhta.

manualTranslations.zh: 議定，陳兵鳴砲，謝天立誓。
manualTranslations.literal: Once agreed, troops were arrayed, guns fired, and oaths sworn to heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When terms were set, troops were drawn up, guns fired, and oaths sworn to heaven.

manualTranslations.zh: 是月，定俄人來京就學額數。
manualTranslations.literal: That month quotas were fixed for Russians coming to the capital to study.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That month quotas were fixed for Russians studying in the capital.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄國界近大西洋者崇天主教，其南境近哈薩克者崇回教，其東境近蒙古者崇佛教。
manualTranslations.literal: In Russia, those near the Atlantic revered Catholicism; the southern frontier near the Kazakhs revered Islam; the eastern frontier near Mongolia revered Buddhism.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Russians near the Atlantic followed Catholicism; those on the Kazakh frontier followed Islam; those on the Mongol frontier followed Buddhism.

manualTranslations.zh: 康熙間，嘗遣人至中國學喇嘛經典，並遣子弟入國子監，習滿、漢語言文字，居舊會同館，以滿、漢助教各一人教習之。
manualTranslations.literal: During Kangxi, men had been sent to China to study Lamaist scriptures, and youths sent to the Imperial College to learn Manchu and Chinese language and writing, lodging in the old Tongwenguan, with one Manchu and one Chinese assistant instructor each to teach them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Kangxi, Russians had sent men to study Lamaist scriptures in China and youths to the Imperial College to learn Manchu and Chinese, lodging in the old Tongwenguan under one Manchu and one Chinese assistant instructor each.

manualTranslations.zh: 至是，定俄人來學喇嘛者，額數六人，學生額數四人，十年更代為例。
manualTranslations.literal: Now quotas were fixed: six for Russians coming to study Lamaism, four student places, with replacement every ten years as the rule.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now quotas were set at six for Lamaist study and four student places, with rotation every ten years.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾隆二十三年春正月，俄人獻叛人阿睦爾撒納屍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of spring of Qianlong 23, Russians presented the corpse of the rebel Amursana.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of Qianlong 23, Russia presented the corpse of the rebel Amursana.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，厄魯特輝特部阿睦爾撒納背準噶爾來附，帝封為親王，命副定北將軍班第征準噶爾，降其部眾。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier Amursana of the Khorchin Zunghar tribe had deserted the Zunghars to submit; the emperor enfeoffed him as prince and ordered him to assist Dingbei General Bandi in campaigning against the Zunghars and reducing their tribes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier Amursana of the Khorchin had deserted the Zunghars to submit; the emperor made him a prince and ordered him to assist Dingbei General Bandi against the Zunghars and reduce their followers.

manualTranslations.zh: 已復叛歸，逃入俄，索之，以渡河溺死聞。
manualTranslations.literal: He rebelled again and fled into Russia; when demanded back, word came that he had drowned crossing a river.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He rebelled again and fled into Russia; when China demanded him back, word came that he had drowned crossing a river.

manualTranslations.zh: 既而患痘死，遂移屍至恰克圖來獻。
manualTranslations.literal: He later died of smallpox, and the corpse was brought to Kyakhta and presented.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later died of smallpox, and the body was brought to Kyakhta and presented.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，厄魯特台吉舍楞戕中國都統唐喀祿，叛逃入俄，索之又不與，絕其恰克圖貿易。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long the Zunghar taiji Sheleng killed Chinese dutong Tang Kalu, rebelled, and fled into Russia; when demanded back they again refused, and Kyakhta trade was cut off.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon the Zunghar taiji Sheleng killed Chinese dutong Tang Kalu, rebelled, and fled into Russia; when China demanded him back Russia refused again, and Kyakhta trade was suspended.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十年秋八月，俄綽爾濟喇嘛丹巴達爾紮等請附，又恐俄人追索，中國擒送，遣人來探。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn of the thirtieth year, the Russian Jörgis lama Danbadarja and others requested attachment, fearing Russian pursuit; China seized and sent them back, and they sent men to investigate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn of Qianlong 30, the Russian Jörgis lama Danbadarja and others sought Qing protection, fearing Russian pursuit; when China seized and returned them, they sent men to investigate.

manualTranslations.zh: 瑚圖靈阿以聞，帝命納之。
manualTranslations.literal: Hutuling'a reported this; the emperor ordered them received.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hutuling'a reported this; the emperor ordered them received.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十三年秋八月，復俄恰克圖互市，理籓院設庫倫辦事大臣掌之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn of the thirty-third year, Kyakhta trade with Russia was restored; the Lifan Yuan established a Khuree resident minister to manage it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn of Qianlong 33, Kyakhta trade with Russia was restored; the Lifan Yuan appointed a Khuree resident minister to manage it.

manualTranslations.zh: 四十四年，再停互市，次年復之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the forty-fourth year trade was again suspended, and restored the following year.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 44 trade was suspended again and restored the next year.

manualTranslations.zh: 五十四年，又以納叛人閉市，嚴禁大黃、茶葉出口，俄人復以為請。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year the market was again closed for harboring rebels; export of rhubarb and tea was strictly forbidden, and Russians again petitioned on the matter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 54 the market closed again over harbored rebels; export of rhubarb and tea was strictly forbidden, and Russia petitioned again.

manualTranslations.zh: 五十七年，乃與訂恰克圖市約五條。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifty-seventh year five articles of a Kyakhta market agreement were concluded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 57 five Kyakhta market articles were concluded.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘉慶七年秋七月，喀爾喀親王蘊端多爾濟請巡查恰克圖兩國邊界，帝命逾十年與庫倫辦事大臣輪次往查。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn of Jiaqing 7, Khalkha Prince Yunduoduoerji requested inspection of the Kyakhta border of both states; the emperor ordered inspection every ten years in rotation with the Khuree resident minister.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn of Jiaqing 7, Khalkha Prince Yunduoduoerji asked to inspect the Kyakhta border; the emperor ordered joint inspections every ten years with the Khuree resident minister.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年冬十二月，俄商船來粵請互市，不許。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter of the tenth year a Russian merchant ship came to Guangdong requesting trade—this was refused.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter of Jiaqing 10 a Russian merchant ship came to Guangdong seeking trade. China refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 道光二十五年，俄進呈書籍三百餘種。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Daoguang, Russia presented more than three hundred kinds of books.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 25 Russia presented more than three hundred books.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十八年，俄商船來上海求互市，不許。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year a Russian merchant ship came to Shanghai seeking trade—this was refused.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 28 a Russian merchant ship came to Shanghai seeking trade. China refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 初嘉、道間，俄由黑海沿裏海南侵遊牧各回部。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in the Jiaqing and Daoguang periods, Russia advanced from the Black Sea along the Caspian southward into the pastoral Muslim regions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiaqing and Daoguang periods, Russia advanced from the Black Sea along the Caspian into the pastoral Muslim regions.

manualTranslations.zh: 英吉利既據東南兩印度，漸拓及溫都斯坦而北。
manualTranslations.literal: Britain, having seized the two Indias in the southeast, gradually expanded northward into Transoxiana.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Britain, having seized southeastern India, gradually expanded north into Transoxiana.

manualTranslations.zh: 於是蔥嶺西自布哈爾、浩罕諸部皆併於俄，夾恆河城郭回國半屬於英，英、俄邊界僅隔印度歌士一大山，連年爭戰。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon west of the Pamirs, from Bukhara, Kokand, and other states all were annexed by Russia; the walled Muslim states along the Ganges were half under Britain; the British and Russian frontiers were separated only by the great Kish mountain of India, and they fought year after year.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: West of the Pamirs, Bukhara, Kokand, and neighboring states fell to Russia; walled Muslim states along the Ganges were half British; British and Russian frontiers were separated only by the great Kish range in India, and war continued year after year.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄思結援中國，遣使約中國以兵二萬由緬甸、西藏夾攻印度。
manualTranslations.literal: Russia thought to ally with China and sent envoys proposing that China march twenty thousand troops through Burma and Tibet to attack India from both sides.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Russia sought Chinese help and proposed a joint attack on India with twenty thousand troops through Burma and Tibet.

manualTranslations.zh: 事未行。
manualTranslations.literal: The plan was not carried out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The plan went nowhere.

manualTranslations.zh: 英旋助土耳其與俄戰，始講和而罷。
manualTranslations.literal: Britain soon aided Turkey in war with Russia, and peace was finally made and the scheme dropped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Britain soon aided Turkey against Russia; peace followed and the scheme ended.

manualTranslations.zh: 逮江寧撫議定，法、美未與議者，亦照英例，並在五口通商。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Nanjing settlement was concluded, France and the United States, though not parties to the negotiations, likewise followed the British precedent and traded at the five ports.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the Nanjing settlement, France and the United States, though not parties to the talks, followed Britain's example and joined trade at the five ports.

manualTranslations.zh: 而俄人自嘉慶十一年商船來粵駮回後，至是有一船亦來上海求市，經疆臣奏駮，後遂有四國聯盟合從稱兵之事。
manualTranslations.literal: Russians, since their merchant ship had been turned back from Guangdong in Jiaqing 11, now also had a ship come to Shanghai seeking trade; frontier officials memorialized refusal, and afterward came the affair of the four-power alliance joining forces and taking up arms.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since Jiaqing 11, when a Russian merchant ship was turned back from Guangdong, another now came to Shanghai seeking trade; frontier officials memorialized refusal, and afterward came the four-power alliance and war.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸豐元年，俄人請增伊犁、塔爾巴哈台、喀什噶爾互市，經理籓院議允伊、塔而拒喀什噶爾。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng, Russians requested added trade at Ili, Tarbagatai, and Kashgar; the Lifan Yuan deliberated and permitted Ili and Tarbagatai but refused Kashgar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 1 Russia asked to add trade at Ili, Tarbagatai, and Kashgar; the Lifan Yuan allowed Ili and Tarbagatai but refused Kashgar.

manualTranslations.zh: 文宗即位，命伊犁將軍奕山等與之定約，成通商章程十七條。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Wenzong acceded, he ordered Ili General Yishan and others to conclude a treaty with them, forming seventeen articles of trade regulations.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenzong acceded, he ordered Ili General Yishan and others to conclude a treaty—seventeen trade articles.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，俄人請在上海通商，不許。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year Russians requested trade at Shanghai—this was refused.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3 Russia asked to trade at Shanghai. China refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 又請立格爾畢齊河界牌，許之。
manualTranslations.literal: They also requested erection of boundary markers on the Gorbitsa River—this was permitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Russia also asked to erect markers on the Gorbitsa River. China agreed.

manualTranslations.zh: 至五年，俄帝尼哥拉斯一世始命木喇福岳福等來畫界。
manualTranslations.literal: By the fifth year the Russian emperor Nicholas I finally ordered Muravyov and others to come demarcate the boundary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By Xianfeng 5 Tsar Nicholas I finally ordered Muravyov and others to come demarcate the border.

sourceRange.text: 同治元年春二月，與俄訂陸路通商章程。俄人初意欲納稅從輕，商蒙古不加限制，張家口立行棧，經關隘免稽查。總署以俄人向在恰克圖等處以貨易華茶出口，今許其進口貿易，宜照洋關重稅，免礙華商生計。又庫倫為蒙古錯居之地，其為庫倫大臣所屬者，向止車臣汗、圖什業圖汗等地，此外各遊牧處所地曠族繁，不盡為庫倫大臣所轄，若許俄隨地貿易，稽查難周。又張家口距京伊邇，嚴拒俄商設立行棧。久之，始定章程二十一款于天津，續增稅則一冊。三月，俄人以喀什噶爾不靖，請暫移阿克蘇通商，不許。

context.afterSource: 時俄人在伊犁屬瑪呢圖一帶私設卡倫，阻中國赴勒布希之路，復於沙拉托羅海境率兵攔阻查邊人，聲稱哈薩克、布魯特為其屬國，又於各卡倫外壘立鄂博。
context.afterLocal: 時俄人在伊犁屬瑪呢圖一帶私設卡倫，阻中國赴勒布希之路，復於沙拉托羅海境率兵攔阻查邊人，聲稱哈薩克、布魯特為其屬國，又於各卡倫外壘立鄂博。

manualTranslations.zh: 同治元年春二月，與俄訂陸路通商章程。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of spring of Tongzhi 1, overland trade regulations were concluded with Russia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of Tongzhi 1, China and Russia concluded overland trade regulations.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄人初意欲納稅從輕，商蒙古不加限制，張家口立行棧，經關隘免稽查。
manualTranslations.literal: At first the Russians wished light taxation, unrestricted trade in Mongolia, establishment of warehouses at Zhangjiakou, and exemption from inspection at passes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first Russia sought light duties, unrestricted trade in Mongolia, warehouses at Zhangjiakou, and exemption from inspection at passes.

manualTranslations.zh: 總署以俄人向在恰克圖等處以貨易華茶出口，今許其進口貿易，宜照洋關重稅，免礙華商生計。
manualTranslations.literal: The Yamen held that since Russians had long exported Chinese tea in trade at Kyakhta and elsewhere, now permitting them import trade, heavy customs duties like foreign treaty ports should apply, lest Chinese merchants' livelihoods suffer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen replied that Russians had long bought Chinese tea for export at Kyakhta and elsewhere; now that import trade was allowed, duties should match treaty-port rates so Chinese merchants would not be harmed.

manualTranslations.zh: 又庫倫為蒙古錯居之地，其為庫倫大臣所屬者，向止車臣汗、圖什業圖汗等地，此外各遊牧處所地曠族繁，不盡為庫倫大臣所轄，若許俄隨地貿易，稽查難周。
manualTranslations.literal: Further, Khuree was a place where Mongols were intermixed; what fell under the Khuree minister was limited to the lands of the Tsetsen Khan, Tösheet Khan, and the like; beyond these, pastoral areas were vast and tribes numerous, not all under the Khuree minister—if Russians were permitted to trade wherever they pleased, inspection would be difficult to enforce.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Khuree was also a mixed Mongol region. The Khuree minister's jurisdiction had long been limited to the Tsetsen Khan, Tösheet Khan, and similar domains; beyond them lay vast pastures and many tribes not all under his control—allowing Russians to trade wherever they chose would make inspection impossible.

manualTranslations.zh: 又張家口距京伊邇，嚴拒俄商設立行棧。
manualTranslations.literal: Further, Zhangjiakou was close to the capital; establishment of Russian trading warehouses was strictly refused.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhangjiakou was also too close to the capital; Russian warehouses there were firmly refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 久之，始定章程二十一款于天津，續增稅則一冊。
manualTranslations.literal: After lengthy negotiations, twenty-one articles of regulations were finally fixed at Tianjin, with a supplementary tariff volume.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After long negotiation, twenty-one regulatory articles were finally fixed at Tianjin, with a supplementary tariff schedule.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月，俄人以喀什噶爾不靖，請暫移阿克蘇通商，不許。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month, because Kashgar was unsettled, Russians requested that trade temporarily move to Aksu—this was refused.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month, citing unrest in Kashgar, Russia asked to move trade temporarily to Aksu. China refused.

sourceRange.text: 康熙十五年，帝召見其商人尼果賚，貽書察罕汗，令管束羅刹，毋擾邊陲。既而羅刹復肆擾，帝命黑龍江將軍薩布素圍雅克薩城。會荷蘭貢使至，乃賜書付荷蘭轉達其汗。二十五年九月，其新察罕汗復書至，言：「中國前屢賜書，本國無能通解者。今已知邊人構釁之罪，自當嚴治，即遣使臣詣邊定界，請先釋雅克薩之圍。」許之，遂詔薩布素退師。

context.beforeSource: 十二年及十七年，俄察罕汗兩附貿易人至京奏書，然不言邊界事。
context.afterSource: 二十八年冬十二月，與俄定黑龍江界，立約七條。
context.beforeLocal: 十二年及十七年，俄察罕汗兩附貿易人至京奏書，然不言邊界事。
context.afterLocal: 二十八年冬十二月，與俄定黑龍江界，立約七條。

manualTranslations.zh: 康熙十五年，帝召見其商人尼果賚，貽書察罕汗，令管束羅刹，毋擾邊陲。
manualTranslations.literal: In Kangxi 15 the emperor received the Russian merchant Nikogolei and sent a letter to the Tsar ordering restraint of the Luocha and no disturbance of the frontier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 15 the emperor received the Russian merchant Nikogolei and sent a letter to the tsar ordering the Luocha restrained and the frontier left in peace.

manualTranslations.zh: 既而羅刹復肆擾，帝命黑龍江將軍薩布素圍雅克薩城。
manualTranslations.literal: The Luocha again made raids; the emperor ordered Heilongjiang General Sabsu to besiege Albazin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Luocha raided again; the emperor ordered Heilongjiang General Sabsu to besiege Albazin.

manualTranslations.zh: 會荷蘭貢使至，乃賜書付荷蘭轉達其汗。
manualTranslations.literal: When a Dutch tribute envoy arrived, an imperial letter was entrusted to Holland for transmission to the khan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When a Dutch tribute envoy arrived, an imperial letter was given to Holland to forward to the khan.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十五年九月，其新察罕汗復書至，言：「中國前屢賜書，本國無能通解者。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-fifth year the new Tsar's reply arrived, saying: "China has repeatedly sent letters, but our state had no one who could understand them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Kangxi 25 the new tsar's reply arrived, saying: "China has sent many letters, but our state had no one who could read them.

manualTranslations.zh: 今已知邊人構釁之罪，自當嚴治，即遣使臣詣邊定界，請先釋雅克薩之圍。
manualTranslations.literal: We now know the guilt of frontier subjects who provoked trouble and will certainly punish them strictly; we will immediately send envoys to the border to fix the boundary—please first lift the siege of Albazin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We now know the guilt of frontier troublemakers and will punish them strictly; we will send envoys at once to fix the border—please lift the siege of Albazin first.

manualTranslations.zh: 」許之，遂詔薩布素退師。
manualTranslations.literal: " Permission was granted, and Sabsu was ordered to withdraw his army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Permission was granted, and Sabsu was ordered to withdraw.

sourceRange.text: 宣統二年，屆中俄通商條約期滿，應改訂，因與駐京俄使交涉，俄使堅執舊約。正爭議間，俄使奉本國政府電旨，轉向中國提出要求案：:一，兩國國境各百里內，俄制定之國境稅率，不受限制，兩國領土內之產物及工商品，皆無稅貿易；

context.afterSource: :二，旅中國俄人訟案，全歸俄官審理，兩國人民訟案，歸兩國會審；

manualTranslations.zh: 宣統二年，屆中俄通商條約期滿，應改訂，因與駐京俄使交涉，俄使堅執舊約。

sourceRange.text: 宣統元年四月，督辦鐵道大臣張之洞與英及德、法、美四國銀行訂粵漢川漢鐵道借款草約，豫定六百萬鎊。會之洞卒，復與盛宣懷立約續成之。又與英及德兩公司續訂津浦鐵路借款合同，共二十四款，借英金五百萬鎊，年息五釐，路工四年造竣。二年，英人以兵力據片馬，設砲臺於高黎貢山，侵踞小江以北茶山土司地。滇人大憤，各省人亦起應之，遂電政府請力爭。滇督李經羲亦請外務部與英使交涉，英卒不退兵。三年，復派員與英劃境，不省。是年度支部尚書載澤與英及德、法、美締結一千萬鎊借款契約，以改革幣制及東三省興業為詞，是為四國借款契約。又與英訂禁煙條件。原議十年遞減，至是中國以為國內栽種吸食漸已減少，欲縮短年限禁絕，與英特訂專條，期印藥不入中國。而第三條又言廣州、上海二口為最後之結束，不能驟禁，於是煙卒不能禁矣。

sourceRange.text: 嘉慶七年春三月，英人窺澳門，以兵船六泊雞頸洋，粵督吉慶宣諭回國，至六月始去。十年春三月，英王雅治復遣其臣多林文附商船來粵獻方物。十三年秋九月，復謀襲澳門，以兵船護貨為詞，總督吳熊光屢諭使去，不聽，遂據澳，復以兵船闖入虎門，進泊黃埔。命剿辦絕市，褫熊光職，英人始於十月退師。明年春二月，增築澳門砲臺。夏五月，定廣東互市章程。十九年冬十一月，禁英人傳教。二十年春三月，申鴉片煙禁。二十一年夏六月，英國遣其臣加拉威禮來粵東投書，言英太子攝政已歷四年，感念純皇帝聖恩，遣使來獻方物，循乾隆五十八年貢道，由海洋舟山至天津赴都，懇總督先奏。

sourceRange.text: 光緒元年正月乙卯，英繙譯官馬嘉理被戕於雲南。先是馬嘉理奉其使臣威妥瑪命，以總署護照赴緬甸迎探路員副將柏郎等，偕行至雲南騰越廳屬蠻允土司地被戕。時岑毓英以巡撫兼署總督。威妥瑪疑之，聲言將派兵自辦。帝派湖廣總督李瀚章赴滇查辦。威妥瑪遂出京赴上海，於是有命李鴻章、丁日昌會同商議之舉。威妥瑪至津見李鴻章，以六事相要，鴻章拒之。政府派前兵部侍郎郭嵩燾使英，威妥瑪亦欲拒議。又駐滬英商租上海、吳淞間地敷設鐵軌，行駛火車，總督沈葆楨以英人築路租界外，違約，飭停工。至是，威妥瑪遣其漢文正使梅輝立赴滬商辦，鴻章乃與約，令英商停工，而中國以原價購回自辦。初上海既通商，租界內仍有釐捐局，專收華商未完半稅之貨。至是，威妥瑪欲盡去釐捐局，界內中國不得設局徵收釐稅，鴻章請政府勿許。

sourceRange.text: 咸豐元年，文宗嗣位，英人以火輪船駛赴天津，稱來吊大行皇帝喪。直隸總督以聞，命卻之。三年，洪秀全陷江寧，英以輪船駛至江寧，迎入城，與通款，英人言：「不助官，亦不助洪。」四年，劉麗川據上海作亂。初，英人阻官軍進兵，江督怡良等詰之。既而英人欲變通貿易章程，聯法、美二國請於粵督葉名琛，不許，遂赴上海見蘇撫吉爾杭阿。九月，赴天津。帝命長蘆鹽政崇綸等與相見，拒其遣使駐京諸條，久之始去。

sourceRange.text: 道光二十五年，法商赴粵，詣總督署，請弛漢人習教之禁。總督耆英據以入告，許之開堂傳教，仍限於海口，禁入內地。咸豐三年十二月，有法輪船一駛入長江，未幾解纜去。而法與英、美又欲變通成約，廣東總督葉名琛以換約未屆期，拒之。遂偕英、美逕赴天津，要求如英、美，並請釋陝西傳教人，長蘆鹽政崇綸等以聞。上以定例五口通商外，不許外人擅入內地，何以陝西盩厔縣有法人傳教？飭令詳查，並嚴詞拒之，乃去。時粵賊踞上海，築砲堤防禦，吉爾杭阿因向法提督辣厄爾告以「賊築砲堤，爾國領事署首當其衝，應速遷以免受傷。」辣厄爾立毀其堤，並砲擊賊。事聞，獎之。六年六月，英、美各國求換約，法公使顧思照會兩廣總督葉名琛，援約與英、美一體，力阻不從。七年十二月二十一日，英人結法公使噶曆為援，襲入廣東省城，擄名琛以去。先是法人謂有人殺其說書老人，向名琛索犯，限三日交出，並要求五事：一，入城；二，索河南地；三，求改章程；四，索補兵費；五，求通商。限日答覆。名琛回牒許通商，餘皆不許，而又不設備，遂至被擄。英、法連檣赴天津，美、俄亦相繼至，各有所求。法人又欲推廣商埠，任意傳教，遣公使駐京，入內地買絲茶，並請查辦廣西西林縣殺馬神父案，皆不許。八年三月，法與英人攻踞海口砲台，進逼天津。於是命大學士桂良、吏部尚書花沙納往議，徇所請。遂於五月定約，法得通商、傳教及兵費，幾與英等。

context.afterLocal: 九年五月，法公使布林布隆以進京換約為名，隨英公使普魯斯赴天津，拒不納，致傷敗數百人，折回上海，聲言調兵復仇。
