manualTranslations.zh: 天聰元年，從伐朝鮮，師有功，分賜降戶及所獲馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong, he followed the campaign against Korea; the army had merit, and surrendered households and captured horses were distributed as rewards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1 he joined the Korean campaign; when the army won honors, surrendered households and captured horses were distributed as rewards.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，從伐明，入龍井關，克大安口，下遵化，薄明都，四遇敵，戰皆勝。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year he followed the campaign against Ming, entered Longjing Pass, captured Da'ankou, took Zunhua, approached the Ming capital, met the enemy four times, and won every battle.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined the Ming campaign, entered Longjing Pass, took Da'ankou and Zunhua, approached the capital, met the enemy four times, and won every fight.

manualTranslations.zh: 复擊明兵盧溝橋，以七人先入敵陣，遂破之。
manualTranslations.literal: Again he attacked Ming troops at Lugou Bridge; with seven men he was first into the enemy line and broke them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He again struck Ming troops at Lugou Bridge; with seven men he was first into the enemy ranks and routed them.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年春，師還，駐遵化，明兵擊喀喇沁兵壘，布顏代趨援卻敵。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, as the army returned and encamped at Zunhua, Ming troops attacked the Khorchin stockade; Buyandai rushed to relieve them and drove the enemy off.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year, as the army returned and halted at Zunhua, Ming troops attacked the Khorchin camp; Buyandai hurried to the rescue and drove them off.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋與武訥格略地行山岡，遇敵，斬級四十餘。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon afterward, together with Wunage he raided territory along the hill ridges, met the enemy, and beheaded more than forty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he joined Wunage in raiding along the ridges, met the enemy, and killed more than forty.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，授禮部承政，兼右翼蒙古梅勒額真。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed vice minister of the Board of Rites and concurrently meiren ejen of the right-wing Mongols.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he became vice minister of the Board of Rites and concurrently meiren ejen of the right-wing Mongols.

manualTranslations.zh: 從圍大凌河，明兵出戰，布顏代傷於矛，仍力戰卻敵，斬一人。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed the siege of Dalinghe; when Ming troops came out to fight, Buyandai was wounded by a spear but still fought fiercely, drove the enemy off, and beheaded one man.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the siege of Dalinghe, when Ming troops sallied, Buyandai was speared but kept fighting, drove them back, and killed one man.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，從略宣府、大同邊外，收察哈爾部眾。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he followed raids beyond the borders of Xuanfu and Datong and received the submission of Chakhar tribesmen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined raids beyond Xuanfu and Datong and brought Chakhar tribesmen to submit.

manualTranslations.zh: 師還，以匿俘獲，吏議削世職、罰鍰、奪俘獲及賜物，上命毋削世職。
manualTranslations.literal: When the army returned, because he concealed captives and booty, officials proposed stripping his hereditary office, fining him, and seizing his captives and gifts; the sovereign ordered that his hereditary office not be stripped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the march home he was found to have concealed captives and booty; officials urged stripping his hereditary rank, fining him, and seizing his prizes, but the sovereign ordered that his hereditary rank stand.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，上自將伐明，攻大同，布顏代與侍衛星訥等率蒙古巴牙喇兵八十人，經哈麻爾嶺，收察哈爾部眾。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year the sovereign personally led a campaign against Ming and attacked Datong; Buyandai, together with guardsman Xingne and others, led eighty Mongol bayara troops through Hamar Ridge and received the submission of Chakhar tribesmen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Nurhaci took the field in person against Ming at Datong. Buyandai and guardsman Xingne led eighty Mongol bayara troops over Hamar Ridge and brought Chakhar tribesmen to submit.

manualTranslations.zh: 進次西拉木輪，降百餘戶；
manualTranslations.literal: Advancing, they halted at Xilamulun and received the surrender of more than a hundred households;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Advancing to Xilamulun, they received the surrender of more than a hundred households;

manualTranslations.zh: 又進，遇察哈爾部俄爾塞圖等以所屬來降。
manualTranslations.literal: advancing again, they met Oersetu of the Chakhar tribe and others, who came with their followers to submit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and pressing on, met Oersetu of the Chakhar and others, who came over with their followers.

manualTranslations.zh: 還，與大軍會。
manualTranslations.literal: On their return they joined the main army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the return march they rejoined the main army.

manualTranslations.zh: 以功，進三等梅勒章京。
manualTranslations.literal: For merit he was advanced to third-rank meiren zhangjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For his merit he was raised to third-rank meiren zhangjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，蒙古旗制定，以布顏代為鑲紅旗固山額真。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year, when the Mongol banners were fixed, Buyandai was made gushan ejen of the Bordered Red Banner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when Mongol banners were organized, Buyandai was made gushan ejen of the Bordered Red Banner.

manualTranslations.zh: 崇德元年，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，克昌平。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed Prince Wu Ying Ajige in campaigning against Ming and captured Changping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he followed Prince Wu Ying Ajige against Ming and took Changping.

manualTranslations.zh: 師還出塞，明兵襲我後，布顏代為所敗，坐罷固山額真世職，降一等甲喇章京，罰鍰，奪俘獲。
manualTranslations.literal: As the army returned beyond the border, Ming troops attacked the rear; Buyandai was defeated, was removed from the hereditary office of gushan ejen, reduced to first-rank jalan zhangjing, fined, and stripped of captives.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On the march home beyond the border, Ming troops struck the rear and defeated Buyandai. He lost his hereditary gushan ejen rank, was reduced to first-rank jalan zhangjing, fined, and stripped of captives.

manualTranslations.zh: 順治元年，以巴牙喇甲喇額真從入關，與梅勒額真和託等逐李自成至慶都。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, as bayara jalan ejen he followed in entering the pass and, with meiren ejen Hetuo and others, pursued Li Zicheng to Qingdu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1, as bayara jalan ejen, he crossed into China and, with meiren ejen Hetuo and others, pursued Li Zicheng to Qingdu.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋從豫親王多鐸定陝西。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon afterward he followed Prince Yu Dodo in pacifying Shaanxi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He soon followed Prince Yu Dodo in pacifying Shaanxi.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年，加半個前程。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he was granted half a step of seniority.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year he received half a step of seniority.

manualTranslations.zh: 復從下江南，渡黃河，與明兵戰，身被數傷，所乘馬亦創，猶力戰衝鋒殪敵，遂以創卒，年六十有一。
manualTranslations.literal: Again he followed in subduing Jiangnan, crossed the Yellow River, fought Ming troops, suffered several wounds, and his mount was also injured; still he fought fiercely, charged, and killed the enemy, and finally died of his wounds at the age of sixty-one.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He again joined the conquest of Jiangnan, crossed the Yellow River, and fought Ming troops. Though he took several wounds and his horse was also injured, he kept charging and killing the enemy until he died of his wounds at sixty-one.

manualTranslations.zh: 子鄂穆布，襲職。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Emubu succeeded to the office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Emubu inherited the rank.

sourceRange.text: 崇德元年二月，命齎書投明邊諸守將，歷松棚路、潘家口、董家口、喜峰口致責言焉。五月，從伐明，薄明都，敗明兵盧溝橋。三年二月，從伐喀爾喀部。七月，擢議政大臣，兼巴牙喇纛章京。九月，從伐明，自牆子嶺入，敗明兵，追擊，得馬八十七。四年，帥師戍烏欣河口。偕侍衛阿爾薩蘭攻松山，布延為伏，斬二十一級。诇敵錦州，斬邏卒八，得馬十二。五年，從睿親王多爾袞圍錦州，擊敗明步軍。六年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗克錦州外城，與內大臣伊爾登戰最力，賚百金，進世職二等甲喇章京。八月，上自將擊洪承疇，其將曹變蛟夜襲上營，布延以內大臣不嚴守禦，論罰。七年二月，師擊承疇，布延兵後至，當死，命論罰以贖。十一月，伐明，圍薊州。順治二年，世祖以布延舊臣，進世職一等甲喇章京。其從子烏納海，先以戰死，卹贈世職牛錄章京，命布延並襲，進三等阿思哈尼哈番。八年，卒，次子茂奇塔特襲世職。茂奇塔特，康熙三十五年，從征噶爾丹有功，加拖沙喇哈番，例進二等。

localRange.text: 茂奇塔特，，從征噶爾丹有功，加拖沙喇哈番，例進二等。

manualTranslations.zh: 崇德元年二月，命齎書投明邊諸守將，歷松棚路、潘家口、董家口、喜峰口致責言焉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Chongde, he was ordered to carry letters and deliver them to the Ming border commanders, passing Songpeng Road, Panjiakou, Dongjiakou, and Xifengkou to present reproaches.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of Chongde 1 he was ordered to carry letters to Ming border commanders along Songpeng Road, Panjiakou, Dongjiakou, and Xifengkou with reproaches.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，從伐明，薄明都，敗明兵盧溝橋。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month he followed the campaign against Ming, approached the Ming capital, and defeated Ming troops at Lugou Bridge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he joined the Ming campaign, approached the capital, and defeated Ming troops at Lugou Bridge.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年二月，從伐喀爾喀部。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the third year he followed the campaign against the Khalkha tribe.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year he joined the campaign against the Khalkha.

manualTranslations.zh: 七月，擢議政大臣，兼巴牙喇纛章京。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh month he was promoted to deliberative minister and concurrently made bayara dao zhangjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was made a deliberative minister and concurrently bayara dao zhangjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 九月，從伐明，自牆子嶺入，敗明兵，追擊，得馬八十七。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth month he followed the campaign against Ming, entered through Qiangziling, defeated Ming troops, pursued them, and took eighty-seven horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he joined the Ming campaign, entered through Qiangziling, routed Ming troops, pursued them, and took eighty-seven horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，帥師戍烏欣河口。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year he commanded troops garrisoning Wuxinhekou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he commanded the garrison at Wuxinhekou.

manualTranslations.zh: 偕侍衛阿爾薩蘭攻松山，布延為伏，斬二十一級。
manualTranslations.literal: Together with guardsman Arsalan he attacked Songshan; Buyan lay in ambush and beheaded twenty-one.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With guardsman Arsalan he attacked Songshan; Buyan set an ambush and killed twenty-one.

manualTranslations.zh: 诇敵錦州，斬邏卒八，得馬十二。
manualTranslations.literal: Scouting the enemy at Jinzhou, he beheaded eight border patrol soldiers and took twelve horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Scouting at Jinzhou, he killed eight border scouts and took twelve horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，從睿親王多爾袞圍錦州，擊敗明步軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Prince Regent Dorgon in besieging Jinzhou and defeated Ming infantry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Prince Regent Dorgon in the siege of Jinzhou and routed Ming infantry.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗克錦州外城，與內大臣伊爾登戰最力，賚百金，進世職二等甲喇章京。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang in taking the outer city of Jinzhou; he fought most fiercely with grand minister of the interior Ilden, was rewarded with a hundred taels of gold, and was advanced in hereditary rank to second-rank jalan zhangjing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang in taking Jinzhou's outer city and fought hardest with Grand Minister Ilden. He was rewarded with a hundred taels of gold and rose in hereditary rank to second-rank jalan zhangjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 八月，上自將擊洪承疇，其將曹變蛟夜襲上營，布延以內大臣不嚴守禦，論罰。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month the sovereign personally led an attack on Hong Chengchou; his general Cao Bianjiao raided the imperial camp by night; Buyan was punished for the grand minister's failure to guard strictly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the sovereign took the field in person against Hong Chengchou. When Cao Bianjiao raided the imperial camp by night, Buyan was punished because the grand minister had not guarded strictly.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年二月，師擊承疇，布延兵後至，當死，命論罰以贖。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, as the army attacked Chengchou, Buyan's troops arrived late; he should have died, but was ordered punished instead to redeem his life.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year, during the attack on Chengchou, Buyan's troops arrived late. He deserved death, but was allowed to redeem his life by punishment.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月，伐明，圍薊州。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh month he campaigned against Ming and besieged Jizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he campaigned against Ming and besieged Jizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 順治二年，世祖以布延舊臣，進世職一等甲喇章京。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi, because Buyan was an old minister, the Shizu advanced his hereditary rank to first-rank jalan zhangjing.

manualTranslations.zh: 其從子烏納海，先以戰死，卹贈世職牛錄章京，命布延並襲，進三等阿思哈尼哈番。
manualTranslations.literal: His nephew Wunahai had earlier died in battle; mourning gifts granted the hereditary office of niru zhangjing, and Buyan was ordered to inherit both offices, advancing to third-rank ashan i hafan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His nephew Wunahai had died in battle earlier; posthumous honors granted the hereditary rank of niru zhangjing, and Buyan was ordered to inherit both lines, rising to third-rank ashan i hafan.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，卒，次子茂奇塔特襲世職。

sourceRange.text: 崇德三年，起授巴牙喇纛章京。四年春，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，伊爾登以三十人行略地，敗明兵千人，掠其馬。上自將大軍駐錦州。四月，阿濟格以其師會攻松山、杏山，诇知明總兵祖大壽、太監高起潛將二千人出戰，我師為伏以待，敵逡巡不前。伊爾登以四十人紆道致敵，且戰且卻，伏發合擊，大敗明兵。六月，命充議政大臣，兼內大臣。

context.beforeSource: 尋從豫親王多鐸伐朝鮮，師還，復從武英郡王阿濟格攻皮島，坐先軍纛渡江，复罰鍰。
context.afterSource: 六年六月，從鄭親王濟爾哈朗圍錦州，明總兵洪承疇以師赴援，屯松山西北。

manualTranslations.zh: 四年春，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，伊爾登以三十人行略地，敗明兵千人，掠其馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year he followed Prince Ajige of the Wuying Commandery to campaign against Ming; Yierdeng with thirty men conducted a raiding march, defeated a thousand Ming troops, and seized their horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year he followed Prince Ajige of the Wuying Commandery against Ming. Yierdeng with thirty men raided the countryside, defeated a thousand Ming troops, and seized their horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 上自將大軍駐錦州。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor personally led the main army to encamp at Jinzhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor personally led the main army to encamp at Jinzhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 四月，阿濟格以其師會攻松山、杏山，诇知明總兵祖大壽、太監高起潛將二千人出戰，我師為伏以待，敵逡巡不前。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month Ajige joined his division to attack Songshan and Xingshan; scouts learned that Ming commander-in-chief Zu Dashou and the eunuch Gao Qiqian would come out with two thousand men; our forces lay in ambush awaiting them, and the enemy hesitated and would not advance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Ajige joined his division to attack Songshan and Xingshan. Scouts learned that Ming commander-in-chief Zu Dashou and the eunuch Gao Qiqian would come out with two thousand men. Our forces lay in ambush, and the enemy hesitated and would not advance.

manualTranslations.zh: 伊爾登以四十人紆道致敵，且戰且卻，伏發合擊，大敗明兵。
manualTranslations.literal: Yierdeng with forty men took a detour to draw the enemy, fighting while retreating; the ambush rose and struck together, routing the Ming army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yierdeng with forty men took a detour to draw the enemy, fighting while retreating. The ambush rose and struck together, routing the Ming army.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，命充議政大臣，兼內大臣。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month he was appointed deliberative minister and also inner minister.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was appointed deliberative minister and also inner minister.

sourceRange.text: 天聰三年，從伐明，薄明都，駐軍城北，擊敗明總兵滿桂等。七年，從伐明，攻旅順口。巴奇蘭率白奇超哈兵與鑲白旗固山額真薩穆什喀方舟而前，敵負崖，戰甚力，巴奇蘭被數創，冒矢石奮擊，且號於眾曰：「孰能先登，吾昪其功於上前！」於是牛錄額真雍舜、珠瑪喇超距登崖，巴奇蘭督眾兵從之上，敵殊死戰，我軍少卻。巴奇蘭疾呼曰：「敵兵敗矣！」士卒皆踴躍騰藉入，遂克之，進三等副將。

context.beforeSource: 太宗即位，各旗設調遣大臣二，巴奇蘭佐正黃旗。
context.afterSource: 八年五月，太宗自將伐明，貝勒濟爾哈朗留守，巴奇蘭副之。

manualTranslations.literal: Baqilan led white-banded light cavalry together with Bordered White Banner gushan ejen Samuska forward by boat; the enemy held the cliff and fought fiercely; Baqilan received several wounds, braved arrows and stones to fight all the harder, and called to the host: "Whoever scales first, I will report his merit before the emperor!"

sourceRange.text: 順治元年，從入關，擊李自成，授世職牛錄章京。考績，加半個前程。五年，擢戶部侍郎。從英親王阿濟格討姜瓖，師下大同，令車克援太原，與巡撫祝世昌謀，遣兵殲瓖將劉遷、萬鍊等。七年，兼任正白旗滿洲梅勒額真。世職累進二等阿達哈哈番。八年，改都察院參政。駐防河間，佐領碩爾對訐戶部給餉不均，事具巴哈納傳。車克亦坐降世職拖沙喇哈番。旋擢戶部尚書。十年，复世職。十一年，加太子太保。十二年，擢秘書院大學士，進少保。十三年，復進少傅兼太子太傅，領戶部尚書。十四年，考滿，加少師兼太子太師。十六年，命赴江南督造戰艦。十七年，命與安南將軍宗室羅託率師駐福建，防鄭成功。

manualTranslations.zh: 五年，擢戶部侍郎。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue.

manualTranslations.zh: 從英親王阿濟格討姜瓖，師下大同，令車克援太原，與巡撫祝世昌謀，遣兵殲瓖將劉遷、萬鍊等。
manualTranslations.literal: He followed Prince Ying Ajige against Jiang Xiang; when the army reached Datong, Che Ke was ordered to relieve Taiyuan. Together with Governor Zhu Shichang he plotted and sent troops to annihilate Jiang's generals Liu Qian, Wan Lian, and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Ying Ajige against Jiang Xiang. When the army reached Datong, Che Ke was ordered to relieve Taiyuan. With Governor Zhu Shichang he planned and sent troops to destroy Jiang's generals Liu Qian, Wan Lian, and others.

manualTranslations.zh: 七年，兼任正白旗滿洲梅勒額真。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventh year he was additionally appointed Meile-i Jinggin of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was additionally appointed Meile-i Jinggin of the Manchu Bordered White Banner.

manualTranslations.zh: 世職累進二等阿達哈哈番。
manualTranslations.literal: His hereditary office was repeatedly advanced to second-rank Adahafan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His hereditary rank was advanced step by step to second-rank Adahafan.

manualTranslations.zh: 八年，改都察院參政。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to censorate commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to censorate commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 駐防河間，佐領碩爾對訐戶部給餉不均，事具巴哈納傳。
manualTranslations.literal: Garrisoned at Hejian, Assistant Commandant Shuordui impeached the Board of Revenue for unequal distribution of pay; the affair is recorded in full in Bahana's biography.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While garrisoned at Hejian, Assistant Commandant Shuordui accused the Board of Revenue of unequal pay distribution; the affair is recorded in full in Ba Ha Na's biography.

manualTranslations.zh: 車克亦坐降世職拖沙喇哈番。
manualTranslations.literal: Che Ke was also convicted and his hereditary office was reduced to Tusarahafan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Che Ke was also convicted and his hereditary rank was reduced to Tusarahafan.

manualTranslations.zh: 旋擢戶部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was promoted to Minister of Revenue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to Minister of Revenue.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，复世職。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year his hereditary office was restored.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year his hereditary rank was restored.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一年，加太子太保。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eleventh year he was given the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二年，擢秘書院大學士，進少保。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Grand Academician of the Secretariat College and advanced to Junior Guardian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was promoted to Grand Academician of the Secretariat College and advanced to Junior Guardian.

manualTranslations.zh: 十三年，復進少傅兼太子太傅，領戶部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was again advanced to Junior Tutor and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and concurrently served as Minister of Revenue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was again advanced to Junior Tutor and Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and concurrently headed the Ministry of Revenue.

manualTranslations.zh: 十四年，考滿，加少師兼太子太師。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourteenth year, at completion of his term review, he was given the additional titles of Junior Preceptor and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, when his term review was complete, he received the additional titles of Junior Preceptor and Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 十六年，命赴江南督造戰艦。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was ordered to go to Jiangnan to supervise the construction of war vessels.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was ordered to go to Jiangnan to supervise the building of warships.

manualTranslations.zh: 十七年，命與安南將軍宗室羅託率師駐福建，防鄭成功。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was ordered to lead troops with Annam General the imperial clansman Luo Tuo and garrison Fujian against Zheng Chenggong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was ordered to lead troops with Annam General the imperial clansman Luo Tuo and garrison Fujian against Zheng Chenggong.

sourceRange.text: 乾隆二年，署雲南總督。疏言：「雲南水利與他省不同，水自山出，勢若建瓴。大率水高田低，自上而下，當濬溝渠，使盤旋曲折，承以木梘、石槽，引使溉田。偶有田高水低，則宜車戽。又或雨後水急，則宜塘蓄。低道小港水阻恐傍溢，則宜疏水口使得暢流。山多沙磧，水發嫌迅激，則宜築堤埝，俾護田畝。臣令有司勘修，工小，令於農隙按田出夫，督率興作；工稍大者，出夫外，應需工料，令集士民公議需費多寡。有田用水者，按田定銀數，借庫帑興工。工畢，分年還款。工大非民力能勝，詳情覆勘，以官莊變價，留充工費。」報聞。

manualTranslations.zh: 乾隆二年，署雲南總督。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Qianlong, he served as acting governor-general of Yunnan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Qianlong, he served as acting governor-general of Yunnan.

manualTranslations.zh: 疏言：「雲南水利與他省不同，水自山出，勢若建瓴。
manualTranslations.literal: He memorialized: "Yunnan's waterworks differ from those of other provinces—the water issues from the mountains, and the gradient is like water poured from a tilted jar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Yunnan's water management differs from that of other provinces: water issues from the mountains, and the slope is like water poured from a tilted jar.

manualTranslations.zh: 大率水高田低，自上而下，當濬溝渠，使盤旋曲折，承以木梘、石槽，引使溉田。
manualTranslations.literal: Generally the water lies higher and the fields lower; flowing from above downward, canals should be dredged so that they wind and bend, supported by wooden sluices and stone troughs to lead water to irrigate the fields.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a rule the water lies higher and the fields lower; flowing from above downward, canals should be dredged to wind and bend, fitted with wooden sluices and stone troughs to channel water for irrigation.

manualTranslations.zh: 偶有田高水低，則宜車戽。
manualTranslations.literal: When fields happen to lie higher and the water lower, wheel-scoops should be used.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Where fields happen to lie higher than the water, wheel-scoops should be used.

manualTranslations.zh: 又或雨後水急，則宜塘蓄。
manualTranslations.literal: After heavy rain when the water runs swiftly, ponds should be built for storage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After heavy rain, when the water runs too swiftly, ponds should be built for storage.

manualTranslations.zh: 低道小港水阻恐傍溢，則宜疏水口使得暢流。
manualTranslations.literal: Where low paths and small channels are obstructed and threaten to spill over, outlet channels should be cleared so the flow can run freely.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Where low paths and small channels are obstructed and threaten to spill over, outlet channels should be cleared so the water can run freely.

manualTranslations.zh: 山多沙磧，水發嫌迅激，則宜築堤埝，俾護田畝。
manualTranslations.literal: In mountain regions with much sand and gravel, where sudden release of water tends to run too swift and violent, dikes and bunds should be built to protect the farmland.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In mountainous regions with much sand and gravel, where released water tends to run too swift and violent, dikes and bunds should be built to protect the fields.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣令有司勘修，工小，令於農隙按田出夫，督率興作；
manualTranslations.literal: I have ordered the responsible officials to survey and repair. For small projects, during farming intervals laborers should be levied by field area, and work should be directed and carried out;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I have ordered the responsible officials to survey and repair. For small projects, laborers should be levied by field area during farming intervals and work directed accordingly;

manualTranslations.zh: 工稍大者，出夫外，應需工料，令集士民公議需費多寡。
manualTranslations.literal: for somewhat larger projects, beyond laborers, materials will be needed; the gentry and people should be assembled to discuss publicly how much will be required.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: for somewhat larger projects, beyond laborers, materials will be needed, and the gentry and people should be assembled to discuss publicly how much will be required.

manualTranslations.zh: 有田用水者，按田定銀數，借庫帑興工。
manualTranslations.literal: Those with fields using water should be assessed a silver sum by field, and treasury funds should be borrowed to undertake the work.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Those whose fields use water should be assessed a silver sum by field, and treasury funds borrowed to undertake the work.

manualTranslations.zh: 工畢，分年還款。
manualTranslations.literal: When the work is done, repayment should be made over successive years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the work is finished, repayment should be made over successive years.

manualTranslations.zh: 工大非民力能勝，詳情覆勘，以官莊變價，留充工費。」
manualTranslations.literal: For projects too large for the people's strength to bear, a detailed re-survey should be conducted, and official estates sold off to defray the cost."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For projects too large for the people's strength to bear, a detailed re-survey should be conducted, and official estates sold off to cover the cost."

manualTranslations.zh: 報聞。
manualTranslations.literal: Report was received.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court took note.

sourceRange.text: 于敏中和珅弟和琳蘇凌阿于敏中，字叔子，江蘇金壇人。乾隆三年一甲一名進士，授翰林院修撰。以文翰受高宗知，直懋勤殿，敕書華嚴、楞嚴兩經。累遷侍講，典山西鄉試，督山東、浙江學政。十五年，直上書房。累遷內閣學士。十八年，复督山東學政。擢兵部侍郎。二十一年，丁本生父憂，歸宗持服。逾年，起署刑部侍郎。二十三年，嗣父枋歿，回籍治喪。未幾，丁本生母憂，未以上聞。御史朱嵇疏劾敏中「兩次親喪，蒙混為一，恝然赴官」。並言：「部臣與疆臣異，不宜奪情任事。」詔原之。尋實授。調戶部，管錢法堂事。二十五年，命為軍機大臣。敏中敏捷過人，承旨得上意。三十年，擢戶部尚書。子齊賢，鄉試未中式。詔以敏中久直內廷，僅一子年已及壯，加恩依尚書品級予廕生。又以敏中正室前卒，特封其妾張為淑人。三十三年，加太子太保。三十六年，協辦大學士。三十八年，晉文華殿大學士，兼戶部尚書如故。時下詔徵遺書，安徽學政朱筠請開局搜輯永樂大典中古書。大學士劉統勳謂非政要，欲寢其議。敏中善筠奏，與統勳力爭，於是特開四庫全書館，命敏中為正總裁，主其事。又充國史館、三通館正總裁。屢典會試，命為上書房總師傅，兼翰林院掌院學士。敏中為軍機大臣久，頗接外吏，通聲氣。三十九年，內監高雲從漏洩硃批道府記載，下廷臣鞫治。雲從言敏中嘗向詢問記載，及雲從買地涉訟，嘗乞敏中囑託府尹蔣賜棨。上面詰，敏中引罪，詔切責之曰：「內廷諸臣與內監交涉，一言及私，即當據實奏聞。朕方嘉其持正，重治若輩之罪，豈肯轉咎奏參者？於敏中侍朕左右有年，豈尚不知朕而為此隱忍耶？於敏中日蒙召對，朕何所不言？何至轉向內監探詢消息？自川省用兵以來，敏中承旨有勞。大功告竣，朕欲如張廷玉例，領以世職。今事垂成，敏中乃有此事，是其福澤有限，不能受朕深恩，寧不痛自愧悔？免其治罪，嚴加議處。」部議革職，詔從寬留任。四十一年，金川平，詔嘉其勞勚，過失可原，仍列功臣，給一等輕車都尉，世襲罔替。四十四年，病喘，遣醫視，賜人蓡。卒，優詔賜卹，祭葬如例，祀賢良祠，諡文襄。子齊賢，前卒。孫德裕，襲世職，以主事用。敏中從侄時和，擁其貲回籍，德裕訟之。江蘇巡撫吳壇察治，罪時和，戍伊犁。所侵奪者，還德裕三萬兩，馀充金壇開河用。蘇松糧道章攀桂為敏中營造花園，事覺，褫攀桂職。敏中受地方官逢迎，以已卒置不論。既而浙江巡撫王亶望以貪敗，上追咎敏中。五十一年，詔曰：「朕幾馀詠物，有嘉靖年間器皿，念及嚴嵩專權煬蔽，以致國是日非，朝多稗政。取閱嚴嵩傳，見其賄賂公行，生死予奪，潛竊威柄，實為前明奸佞之尤。本朝家法相承，紀綱整肅，太阿從不下移，本無大臣專權之事。原任大學士於敏中因任用日久，恩眷稍優。無識之徒，心存依附，敏中亦遂時相招引，潛受苞苴。其時軍機大臣中無老成更事之人，福康安年輕，未能歷練，以致敏中聲勢略張。究之亦止侍直承旨，不特非前朝嚴嵩可比，並不能如康熙年間明珠、徐乾學、高士奇等；即寵眷亦尚不及鄂爾泰、張廷玉，安能於朕前竊弄威福、淆亂是非耶？朕因其宣力年久，身故仍加恩飾終，准入賢良祠。迨四十六年甘肅捐監折收之事敗露，王亶望等侵欺貪黷，罪不容誅。因憶此事前經舒赫德奏請停止，於敏中於朕前力言甘肅捐監應開，部中免撥解之煩，閭閻有糶販之利，一舉兩得，是以準行。詎知勒爾謹為王亶望所愚，通同一氣，肥橐殃民。非於敏中為之主持，勒爾謹豈敢遽行奏請？王亶望豈敢肆無忌憚？於敏中擁有厚貲，必出王亶望等賄求酬謝。使於敏中尚在，朕必嚴加懲治。今不將其子孫治罪，已為從寬；賢良祠為國家風勵有位盛典，豈可以不慎廉隅之人濫行列入？朕久有此心，因覽嚴嵩傳，觸動鑑戒。恐無知之人，將以明世宗比朕，朕不受也。於敏中著撤出賢良祠，以昭儆戒。」六十年，國史館進呈敏中列傳，詔曰：「於敏中簡任綸扉，不自檢束，既向宦寺交接，復與外省官吏夤緣舞弊。即此二節，實屬辜恩，非大臣所應有。若仍令濫邀世職，何以示懲？其孫於德裕現官直隸知府，已屬格外恩施，所襲輕車都尉世職即撤革，以為大臣營私玷職者戒。

manualTranslations.zh: 于敏中和珅弟和琳蘇凌阿。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Minzhong, He Shen, younger brother He Lin, Su Linga.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Minzhong; He Shen; his younger brother He Lin; and Su Linga.

manualTranslations.zh: 于敏中，字叔子，江蘇金壇人。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Minzhong, style name Shuzi, was a native of Jintan in Jiangsu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Minzhong, whose style name was Shuzi, was a native of Jintan in Jiangsu.

manualTranslations.zh: 乾隆三年一甲一名進士，授翰林院修撰。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Qianlong he passed the palace examination as first in the first rank and was appointed Hanlin compiler.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 3 he placed first in the palace examination and was appointed a Hanlin compiler.

manualTranslations.zh: 以文翰受高宗知，直懋勤殿，敕書華嚴、楞嚴兩經。
manualTranslations.literal: Through his literary skill he won the Gaozong Emperor's notice, served duty at the Maojin Hall, and was ordered to copy the Avatamsaka and Surangama Sutras.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His literary ability won the Gaozong Emperor's notice; he served at the Maojin Hall and was ordered to copy the Avatamsaka and Surangama Sutras.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷侍講，典山西鄉試，督山東、浙江學政。
manualTranslations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to reader-in-waiting, presided over the Shanxi provincial examination, and served as educational commissioner of Shandong and Zhejiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He rose to reader-in-waiting, presided over the Shanxi provincial examination, and served as educational commissioner of Shandong and Zhejiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 十五年，直上書房。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifteenth year he entered the Upper Study.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was assigned to the Upper Study.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷內閣學士。
manualTranslations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Grand Secretariat bachelor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Grand Secretariat bachelor.

manualTranslations.zh: 十八年，复督山東學政。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighteenth year he again served as educational commissioner of Shandong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he again served as educational commissioner of Shandong.

manualTranslations.zh: 擢兵部侍郎。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to vice minister of War.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice minister of War.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十一年，丁本生父憂，歸宗持服。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-first year he mourned the death of his biological father and returned to his clan to observe mourning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he mourned his biological father's death and returned to his clan to observe mourning.

manualTranslations.zh: 逾年，起署刑部侍郎。
manualTranslations.literal: After a year he was recalled to serve in an acting capacity as vice minister of Punishments.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After a year he was recalled to serve as acting vice minister of Punishments.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十三年，嗣父枋歿，回籍治喪。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-third year his adoptive father Fang died, and he returned home to manage the funeral.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year his adoptive father Fang died, and he returned home to manage the funeral.

manualTranslations.zh: 未幾，丁本生母憂，未以上聞。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long he mourned the death of his biological mother but did not report it to the throne.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before long he mourned his biological mother's death but did not report it to the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 御史朱嵇疏劾敏中「兩次親喪，蒙混為一，恝然赴官」。
manualTranslations.literal: Censor Zhu Ji memorialized impeaching Minzhong: "Having twice suffered parental bereavement, he conflated the two cases and callously took office."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Censor Zhu Ji memorialized to impeach Minzhong, saying, "Having twice suffered parental bereavement, he conflated the two cases and callously took office."

manualTranslations.zh: 並言：「部臣與疆臣異，不宜奪情任事。」
manualTranslations.literal: He also said: "Ministers at court differ from frontier officials; it is improper to set aside mourning and take office."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also said, "Ministers at court differ from frontier officials; it is improper to set aside mourning and take office."

manualTranslations.zh: 詔原之。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict pardoned him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned him.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋實授。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he received formal appointment.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He soon received formal appointment.

manualTranslations.zh: 調戶部，管錢法堂事。
manualTranslations.literal: He was transferred to Revenue and managed affairs of the Money Standards Office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Board of Revenue and managed affairs of the Money Standards Office.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十五年，命為軍機大臣。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed a Grand Councilor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed a Grand Councilor.

manualTranslations.zh: 敏中敏捷過人，承旨得上意。
manualTranslations.literal: Minzhong was exceptionally quick-witted and, in drafting edicts, won the emperor's approval.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Minzhong was exceptionally quick-witted and, in drafting edicts, won the emperor's approval.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十年，擢戶部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirtieth year he was promoted to minister of Revenue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he was promoted to minister of Revenue.

manualTranslations.zh: 子齊賢，鄉試未中式。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Qixian failed to pass the provincial examination.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Qixian failed to pass the provincial examination.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔以敏中久直內廷，僅一子年已及壯，加恩依尚書品級予廕生。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict stated that because Minzhong had long served in the inner court and had only one son already grown, grace was granted to award him a yinsheng privilege according to a minister's rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict stated that because Minzhong had long served in the inner court and had only one grown son, he was granted the privilege of yinsheng appointment according to a minister's rank.

manualTranslations.zh: 又以敏中正室前卒，特封其妾張為淑人。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Minzhong's principal wife had died earlier, his concubine Zhang was specially ennobled as Lady Shuren.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Minzhong's principal wife had died earlier, his concubine Zhang was specially ennobled as Lady Shuren.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十三年，加太子太保。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was given the additional title of Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year he was given the additional title of Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十六年，協辦大學士。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he became associate grand secretary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year he became associate grand secretary.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十八年，晉文華殿大學士，兼戶部尚書如故。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year he was advanced to grand secretary of the Wenhua Hall while continuing as minister of Revenue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year he was advanced to grand secretary of the Wenhua Hall while continuing as minister of Revenue.

manualTranslations.zh: 時下詔徵遺書，安徽學政朱筠請開局搜輯永樂大典中古書。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time an edict called for collecting lost books; Zhu Yun, educational commissioner of Anhui, requested that a bureau be opened to search out and compile ancient books from the Yongle Encyclopedia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time an edict called for collecting lost books; Zhu Yun, educational commissioner of Anhui, requested that a bureau be opened to search out and compile ancient books from the Yongle Encyclopedia.

manualTranslations.zh: 大學士劉統勳謂非政要，欲寢其議。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Secretary Liu Tongxun said it was not a matter of governmental priority and wished to shelve the proposal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Liu Tongxun said it was not a governmental priority and wished to shelve the proposal.

manualTranslations.zh: 敏中善筠奏，與統勳力爭，於是特開四庫全書館，命敏中為正總裁，主其事。
manualTranslations.literal: Minzhong approved Zhu Yun's memorial and argued strenuously with Tongxun; thereupon the Siku Quanshu Bureau was specially opened, and Minzhong was appointed chief director to preside over the project.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Minzhong approved Zhu Yun's memorial and argued strenuously with Tongxun; the Siku Quanshu Bureau was then specially opened, and Minzhong was appointed chief director to preside over the project.

manualTranslations.zh: 又充國史館、三通館正總裁。
manualTranslations.literal: He also served as chief director of the State Historiography Bureau and the Santong Bureau.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also served as chief director of the State Historiography Bureau and the Santong Bureau.

manualTranslations.zh: 屢典會試，命為上書房總師傅，兼翰林院掌院學士。
manualTranslations.literal: He repeatedly presided over the metropolitan examination and was appointed chief tutor of the Upper Study, while also serving as chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He repeatedly presided over the metropolitan examination and was appointed chief tutor of the Upper Study, while also serving as chancellor of the Hanlin Academy.

manualTranslations.zh: 敏中為軍機大臣久，頗接外吏，通聲氣。
manualTranslations.literal: Minzhong had long been a Grand Councilor and frequently received outside officials, maintaining channels of communication.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Minzhong had long been a Grand Councilor and frequently received outside officials, maintaining channels of communication.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十九年，內監高雲從漏洩硃批道府記載，下廷臣鞫治。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year the eunuch Gao Yuncong leaked vermilion-annotated records of prefectural and circuit appointments, and court ministers were ordered to investigate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year the eunuch Gao Yuncong leaked vermilion-annotated records of prefectural and circuit appointments, and court ministers were ordered to investigate.

manualTranslations.zh: 雲從言敏中嘗向詢問記載，及雲從買地涉訟，嘗乞敏中囑託府尹蔣賜棨。
manualTranslations.literal: Yuncong said Minzhong had once asked him about the records, and that when Yuncong became involved in a lawsuit over land purchase he had begged Minzhong to entreat the prefect Jiang Ciji on his behalf.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuncong said Minzhong had once asked him about the records, and that when Yuncong became involved in a lawsuit over a land purchase he had begged Minzhong to entreat Prefect Jiang Ciji on his behalf.

manualTranslations.zh: 上面詰，敏中引罪，詔切責之曰：「內廷諸臣與內監交涉，一言及私，即當據實奏聞。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor questioned him in person; Minzhong confessed guilt, and an edict sternly rebuked him, saying: "When inner-court ministers deal with eunuchs, if a single word touches private affairs, they must report it truthfully to the throne.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor questioned him in person; Minzhong confessed guilt, and an edict sternly rebuked him, saying, "When inner-court ministers deal with eunuchs, if a single word touches private affairs, they must report it truthfully to the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕方嘉其持正，重治若輩之罪，豈肯轉咎奏參者？
manualTranslations.literal: I would praise such uprightness and severely punish those offenders—how could I turn and blame the one who memorialized?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I would praise such uprightness and severely punish those offenders—how could I turn and blame the one who memorialized?

manualTranslations.zh: 於敏中侍朕左右有年，豈尚不知朕而為此隱忍耶？
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Minzhong has attended at my side for years—can he still not know me and yet practice such concealment?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Minzhong has attended at my side for years—can he still not know me and yet practice such concealment?

manualTranslations.zh: 於敏中日蒙召對，朕何所不言？
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Minzhong is summoned to audience daily—what do I not speak of?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Minzhong is summoned to audience daily—what do I not speak of?

manualTranslations.zh: 何至轉向內監探詢消息？
manualTranslations.literal: Why turn instead to eunuchs to probe for news?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Why turn instead to eunuchs to probe for news?

manualTranslations.zh: 自川省用兵以來，敏中承旨有勞。
manualTranslations.literal: Since military operations began in Sichuan, Minzhong has had merit in drafting edicts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Since military operations began in Sichuan, Minzhong has had merit in drafting edicts.

manualTranslations.zh: 大功告竣，朕欲如張廷玉例，領以世職。
manualTranslations.literal: With the great achievement completed, I intended, following the precedent of Zhang Tingyu, to grant him a hereditary office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With the great achievement completed, I intended, following the precedent of Zhang Tingyu, to grant him a hereditary office.

manualTranslations.zh: 今事垂成，敏中乃有此事，是其福澤有限，不能受朕深恩，寧不痛自愧悔？
manualTranslations.literal: Now, just as the matter neared completion, Minzhong has done this—his blessings are limited and he cannot receive my deep grace; should he not bitterly repent?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Now, just as the matter neared completion, Minzhong has done this—his blessings are limited and he cannot receive my deep grace; should he not bitterly repent?

manualTranslations.zh: 免其治罪，嚴加議處。」
manualTranslations.literal: He is exempted from criminal punishment but is to be severely dealt with by deliberation."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He is exempted from criminal punishment but is to be severely dealt with by deliberation."

manualTranslations.zh: 部議革職，詔從寬留任。
manualTranslations.literal: The ministry deliberated dismissal from office, but an edict leniently allowed him to remain in post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated dismissal from office, but an edict leniently allowed him to remain in post.

manualTranslations.zh: 四十一年，金川平，詔嘉其勞勚，過失可原，仍列功臣，給一等輕車都尉，世襲罔替。
manualTranslations.literal: In the forty-first year, when Jinchuan was pacified, an edict praised his labor and toil, held his faults forgivable, still listed him among meritorious officials, and granted a first-rank Light Chariot Commandant, hereditary in perpetuity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year, when Jinchuan was pacified, an edict praised his labor, held his faults forgivable, still listed him among meritorious officials, and granted a first-rank Light Chariot Commandant, hereditary in perpetuity.

manualTranslations.zh: 四十四年，病喘，遣醫視，賜人蓡。
manualTranslations.literal: In the forty-fourth year he fell ill with asthma; physicians were sent to attend him and ginseng was bestowed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year he fell ill with asthma; physicians were sent to attend him and ginseng was bestowed.

manualTranslations.zh: 卒，優詔賜卹，祭葬如例，祀賢良祠，諡文襄。
manualTranslations.literal: He died; a favorable edict granted condolence payments, sacrifices and burial followed precedent, he was enshrined in the Shrine of Worthies, and was given the posthumous title Wenxiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died; a favorable edict granted condolence payments, sacrifices and burial followed precedent, he was enshrined in the Shrine of Worthies, and was given the posthumous title Wenxiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 子齊賢，前卒。
manualTranslations.literal: His son Qixian had died earlier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His son Qixian had died earlier.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫德裕，襲世職，以主事用。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandson Deyu inherited the hereditary office and was employed as a secretary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandson Deyu inherited the hereditary office and was employed as a secretary.

manualTranslations.zh: 敏中從侄時和，擁其貲回籍，德裕訟之。
manualTranslations.literal: Minzhong's younger cousin's son Shihe seized his wealth and returned home; Deyu sued him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Minzhong's younger cousin's son Shihe seized his wealth and returned home; Deyu sued him.

manualTranslations.zh: 江蘇巡撫吳壇察治，罪時和，戍伊犁。
manualTranslations.literal: Jiangsu governor Wu Tan investigated and punished Shihe, banishing him to Yili.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jiangsu Governor Wu Tan investigated and punished Shihe, banishing him to Yili.

manualTranslations.zh: 所侵奪者，還德裕三萬兩，馀充金壇開河用。
manualTranslations.literal: What had been seized was returned to Deyu in the amount of thirty thousand taels; the remainder was used for river works at Jintan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What had been seized was returned to Deyu in the amount of thirty thousand taels; the remainder was used for river works at Jintan.

manualTranslations.zh: 蘇松糧道章攀桂為敏中營造花園，事覺，褫攀桂職。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang Pan'gui, grain intendant of Su-Song, built a garden for Minzhong; when the matter came to light, Pan'gui was stripped of office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Pan'gui, grain intendant of Su-Song, built a garden for Minzhong; when the matter came to light, Pan'gui was stripped of office.

manualTranslations.zh: 敏中受地方官逢迎，以已卒置不論。
manualTranslations.literal: Minzhong had accepted the flattery of local officials; because he was already dead, the matter was set aside.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Minzhong had accepted the flattery of local officials; because he was already dead, the matter was set aside.

manualTranslations.zh: 既而浙江巡撫王亶望以貪敗，上追咎敏中。
manualTranslations.literal: Later Zhejiang governor Wang Tanwang was ruined by corruption, and the emperor traced blame back to Minzhong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Zhejiang Governor Wang Tanwang was ruined by corruption, and the emperor traced blame back to Minzhong.

manualTranslations.zh: 五十一年，詔曰：「朕幾馀詠物，有嘉靖年間器皿，念及嚴嵩專權煬蔽，以致國是日非，朝多稗政。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifty-first year an edict said: "While at leisure composing poems on objects, I came upon vessels from the Jiajing reign and thought of Yan Song's monopoly of power and concealment of truth, which caused the affairs of state daily to go astray and the court to abound in harmful policies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifty-first year an edict said, "While at leisure composing poems on objects, I came upon vessels from the Jiajing reign and thought of Yan Song's monopoly of power and concealment of truth, which caused the affairs of state daily to go astray and the court to abound in harmful policies.

manualTranslations.zh: 取閱嚴嵩傳，見其賄賂公行，生死予奪，潛竊威柄，實為前明奸佞之尤。
manualTranslations.literal: I took up and read the biography of Yan Song and saw how bribery was openly practiced, life and death were arbitrarily dispensed, and authority was secretly usurped—he was truly the worst villain of the former Ming.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I took up and read the biography of Yan Song and saw how bribery was openly practiced, life and death were arbitrarily dispensed, and authority was secretly usurped—he was truly the worst villain of the former Ming.

manualTranslations.zh: 本朝家法相承，紀綱整肅，太阿從不下移，本無大臣專權之事。
manualTranslations.literal: Our dynasty's household laws have been handed down in succession, discipline is strict, and the sword of authority has never shifted downward—there is fundamentally no matter of ministers monopolizing power.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Our dynasty's household laws have been handed down in succession, discipline is strict, and the sword of authority has never shifted downward—there is fundamentally no matter of ministers monopolizing power.

manualTranslations.zh: 原任大學士於敏中因任用日久，恩眷稍優。
manualTranslations.literal: The former grand secretary Yu Minzhong, because he had long been in office, enjoyed somewhat greater imperial favor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The former grand secretary Yu Minzhong, because he had long been in office, enjoyed somewhat greater imperial favor.

manualTranslations.zh: 無識之徒，心存依附，敏中亦遂時相招引，潛受苞苴。
manualTranslations.literal: Men without judgment sought to attach themselves, and Minzhong in turn occasionally drew them in and secretly accepted gifts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Men without judgment sought to attach themselves, and Minzhong in turn occasionally drew them in and secretly accepted gifts.

manualTranslations.zh: 其時軍機大臣中無老成更事之人，福康安年輕，未能歷練，以致敏中聲勢略張。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time among the Grand Councilors there was no seasoned and experienced man; Fukang'an was young and had not yet been tempered by experience, so Minzhong's influence expanded somewhat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time among the Grand Councilors there was no seasoned and experienced man; Fukang'an was young and had not yet been tempered by experience, so Minzhong's influence expanded somewhat.

manualTranslations.zh: 究之亦止侍直承旨，不特非前朝嚴嵩可比，並不能如康熙年間明珠、徐乾學、高士奇等；
manualTranslations.literal: In the end he only attended duty and drafted edicts; he was not only incomparable to Yan Song of the previous dynasty, but also could not match such men as Nalan Mingzhu, Xu Qianxue, and Gao Shiqi in the Kangxi reign;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the end he only attended duty and drafted edicts; he was not only incomparable to Yan Song of the previous dynasty, but also could not match such men as Nalan Mingzhu, Xu Qianxue, and Gao Shiqi in the Kangxi reign;

manualTranslations.zh: 即寵眷亦尚不及鄂爾泰、張廷玉，安能於朕前竊弄威福、淆亂是非耶？
manualTranslations.literal: even his favor still fell short of Oertai and Zhang Tingyu—how could he secretly wield authority and confuse right and wrong before me?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: even his favor still fell short of Oertai and Zhang Tingyu—how could he secretly wield authority and confuse right and wrong before me?

manualTranslations.zh: 朕因其宣力年久，身故仍加恩飾終，准入賢良祠。
manualTranslations.literal: Because he had long served with effort, after his death I still bestowed grace in honoring his end and allowed him entry into the Shrine of Worthies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because he had long served with effort, after his death I still bestowed grace in honoring his end and allowed him entry into the Shrine of Worthies.

manualTranslations.zh: 迨四十六年甘肅捐監折收之事敗露，王亶望等侵欺貪黷，罪不容誅。
manualTranslations.literal: When in the forty-sixth year the Gansu practice of selling supervisory student status and collecting grain in lieu of silver was exposed, Wang Tanwang and others were guilty of embezzlement and corruption beyond what execution could expiate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When in the forty-sixth year the Gansu practice of selling supervisory student status and collecting grain in lieu of silver was exposed, Wang Tanwang and others were guilty of embezzlement and corruption beyond what execution could expiate.

manualTranslations.zh: 因憶此事前經舒赫德奏請停止，於敏中於朕前力言甘肅捐監應開，部中免撥解之煩，閭閻有糶販之利，一舉兩得，是以準行。
manualTranslations.literal: Recalling that this matter had earlier been memorialized by Shuhede requesting its cessation, Yu Minzhong had strongly urged before me that Gansu sales of supervisory student status should be opened, sparing the ministry the trouble of forwarding grain and giving common people the profit of selling grain—two gains at once—and therefore it was approved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recalling that Shuhede had earlier memorialized requesting its cessation, Yu Minzhong had strongly urged before me that Gansu sales of supervisory student status should be opened, sparing the ministry the trouble of forwarding grain and giving common people the profit of selling grain—two gains at once—and therefore it was approved.

manualTranslations.zh: 詎知勒爾謹為王亶望所愚，通同一氣，肥橐殃民。
manualTranslations.literal: Who knew that Le'erjin would be deceived by Wang Tanwang, act in collusion, fatten their purses, and harm the people?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Who knew that Le'erjin would be deceived by Wang Tanwang, act in collusion, fatten their purses, and harm the people?

manualTranslations.zh: 非於敏中為之主持，勒爾謹豈敢遽行奏請？
manualTranslations.literal: Had Yu Minzhong not backed it, how would Le'erjin have dared to memorialize so hastily?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Had Yu Minzhong not backed it, how would Le'erjin have dared to memorialize so hastily?

manualTranslations.zh: 王亶望豈敢肆無忌憚？
manualTranslations.literal: How would Wang Tanwang have dared to act so brazenly?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: How would Wang Tanwang have dared to act so brazenly?

manualTranslations.zh: 於敏中擁有厚貲，必出王亶望等賄求酬謝。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Minzhong's possession of great wealth must have come from bribes and rewards sought by Wang Tanwang and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Minzhong's possession of great wealth must have come from bribes and rewards sought by Wang Tanwang and others.

manualTranslations.zh: 使於敏中尚在，朕必嚴加懲治。
manualTranslations.literal: Had Yu Minzhong still been alive, I would certainly have punished him severely.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Had Yu Minzhong still been alive, I would certainly have punished him severely.

manualTranslations.zh: 今不將其子孫治罪，已為從寬；
manualTranslations.literal: That I do not now punish his descendants is already leniency;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That I do not now punish his descendants is already leniency;

manualTranslations.zh: 賢良祠為國家風勵有位盛典，豈可以不慎廉隅之人濫行列入？
manualTranslations.literal: the Shrine of Worthies is a great state ceremony for encouraging those in office—how can men who do not guard their integrity be recklessly listed therein?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the Shrine of Worthies is a great state ceremony for encouraging those in office—how can men who do not guard their integrity be recklessly listed therein?

manualTranslations.zh: 朕久有此心，因覽嚴嵩傳，觸動鑑戒。
manualTranslations.literal: I have long had this thought; reading the biography of Yan Song stirred my sense of warning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I have long had this thought; reading the biography of Yan Song stirred my sense of warning.

manualTranslations.zh: 恐無知之人，將以明世宗比朕，朕不受也。
manualTranslations.literal: I fear ignorant men may compare me to the Jiajing Emperor of the Ming—I do not accept that.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I fear ignorant men may compare me to the Jiajing Emperor of the Ming—I do not accept that.

manualTranslations.zh: 於敏中著撤出賢良祠，以昭儆戒。」
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Minzhong is to be removed from the Shrine of Worthies, to serve as a warning."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Minzhong is to be removed from the Shrine of Worthies, to serve as a warning."

manualTranslations.zh: 六十年，國史館進呈敏中列傳，詔曰：「於敏中簡任綸扉，不自檢束，既向宦寺交接，復與外省官吏夤緣舞弊。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixtieth year the State Historiography Bureau submitted Minzhong's biography; an edict said: "Yu Minzhong was simply appointed to the Grand Secretariat but did not restrain himself; he not only associated with eunuchs but also colluded in corruption with officials from outside provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year the State Historiography Bureau submitted Minzhong's biography; an edict said, "Yu Minzhong was simply appointed to the Grand Secretariat but did not restrain himself; he not only associated with eunuchs but also colluded in corruption with officials from outside provinces.

manualTranslations.zh: 即此二節，實屬辜恩，非大臣所應有。
manualTranslations.literal: These two points alone truly betrayed grace and are not what a great minister should do.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: These two points alone truly betrayed grace and are not what a great minister should do.

manualTranslations.zh: 若仍令濫邀世職，何以示懲？
manualTranslations.literal: If he were still allowed to claim a hereditary office in vain, how would punishment be shown?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If he were still allowed to claim a hereditary office in vain, how would punishment be shown?

manualTranslations.zh: 其孫於德裕現官直隸知府，已屬格外恩施，所襲輕車都尉世職即撤革，以為大臣營私玷職者戒。
manualTranslations.literal: His grandson Yu Deyu now serves as prefect of Zhili, which is already extraordinary grace; the inherited Light Chariot Commandant hereditary office is forthwith revoked, as a warning to great ministers who pursue private gain and stain their office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His grandson Yu Deyu now serves as prefect of Zhili, which is already extraordinary grace; the inherited Light Chariot Commandant hereditary office is forthwith revoked, as a warning to great ministers who pursue private gain and stain their office.

items.acceptedSourceText: 于敏中和珅弟和琳蘇凌阿。于敏中，字叔子，江蘇金壇人。乾隆三年一甲一名進士，授翰林院修撰。以文翰受高宗知，直懋勤殿，敕書華嚴、楞嚴兩經。累遷侍講，典山西鄉試，督山東、浙江學政。十五年，直上書房。累遷內閣學士。十八年，复督山東學政。擢兵部侍郎。二十一年，丁本生父憂，歸宗持服。逾年，起署刑部侍郎。二十三年，嗣父枋歿，回籍治喪。未幾，丁本生母憂，未以上聞。御史朱嵇疏劾敏中「兩次親喪，蒙混為一，恝然赴官」。並言：「部臣與疆臣異，不宜奪情任事。」詔原之。尋實授。調戶部，管錢法堂事。二十五年，命為軍機大臣。敏中敏捷過人，承旨得上意。三十年，擢戶部尚書。子齊賢，鄉試未中式。詔以敏中久直內廷，僅一子年已及壯，加恩依尚書品級予廕生。又以敏中正室前卒，特封其妾張為淑人。三十三年，加太子太保。三十六年，協辦大學士。三十八年，晉文華殿大學士，兼戶部尚書如故。時下詔徵遺書，安徽學政朱筠請開局搜輯永樂大典中古書。大學士劉統勳謂非政要，欲寢其議。敏中善筠奏，與統勳力爭，於是特開四庫全書館，命敏中為正總裁，主其事。又充國史館、三通館正總裁。屢典會試，命為上書房總師傅，兼翰林院掌院學士。敏中為軍機大臣久，頗接外吏，通聲氣。三十九年，內監高雲從漏洩硃批道府記載，下廷臣鞫治。雲從言敏中嘗向詢問記載，及雲從買地涉訟，嘗乞敏中囑託府尹蔣賜棨。上面詰，敏中引罪，詔切責之曰：「內廷諸臣與內監交涉，一言及私，即當據實奏聞。朕方嘉其持正，重治若輩之罪，豈肯轉咎奏參者？於敏中侍朕左右有年，豈尚不知朕而為此隱忍耶？於敏中日蒙召對，朕何所不言？何至轉向內監探詢消息？自川省用兵以來，敏中承旨有勞。大功告竣，朕欲如張廷玉例，領以世職。今事垂成，敏中乃有此事，是其福澤有限，不能受朕深恩，寧不痛自愧悔？免其治罪，嚴加議處。」部議革職，詔從寬留任。四十一年，金川平，詔嘉其勞勚，過失可原，仍列功臣，給一等輕車都尉，世襲罔替。四十四年，病喘，遣醫視，賜人蓡。卒，優詔賜卹，祭葬如例，祀賢良祠，諡文襄。子齊賢，前卒。孫德裕，襲世職，以主事用。敏中從侄時和，擁其貲回籍，德裕訟之。江蘇巡撫吳壇察治，罪時和，戍伊犁。所侵奪者，還德裕三萬兩，馀充金壇開河用。蘇松糧道章攀桂為敏中營造花園，事覺，褫攀桂職。敏中受地方官逢迎，以已卒置不論。既而浙江巡撫王亶望以貪敗，上追咎敏中。五十一年，詔曰：「朕幾馀詠物，有嘉靖年間器皿，念及嚴嵩專權煬蔽，以致國是日非，朝多稗政。取閱嚴嵩傳，見其賄賂公行，生死予奪，潛竊威柄，實為前明奸佞之尤。本朝家法相承，紀綱整肅，太阿從不下移，本無大臣專權之事。原任大學士於敏中因任用日久，恩眷稍優。無識之徒，心存依附，敏中亦遂時相招引，潛受苞苴。其時軍機大臣中無老成更事之人，福康安年輕，未能歷練，以致敏中聲勢略張。究之亦止侍直承旨，不特非前朝嚴嵩可比，並不能如康熙年間明珠、徐乾學、高士奇等；即寵眷亦尚不及鄂爾泰、張廷玉，安能於朕前竊弄威福、淆亂是非耶？朕因其宣力年久，身故仍加恩飾終，准入賢良祠。迨四十六年甘肅捐監折收之事敗露，王亶望等侵欺貪黷，罪不容誅。因憶此事前經舒赫德奏請停止，於敏中於朕前力言甘肅捐監應開，部中免撥解之煩，閭閻有糶販之利，一舉兩得，是以準行。詎知勒爾謹為王亶望所愚，通同一氣，肥橐殃民。非於敏中為之主持，勒爾謹豈敢遽行奏請？王亶望豈敢肆無忌憚？於敏中擁有厚貲，必出王亶望等賄求酬謝。使於敏中尚在，朕必嚴加懲治。今不將其子孫治罪，已為從寬；賢良祠為國家風勵有位盛典，豈可以不慎廉隅之人濫行列入？朕久有此心，因覽嚴嵩傳，觸動鑑戒。恐無知之人，將以明世宗比朕，朕不受也。於敏中著撤出賢良祠，以昭儆戒。」六十年，國史館進呈敏中列傳，詔曰：「於敏中簡任綸扉，不自檢束，既向宦寺交接，復與外省官吏夤緣舞弊。即此二節，實屬辜恩，非大臣所應有。若仍令濫邀世職，何以示懲？其孫於德裕現官直隸知府，已屬格外恩施，所襲輕車都尉世職即撤革，以為大臣營私玷職者戒。

sourceRange.text: 嘉慶四年，擢廣西巡撫。上疏，略曰：「各省倉庫積弊有三變。始則大吏貪婪者利州縣之餽賂，僨事者資州縣之攤賠。州縣匿其私橐，以公帑應之，離任則虧空累累。大吏既餌其資助，不得不抑勒後任接收。此虧空之緣起也。繼則大吏庸闇者任其欺矇，姑息者又懼興大獄，以敢接虧空為能員，以禀揭虧空為多事。州縣且有藉多虧挾制上司升遷美缺者。此虧空之濫觴也。近年不職督撫相繼敗露，諸大吏共相濯磨，州縣亦爭先彌補。但彌補之法，寬則生玩，胥吏因緣為奸；急則張皇，百姓先受其累。各省貧富不同，難易迥別，一法立即一弊生，惟在因地制宜。率定章程，又多窒礙。請飭下各省先查實虧之數、原虧之人，如律論治。其無著者，詳記檔案，使猾吏無可影射。多分年限，使後任量力補苴，不必展轉株求，亦不必程功旦夕。責成督撫裁陋規以清其源，倡節儉以絕其流，講求愛民之術以培元氣，獎擢清廉之員以勵官常。日計不足，月計有餘。不數年間，休養生息，不徒倉庫充盈，吏治民生亦蒸蒸日上。廣西自孫士毅經營安南，軍需供億，所費不貲，米銀裝械，毀棄關外，令州縣分賠，遂致通省皆虧。本非州縣侵蝕，且人已去任，接收者正在補苴，一經參追，難保不勸捐派累。惟率司、道、府、州省衣節食，革去一切陋規，俾州縣從容彌補，進廉去貪，無累百姓，計三年之內，庫項必可補足。惟是數十人補之而不足，一二人敗之而有餘。是又在知人善任，大法小廉，不愛逢迎，不存姑息，庶不致後有續虧之患。」又言：「彌補虧空，初不為一身免累之計，乃有實際。臣前歷山西、浙江，皆未諮部，亦未諮追原籍。蓋當日之員，大半死亡遣戍，子孫貧乏者多，諮追徒滋紛擾，如數完繳者實無二三，現任反置身事外。廣西庫項未完者三十九州縣，覈其廉數多寡，分限三年，按月交庫，於交代時有不足者，即以虧空論劾。」疏入，仁宗嘉納焉。時詔買補倉穀，取諸豐稔鄰縣，禁於本境採買。啟昆言廣西跬步皆山，轉運不減於穀價，恐不肖者因採買之難，或為勒派，請仍聽本境買補便，詔如所議。

manualTranslations.zh: 嘉慶四年，擢廣西巡撫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he was promoted to Guangxi governor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jiaqing he was promoted to governor of Guangxi.

manualTranslations.zh: 上疏，略曰：「各省倉庫積弊有三變。
manualTranslations.literal: He memorialized, saying in summary: "The accumulated abuses of provincial treasuries have three stages of change.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He memorialized, saying in summary: "The accumulated abuses of provincial treasuries have three stages of change.

manualTranslations.zh: 始則大吏貪婪者利州縣之餽賂，僨事者資州縣之攤賠。
manualTranslations.literal: At first greedy high officials profited from prefectural and county bribes, while those who had run up debts drew on prefectures and counties for shared indemnities.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first greedy high officials profited from prefectural and county bribes, while those who had run up debts drew on prefectures and counties for shared indemnities.

manualTranslations.zh: 州縣匿其私橐，以公帑應之，離任則虧空累累。
manualTranslations.literal: Prefectures and counties hid their private purses and met obligations from public funds; on leaving office deficits piled up.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties hid their private funds and met obligations from public treasuries; on leaving office deficits piled up.

manualTranslations.zh: 大吏既餌其資助，不得不抑勒後任接收。
manualTranslations.literal: Once high officials had taken their subsidies, they had no choice but to pressure successors into accepting the deficits.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once high officials had taken their subsidies, they had no choice but to pressure successors into accepting the deficits.

manualTranslations.zh: 此虧空之緣起也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is how deficits arose.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is how deficits arose.

manualTranslations.zh: 繼則大吏庸闇者任其欺矇，姑息者又懼興大獄，以敢接虧空為能員，以禀揭虧空為多事。
manualTranslations.literal: Next, mediocre and obtuse high officials let themselves be deceived, while indulgent ones feared stirring up major cases, treating willingness to accept deficits as competence and memorials exposing deficits as meddling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Next, mediocre and obtuse high officials let themselves be deceived, while indulgent ones feared stirring up major cases, treating willingness to accept deficits as competence and memorials exposing deficits as meddling.

manualTranslations.zh: 州縣且有藉多虧挾制上司升遷美缺者。
manualTranslations.literal: Prefectures and counties even used large deficits to coerce superiors into granting promotion to prized posts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties even used large deficits to coerce superiors into granting promotion to prized posts.

manualTranslations.zh: 此虧空之濫觴也。
manualTranslations.literal: This is how deficits spread unchecked.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This is how deficits spread unchecked.

manualTranslations.zh: 近年不職督撫相繼敗露，諸大吏共相濯磨，州縣亦爭先彌補。
manualTranslations.literal: In recent years incompetent governors-general and governors have been exposed one after another; the high officials have all polished one another, and prefectures and counties have also rushed to make deficits good.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In recent years incompetent governors-general and governors have been exposed one after another; the high officials have all covered for one another, and prefectures and counties have also rushed to make deficits good.

manualTranslations.zh: 但彌補之法，寬則生玩，胥吏因緣為奸；
manualTranslations.literal: But in methods of making deficits good, leniency breeds laxity and clerks seize the chance for corruption;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But in methods of making deficits good, leniency breeds laxity and clerks seize the chance for corruption;

manualTranslations.zh: 急則張皇，百姓先受其累。
manualTranslations.literal: haste breeds alarm, and the common people suffer first.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: haste breeds alarm, and the common people suffer first.

manualTranslations.zh: 各省貧富不同，難易迥別，一法立即一弊生，惟在因地制宜。
manualTranslations.literal: The provinces differ in wealth and poverty and in ease and difficulty; one rule applied at once produces one new abuse—the only course is to suit measures to local conditions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The provinces differ in wealth and poverty and in ease and difficulty; one rule applied at once produces one new abuse—the only course is to suit measures to local conditions.

manualTranslations.zh: 率定章程，又多窒礙。
manualTranslations.literal: To impose uniform regulations is again full of obstacles.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To impose uniform regulations is again full of obstacles.

manualTranslations.zh: 請飭下各省先查實虧之數、原虧之人，如律論治。
manualTranslations.literal: I ask that orders be sent to every province first to verify the amount of actual deficits and the persons originally responsible, and to punish them according to law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I ask that orders be sent to every province first to verify the amount of actual deficits and the persons originally responsible, and to punish them according to law.

manualTranslations.zh: 其無著者，詳記檔案，使猾吏無可影射。
manualTranslations.literal: Where there is no one to hold accountable, let it be recorded in detail in the files so that crafty clerks have nothing to exploit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Where there is no one to hold accountable, let it be recorded in detail in the files so that crafty clerks have nothing to exploit.

manualTranslations.zh: 多分年限，使後任量力補苴，不必展轉株求，亦不必程功旦夕。
manualTranslations.literal: Spread repayment over more years, letting successors make good deficits according to their capacity, without endless pursuit through successive offices and without demanding completion overnight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Spread repayment over more years, letting successors make good deficits according to their capacity, without endless pursuit through successive offices and without demanding completion overnight.

manualTranslations.zh: 責成督撫裁陋規以清其源，倡節儉以絕其流，講求愛民之術以培元氣，獎擢清廉之員以勵官常。
manualTranslations.literal: Hold governors-general and governors responsible for cutting abusive customs to clear the source, promote frugality to stop the flow, seek methods that cherish the people to nurture vital strength, and reward and promote incorrupt officials to uphold official norms.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hold governors-general and governors responsible for cutting abusive customs to clear the source, promote frugality to stop the flow, seek methods that cherish the people to nurture vital strength, and reward and promote incorrupt officials to uphold official norms.

manualTranslations.zh: 日計不足，月計有餘。
manualTranslations.literal: Day by day the account falls short; month by month it comes out ahead.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Day by day the account falls short; month by month it comes out ahead.

manualTranslations.zh: 不數年間，休養生息，不徒倉庫充盈，吏治民生亦蒸蒸日上。
manualTranslations.literal: Within a few years, through rest and recovery, not only will the treasuries be full, but official governance and the people's livelihood will also rise steadily.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Within a few years, through rest and recovery, not only will the treasuries be full, but official governance and the people's livelihood will also rise steadily.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣西自孫士毅經營安南，軍需供億，所費不貲，米銀裝械，毀棄關外，令州縣分賠，遂致通省皆虧。
manualTranslations.literal: Guangxi, since Sun Shiyi managed Annam, had military supplies in vast quantities at enormous cost; grain, silver, and equipment were abandoned beyond the passes, and prefectures and counties were ordered to share indemnities, so that the whole province fell into deficit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guangxi, since Sun Shiyi managed Annam, had military supplies in vast quantities at enormous cost; grain, silver, and equipment were abandoned beyond the passes, and prefectures and counties were ordered to share indemnities, so that the whole province fell into deficit.

manualTranslations.zh: 本非州縣侵蝕，且人已去任，接收者正在補苴，一經參追，難保不勸捐派累。
manualTranslations.literal: This was not embezzlement by prefectures and counties; moreover the men had already left office, and those receiving the posts were just making deficits good—once impeachment and pursuit began, it was hard to ensure that there would not be forced contributions and levies on the people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This was not embezzlement by prefectures and counties; moreover the men had already left office, and those receiving the posts were just making deficits good—once impeachment and pursuit began, it was hard to ensure that there would not be forced contributions and levies on the people.

manualTranslations.zh: 惟率司、道、府、州省衣節食，革去一切陋規，俾州縣從容彌補，進廉去貪，無累百姓，計三年之內，庫項必可補足。
manualTranslations.literal: Only if the provincial, circuit, prefectural, and department officials lead by wearing plain clothes and eating sparingly, abolish all abusive customs, let prefectures and counties make deficits good at a measured pace, advance the incorrupt and remove the greedy without burdening the people, can the treasury shortfalls be made good within three years.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Only if the provincial, circuit, prefectural, and department officials lead by wearing plain clothes and eating sparingly, abolish all abusive customs, let prefectures and counties make deficits good at a measured pace, advance the incorrupt and remove the greedy without burdening the people, can the treasury shortfalls be made good within three years.

manualTranslations.zh: 惟是數十人補之而不足，一二人敗之而有餘。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet dozens may make good deficits and still fall short, while one or two may ruin them and leave a surplus of harm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet dozens may make good deficits and still fall short, while one or two may ruin them and leave a surplus of harm.

manualTranslations.zh: 是又在知人善任，大法小廉，不愛逢迎，不存姑息，庶不致後有續虧之患。」
manualTranslations.literal: This again depends on knowing men and assigning them well, on strict law and modest integrity, on not courting flattery, and on not indulgence, so that later there may not be the calamity of renewed deficits."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This again depends on knowing men and assigning them well, on strict law and modest integrity, on not courting flattery, and on not indulgence, so that later there may not be the calamity of renewed deficits."

manualTranslations.zh: 又言：「彌補虧空，初不為一身免累之計，乃有實際。
manualTranslations.literal: He also said: "Making deficits good is not at first a plan to spare oneself from liability; it must have practical effect.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also said: "Making deficits good is not at first a plan to spare oneself from liability; it must have practical effect.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣前歷山西、浙江，皆未諮部，亦未諮追原籍。
manualTranslations.literal: When I previously served in Shanxi and Zhejiang, I never consulted the ministry, nor did I pursue men to their native places.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When I previously served in Shanxi and Zhejiang, I never consulted the ministry, nor did I pursue men to their native places.

manualTranslations.zh: 蓋當日之員，大半死亡遣戍，子孫貧乏者多，諮追徒滋紛擾，如數完繳者實無二三，現任反置身事外。
manualTranslations.literal: For the officials of those days had mostly died or been banished to garrison service; many of their descendants were poor; pursuit by consultation only bred disorder, and those who actually paid in full were scarcely two or three, while incumbents were left outside the matter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For the officials of those days had mostly died or been banished to garrison service; many of their descendants were poor; pursuit by consultation only bred disorder, and those who actually paid in full were scarcely two or three, while incumbents were left outside the matter.

manualTranslations.zh: 廣西庫項未完者三十九州縣，覈其廉數多寡，分限三年，按月交庫，於交代時有不足者，即以虧空論劾。」
manualTranslations.literal: In Guangxi thirty-nine prefectures and counties still had unfinished treasury accounts; I have verified the amounts of their deficits, set a three-year limit, required monthly payment into the treasury, and where there is shortfall at handover of office, I will impeach it as deficit."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Guangxi thirty-nine prefectures and counties still had unfinished treasury accounts; I have verified the amounts of their deficits, set a three-year limit, required monthly payment into the treasury, and where there is shortfall at handover of office, I will impeach it as deficit."

manualTranslations.zh: 疏入，仁宗嘉納焉。
manualTranslations.literal: When the memorial entered, Emperor Renzong praised and accepted it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, Emperor Renzong praised and accepted it.

manualTranslations.zh: 時詔買補倉穀，取諸豐稔鄰縣，禁於本境採買。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time an edict ordered purchase of grain to replenish granaries, taking it from neighboring counties with abundant harvests and forbidding procurement within one's own jurisdiction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At that time an edict ordered purchase of grain to replenish granaries, taking it from neighboring counties with abundant harvests and forbidding procurement within one's own jurisdiction.

manualTranslations.zh: 啟昆言廣西跬步皆山，轉運不減於穀價，恐不肖者因採買之難，或為勒派，請仍聽本境買補便，詔如所議。
manualTranslations.literal: Qikun said that in Guangxi every short step is over mountains, and transport costs are no less than the price of grain; he feared that unscrupulous men, because procurement was difficult, might resort to forced levies, and asked that local procurement within the jurisdiction still be permitted for convenience; an edict followed his proposal.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Qikun said that in Guangxi every short step is over mountains, and transport costs are no less than the price of grain; he feared that unscrupulous men, because procurement was difficult, might resort to forced levies, and asked that local procurement within the jurisdiction still be permitted for convenience; an edict followed his proposal.

sourceRange.text: 道光二年，遷太僕寺少卿。父憂去官，服闋，補順天府丞。歷通政司副使、光祿寺卿、太常寺卿、宗人府丞。十五年，署順天府尹。累遷內閣學士。十八年，授工部侍郎，調吏部，兼署倉場侍郎。二十一年，擢刑部尚書。浙江提督余步雲海疆僨事，逮問治罪。廷臣猶有為議輕比者，振祜堅持，得伸法。二十八年元旦，加恩年老諸臣，加太子太保。二十九年，因病乞休，許之。三十年，卒，年七十四，諡莊肅。

context.beforeSource: 又察出假印試卷、勾結舞弊之人，奏請懲辦。
context.afterSource: 宗室恩桂，字小山，隸鑲藍旗。

manualTranslations.zh: 道光二年，遷太僕寺少卿。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Daoguang he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1822 he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

manualTranslations.zh: 父憂去官，服闋，補順天府丞。
manualTranslations.literal: Upon his father's death he left office; after mourning was completed, he was appointed Deputy Intendant of Shuntian Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He left office upon his father's death; after mourning, he was appointed deputy intendant of Shuntian Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷通政司副使、光祿寺卿、太常寺卿、宗人府丞。
manualTranslations.literal: He served successively as Vice Commissioner of the Office of Transmission, Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served successively as vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission, minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and director of the Imperial Clan Court.

manualTranslations.zh: 十五年，署順天府尹。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifteenth year he acted as Intendant of Shuntian Prefecture.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 15 he served as acting intendant of Shuntian Prefecture.

manualTranslations.zh: 累遷內閣學士。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Academician of the Inner Cabinet.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He rose to Academician of the Inner Cabinet.

manualTranslations.zh: 十八年，授工部侍郎，調吏部，兼署倉場侍郎。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed Vice Minister of Works, transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, and concurrently acted as Vice Minister of the Granary.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 18 he was appointed Vice Minister of Works, transferred to Personnel, and concurrently acted as Vice Minister of the Granary.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十一年，擢刑部尚書。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was promoted to Minister of Justice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 21 he was promoted to Minister of Justice.

manualTranslations.zh: 浙江提督余步雲海疆僨事，逮問治罪。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhejiang Provincial Military Commissioner Yu Buyun failed in coastal affairs; he was arrested, interrogated, and punished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Zhejiang Military Commissioner Yu Buyun bungled coastal defense, he was arrested, interrogated, and punished.

manualTranslations.zh: 廷臣猶有為議輕比者，振祜堅持，得伸法。
manualTranslations.literal: Court ministers still argued for a lighter comparison of punishment; Zhenhu held firm and the law was fully enforced.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though court ministers still argued for leniency, Zhenhu held firm and saw the law enforced.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十八年元旦，加恩年老諸臣，加太子太保。
manualTranslations.literal: On New Year's Day of the twenty-eighth year, in granting favor to elderly ministers, he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the New Year's audience of Daoguang 28, honored among elderly ministers, he was made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十九年，因病乞休，許之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, ill, he requested retirement and was granted it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 29 he requested retirement due to illness and was granted leave.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十年，卒，年七十四，諡莊肅。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirtieth year he died at seventy-four and was posthumously titled Zhuangsu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died in Daoguang 30 at seventy-four and received the posthumous name Zhuangsu.

sourceRange.text: 道光三年，擢山西巡撫。丁父憂，服闋，署禮部侍郎。授倉場侍郎，嚴治花戶侵漁。初行海運，奏定漕糧到天津起卸撥運收貯章程，清覈於到壩之先，慎重於入倉之後，著為令。九年，遷漕運總督。疏言：「漕政之艱困，由於旗丁疲累，而水手多係無業遊民，性成強悍，無以卹其力而服其心，寬猛皆無當，欲其不滋事甚難。惟密诇於未然，而重繩其既往。請責成督運官弁，遇有滋事者，立時拿辦者免議；日久無獲者重處。」時漕弊已深，桂楨力加整頓，必究弊源，不為苛刻，群情翕服。

context.beforeSource: 歷浙江按察使，甘肅、山東布政使。
context.afterSource: 十一年，調廣東巡撫，卻洋行陋規，遇事執法，外商獨嚴憚之。

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，遷漕運總督。

manualTranslations.zh: 惟密诇於未然，而重繩其既往。

sourceRange.text: 同治元年安徽降賊苗沛霖謀分兵：一由清江，一渡潁而西，聲稱赴陝西勝保軍營助剿，實有異圖。楨上疏言：「苗沛霖窮而就撫，仍復擁兵觀望，反覆無常。所部素無紀律，倘長驅入陝，何異引狼入室？由潁趨豫，尚為道所必經，繞道清江，則去之愈遠，意存窺伺。西犯山左，則北路門戶大開，固為腹心之患；東犯裡下河，淮、揚通海，在在可虞。請飭下勝保嚴阻。」又疏言：「皖省軍情緊急，署撫臣李續宜回籍葬親，請勿拘百日定制，迅飭回任，以固疆圉。」並嘉納之。三年，文宗實錄、聖訓告成，以監修勞，賜花翎。六年，楨年七十，賜壽，恩禮甚渥。尋以病乞休，不許。七年，乃允致仕，食全俸，仍充團練大臣。十三年，卒，詔稱其「持躬端謹，學問優長」，依大學士例賜卹，晉贈太保，入祀賢良祠，諡文端。子致恩，官至浙江布政使。
