manualTranslations.zh: 同治元年安徽降賊苗沛霖謀分兵：一由清江，一渡潁而西，聲稱赴陝西勝保軍營助剿，實有異圖。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, Miao Peilin, a surrendered rebel of Anhui, planned to divide his forces: one column by way of Qingjiang, the other crossing the Ying River westward, claiming to go to Sheng Bao's camp in Shaanxi to assist in suppression while in fact harboring other designs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi, Miao Peilin, a surrendered rebel in Anhui, planned to divide his forces—one column through Qingjiang, the other crossing the Ying westward—claiming to join Sheng Bao's army in Shaanxi while in fact harboring other designs.

manualTranslations.zh: 楨上疏言：「苗沛霖窮而就撫，仍復擁兵觀望，反覆無常。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhen memorialized, saying: "Miao Peilin, driven to submission, again keeps his troops and watches from the sidelines, shifting back and forth without constancy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhen memorialized: "Miao Peilin, driven to submit, again keeps his troops and waits to see which way the wind blows, shifting back and forth without constancy.

manualTranslations.zh: 所部素無紀律，倘長驅入陝，何異引狼入室？
manualTranslations.literal: His followers have never had discipline; if they drive deep into Shaanxi, how is that different from letting a wolf into the house?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His men have never been disciplined; if they march deep into Shaanxi, how is that different from letting a wolf into the house?

manualTranslations.zh: 由潁趨豫，尚為道所必經，繞道清江，則去之愈遠，意存窺伺。
manualTranslations.literal: Going from the Ying toward Henan is still the route they must take; detouring by Qingjiang takes them farther away, showing intent to watch for an opening.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Marching from the Ying toward Henan is still the route they must take; detouring through Qingjiang takes them farther off course, showing intent to watch for an opening.

manualTranslations.zh: 西犯山左，則北路門戶大開，固為腹心之患；
manualTranslations.literal: If they strike west into Shandong, the northern gate will be thrown wide open, a grave threat to the heartland;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If they strike west into Shandong, the northern gate will be thrown wide open—a grave threat to the heartland;

manualTranslations.zh: 東犯裡下河，淮、揚通海，在在可虞。
manualTranslations.literal: if they strike east into the inner lower river region, Huai and Yangzhou connect to the sea, and danger lurks everywhere.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: if they strike east into the inner lower river region, where Huai and Yangzhou connect to the sea, danger lurks everywhere.

manualTranslations.zh: 請飭下勝保嚴阻。」
manualTranslations.literal: I ask that orders be sent to Sheng Bao to block them strictly."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I ask that orders be sent to Sheng Bao to block them strictly."

manualTranslations.zh: 又疏言：「皖省軍情緊急，署撫臣李續宜回籍葬親，請勿拘百日定制，迅飭回任，以固疆圉。」
manualTranslations.literal: He also memorialized: "Military affairs in Anhui are urgent; Acting Governor Li Xuyi has returned home to bury a parent. Please do not hold him to the hundred-day rule and order him swiftly back to office to secure the frontier."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "Military affairs in Anhui are urgent. Acting Governor Li Xuyi has returned home to bury a parent. Please do not hold him to the hundred-day mourning rule and order him swiftly back to office to secure the frontier."

manualTranslations.zh: 並嘉納之。
manualTranslations.literal: The throne praised and accepted both memorials.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The throne praised and accepted both memorials.

manualTranslations.zh: 三年，文宗實錄、聖訓告成，以監修勞，賜花翎。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year, when the Wenzong Emperor's Veritable Record and Sacred Instructions were reported completed, he was granted the peacock feather for his labor as supervising compiler.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year, when the Wenzong Emperor's Veritable Record and Sacred Instructions were completed, he was granted the peacock feather for supervising the compilation.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，楨年七十，賜壽，恩禮甚渥。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year, when Zhen reached seventy, birthday honors were granted and the imperial favor was very generous.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when Zhen turned seventy, the court granted birthday honors and showed him exceptional favor.

sourceRange.text: 咸豐元年，文宗召繼畬還京，召對，稱其樸實，尋授太僕寺少卿。詔求言，繼畬上疏，略謂：「國家崇尚儉樸，大內宮殿，一仍明舊。惟圓明園為三時聽政之地，避暑山莊為秋狝駐蹕之地，兩處規模，至乾隆間而備。宣宗皇帝暫停秋狝，熱河工程一切報罷，惟自正月至十月恆駐圓明園。然三十年中，未嘗增一堵一椽，遊觀不及諸坐落，或報應修，輒令撤去，以故內帑發出外庫前後凡千數百萬。數年以來，園亭久曠，或謂先朝堂構，不應坐聽彫殘。方今軍務未完，河工未畢，亦料無暇及此。將來兩事告蕆，內庫稍充，保無以營繕之說嘗試者，伏望皇上堅持，苟非萬不得已之工程，一切停罷。至於裝修陳設，珍奇玩好，可省則省，無取鋪張，此土木之漸宜防也。孔子刪詩，以關雎為首，義取摯而有別。匡衡之說有曰：'情慾之感，無介於容儀；宴安之私，不形於動靜。'其言有別，可謂深切著明。第以事涉宮闈，絕於聽睹，非臣子之所敢言。雖有折檻之忠，牽裾之直，止能言得失於殿廷，豈能爭是非於宮壼？故聖帝明王，即以是為修省最切之地。皇上至剛無欲，邇者釋服禮成，將備周官九禦之制，衍大雅百男之祥。竊以為聖德日新，肇基於此，此宴安之漸宜防也。自古壅蔽之患，由於言路不通，然亦有言路既通，而壅蔽轉生於不覺者。皇上御極之初，即以開言路為務。自倭仁一疏，手詔褒嘉，言事者紛紛而起。邇因天旱求言，又復諄諄獎誘，舉空言塞責、受人指揮、激直沽名三弊為戒。臣庶大半中材，臣以為空言塞責，事出庸愚，一覽擲之，無關輕重。激直沽名，由於器小，皇上予以優容，適足以見聖度。至受人指揮，事涉營私，果其確有可憑，必當明正其罪。總之群言淆亂，衷諸聖人，亦在皇上權衡酌量而已。臣竊計在京言事者，約分三等：以章奏陳者，曰九卿、科道；以章奏陳兼得面陳者，曰部院大臣；不以章奏陳而時得面陳者，曰內廷王公。此三者各有所優，亦各有所蔽。九卿、科道，爵秩未崇，少迴翔之意，聞見較廣，多采訪之途，以風節相磨，以彈劾為職，此其所優也；其所蔽則前之三弊是也。部院大臣，久在朝列，受恩效忠，明習時事，此其所優也；然階級既崇，天顏日接，顧忌矜慎，胸臆所存，莫能傾吐其十一，此則其所蔽也。內廷王公，國家肺腑，外無私交黨援之患，內無希幸爵賞之心，此其所優也；然法制綦嚴，例不與外人交接，廷評輿論，所不盡聞，此則其所蔽也。皇上明目達聰，幽隱畢照，而臣乃鰓鰓過慮者，誠恐言事者限於才識，未能仰副淵衷，致皇上察納虛懷，不免悵然而思返，此壅蔽之漸宜防也。昔唐臣魏徵有十漸之疏，太宗嘉納，千古以為美談。夫漸者，已然之詞也。正之於已然，何如防之於未然。臣謹師其意，衍為三防之說，極知迂陋，無補高深，伏冀幾餘採納。」上優詔報之。咸豐二年，吏部追論繼畬在巡撫任逮送罪人遲誤，請議處，乃罷歸。尋丁母憂。粵匪北犯，攻懷慶，山西巡撫哈芬檄太原總兵烏勒欣泰率兵防澤州，遷延未即赴。賊渡河陷垣曲，哈芬出駐陽城，布政使郭夢齡疏乞援，繼畬亦具疏借布政使印馳奏，上為罷哈芬巡撫，以王慶雲代之。繼畬條舉防守諸事以告，尋奏請令繼畬督辦防堵。事定，居數年，回、捻交亂，又命督率官紳總辦各府州團防。繼畬駐潞安年餘，親歷遼州、上黨、陽城諸要隘，措置詳備，署巡撫沈桂芬甚重之。同治二年，召詣京師，命在總理各國事務衙門行走。尋授太僕寺卿，加二品頂戴。五年，以老疾乞歸。

sourceRange.text: 同治六年，移師鳳陽。時捻酋李允謀窺廬、鳳，詣五河就李世忠。念祖诇知之，計說世忠縛以獻，鏁送壽州寘之法，晉按察使。援滕縣，既捷，師還，寇逾萬躡其後，乃掘深溝，布機械，陰徙去，追騎多墜死，人服其智略。直東平，賜號捷勇巴圖魯。八年，除山西按察使，年未及三十也。上慮其資名輕，與直隸按察使張樹聲易官，令曾國籓察覆，稱念祖明爽，磨厲當成大器，宜稍緩任事，遂解職，留直差序。十年，左遷甘肅安肅道，主關內外糧運，給食不乏，征西軍倚以集事，頗見賞於左宗棠。光緒四年，晉按察使。多所平反，理俞應鈞等殺降回讞忤宗棠意，再被劾去。十年，起雲南按察使。歷貴州，調補雲南布政使。時總督岑毓英督師出關，需餉亟，而巡撫張凱嵩與有郄。念祖為陳公私利害，請以地丁錢漕受巡撫指麾，釐金雜稅供總督兵餉，復為貸商款備糧械，毓英德之，密薦其賢。二十一年，授廣西巡撫。桂故多匪，至則選卒逐捕，痛繩以法，匪皆斂跡。坐失察贓罪，罷免。三十一年，賞加副都統銜，命赴奉天隨將軍趙爾巽治賑。尋督三省鹽務及財政局。奉省吏治不飭，冒憲黷貨，弊風相踵，念祖佐爾巽力抉其弊，蠲苛息煩，歲入倍蓰。期年奏績，上嘉之，晉記名副都統。爾巽移蜀，徐世昌代之，又劾罷。宣統二年，卒。爾巽先後上其功，复巡撫原官，卹如製。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed judicial commissioner of Shanxi, though he was not yet thirty.

manualTranslations.literal: The emperor worried that his youth and reputation were slight; he was exchanged with Zhang Shusheng, judicial commissioner of Zhili, and Zeng Guofan was ordered to investigate; Guofan praised Nianzu as clear-minded and said that with further tempering he would become a great figure but that he should be eased into responsibility more slowly; he was therefore removed from office and kept in the Zhili reserve roster.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor worried that his youth and reputation were slight. He was exchanged with Zhang Shusheng, judicial commissioner of Zhili, and Zeng Guofan was ordered to investigate. Guofan praised Nianzu as clear-minded and said that with further tempering he would become a great figure but that he should be eased into responsibility more slowly. He was therefore removed from office and kept on the Zhili reserve roster.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，左遷甘肅安肅道，主關內外糧運，給食不乏，征西軍倚以集事，頗見賞於左宗棠。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year he was demoted to intendant of Ansuhu in Gansu, in charge of grain transport inside and outside the passes; provisions never ran short, and the western expeditionary army relied on him to gather strength; he won considerable praise from Zuo Zongtang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was demoted to intendant of Ansuhu in Gansu, in charge of grain transport inside and outside the passes. Provisions never ran short, and the western expeditionary army relied on him to gather strength. He won considerable praise from Zuo Zongtang.

manualTranslations.zh: 光緒四年，晉按察使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu he was promoted again to judicial commissioner.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Guangxu (1878) he was promoted again to judicial commissioner.

manualTranslations.zh: 多所平反，理俞應鈞等殺降回讞忤宗棠意，再被劾去。
manualTranslations.literal: He reversed many wrongful verdicts; in handling the case of Yu Yingjun and others for killing surrendered Muslims he offended Zongtang's wishes and was impeached and removed again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He reversed many wrongful verdicts. In handling the case of Yu Yingjun and others for killing surrendered Muslims he offended Zuo Zongtang's wishes and was impeached and removed again.

manualTranslations.zh: 十年，起雲南按察使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year he was recalled as judicial commissioner of Yunnan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was recalled as judicial commissioner of Yunnan.

manualTranslations.zh: 歷貴州，調補雲南布政使。
manualTranslations.literal: He served in Guizhou and was transferred to provincial treasurer of Yunnan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served in Guizhou and was transferred to provincial treasurer of Yunnan.

manualTranslations.zh: 時總督岑毓英督師出關，需餉亟，而巡撫張凱嵩與有郄。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Governor-General Cen Yuying was leading troops beyond the border and needed funds urgently, while Governor Zhang Kaixuan bore a grudge against him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time Governor-General Cen Yuying was leading troops beyond the border and needed funds urgently, while Governor Zhang Kaixuan bore a grudge against him.

manualTranslations.zh: 念祖為陳公私利害，請以地丁錢漕受巡撫指麾，釐金雜稅供總督兵餉，復為貸商款備糧械，毓英德之，密薦其賢。
manualTranslations.literal: Nianzu explained the public and private stakes, asking that land-tax and grain-transport funds be directed by the governor while miscellaneous levies supplied the governor-general's military pay; he also secured merchant loans for grain and arms; Yuying was grateful and secretly recommended his worth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Nianzu explained the public and private stakes, asking that land-tax and grain-transport funds be directed by the governor while miscellaneous levies supplied the governor-general's military pay. He also secured merchant loans for grain and arms. Yuying was grateful and secretly recommended his worth.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十一年，授廣西巡撫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed governor of Guangxi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was appointed governor of Guangxi.

manualTranslations.zh: 桂故多匪，至則選卒逐捕，痛繩以法，匪皆斂跡。
manualTranslations.literal: Guangxi had long been full of bandits; on arrival he chose soldiers to hunt them down and punished them severely by law, and the bandits all shrank back.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guangxi had long been full of bandits. On arrival he chose soldiers to hunt them down and punished them severely by law, and the bandits all shrank back.

manualTranslations.zh: 坐失察贓罪，罷免。
manualTranslations.literal: He was dismissed for failure to detect corruption.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was dismissed for failure to detect corruption.

manualTranslations.zh: 三十一年，賞加副都統銜，命赴奉天隨將軍趙爾巽治賑。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirty-first year he was granted the rank of vice commandant and ordered to Fengtian to assist General Zhao Erxun in famine relief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he was granted the rank of vice commandant and ordered to Fengtian to assist General Zhao Erxun in famine relief.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋督三省鹽務及財政局。
manualTranslations.literal: Soon he supervised salt administration and financial affairs in three provinces.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon he supervised salt administration and financial affairs in three provinces.

manualTranslations.zh: 奉省吏治不飭，冒憲黷貨，弊風相踵，念祖佐爾巽力抉其弊，蠲苛息煩，歲入倍蓰。
manualTranslations.literal: Fengtian's official governance was lax; false credentials and bribery ran in succession; Nianzu helped Erxun forcefully root out abuses, cut harsh levies and eased burdens, and annual revenue doubled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fengtian's official governance was lax, and false credentials and bribery ran in succession. Nianzu helped Erxun forcefully root out abuses, cut harsh levies and eased burdens, and annual revenue doubled.

manualTranslations.zh: 期年奏績，上嘉之，晉記名副都統。
manualTranslations.literal: Within a year he reported results and the emperor commended him, promoting him to brevet vice commandant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Within a year he reported results and the emperor commended him, promoting him to brevet vice commandant.

manualTranslations.zh: 爾巽移蜀，徐世昌代之，又劾罷。
manualTranslations.literal: When Erxun was transferred to Sichuan and Xu Shichang replaced him, Nianzu was impeached and dismissed again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Erxun was transferred to Sichuan and Xu Shichang replaced him, Nianzu was impeached and dismissed again.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣統二年，卒。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuantong (1910) he died.

manualTranslations.zh: 爾巽先後上其功，复巡撫原官，卹如製。
manualTranslations.literal: Erxun repeatedly memorialized his achievements; his former governorship was restored posthumously and condolences were granted according to regulation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Erxun repeatedly memorialized his achievements. His former governorship was restored posthumously and condolences were granted according to regulation.

items.acceptedSourceText: 同治六年，移師鳳陽。時捻酋李允謀窺廬、鳳，詣五河就李世忠。念祖诇知之，計說世忠縛以獻，鏁送壽州寘之法，晉按察使。援滕縣，既捷，師還，寇逾萬躡其後，乃掘深溝，布機械，陰徙去，追騎多墜死，人服其智略。直東平，賜號捷勇巴圖魯。八年，除山西按察使，年未及三十也。上慮其資名輕，與直隸按察使張樹聲易官，令曾國籓察覆，稱念祖明爽，磨厲當成大器，宜稍緩任事，遂解職，留直差序。十年，左遷甘肅安肅道，主關內外糧運，給食不乏，征西軍倚以集事，頗見賞於左宗棠。光緒四年，晉按察使。多所平反，理俞應鈞等殺降回讞忤宗棠意，再被劾去。十年，起雲南按察使。歷貴州，調補雲南布政使。時總督岑毓英督師出關，需餉亟，而巡撫張凱嵩與有郄。念祖為陳公私利害，請以地丁錢漕受巡撫指麾，釐金雜稅供總督兵餉，復為貸商款備糧械，毓英德之，密薦其賢。二十一年，授廣西巡撫。桂故多匪，至則選卒逐捕，痛繩以法，匪皆斂跡。坐失察贓罪，罷免。三十一年，賞加副都統銜，命赴奉天隨將軍趙爾巽治賑。尋督三省鹽務及財政局。奉省吏治不飭，冒憲黷貨，弊風相踵，念祖佐爾巽力抉其弊，蠲苛息煩，歲入倍蓰。期年奏績，上嘉之，晉記名副都統。爾巽移蜀，徐世昌代之，又劾罷。宣統二年，卒。爾巽先後上其功，复巡撫原官，卹如製。

sourceRange.text: 光緒十七年，授甘肅新疆巡撫。當蔥嶺西，有地曰帕米爾，乾隆間為我軍鋒所及，高宗嘗勒銘焉。蔥嶺東南有小部落曰坎巨提，歲納貢於我。模未至新疆，俄侵帕米爾，謀通印度，英攻破坎巨提。中外方議戰，模謂：「將士能戡土匪，未能禦強敵。軍資百物，運自內地，數月乃達。俄、英鐵軌，瞬息可至。新疆與俄相接幾五千里，增兵十倍未足固。當民窮財匱之時，不可輕言戰。惟當購機砲，擴電線，飭邊將嚴為備。羈坎巨提故酋無令北走，而撫其流民，與駐俄、英使臣合爭。」議未定，俄曰防英，英曰防俄，莫可究詰。明年，二國兵益進，將吏咸憤激請戰，終不許。於是奏請廢黜坎巨提故酋。會英人亦立其弟買賣提艾孜木，令鎮撫部民，歲納貢如故事，坎巨提事乃定。

manualTranslations.zh: 光緒十七年，授甘肅新疆巡撫。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu he was appointed governor of Gansu and Xinjiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu (1891) he was appointed governor of Gansu and Xinjiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 當蔥嶺西，有地曰帕米爾，乾隆間為我軍鋒所及，高宗嘗勒銘焉。
manualTranslations.literal: West of the Congling Mountains lies a region called the Pamirs; in the Qianlong period it was reached by our army's vanguard, and the Gaozong emperor once had an inscription carved there.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: West of the Congling Mountains lies a region called the Pamirs. In the Qianlong period it was reached by our army's vanguard, and the Gaozong emperor once had an inscription carved there.

manualTranslations.zh: 蔥嶺東南有小部落曰坎巨提，歲納貢於我。
manualTranslations.literal: Southeast of the Congling Mountains is a small tribe called Kanjut, which paid annual tribute to us.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Southeast of the Congling Mountains is a small tribe called Kanjut, which paid annual tribute to China.

manualTranslations.zh: 模未至新疆，俄侵帕米爾，謀通印度，英攻破坎巨提。
manualTranslations.literal: Before Mo reached Xinjiang, Russia invaded the Pamirs, seeking a route to India, and Britain captured Kanjut.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before Mo reached Xinjiang, Russia invaded the Pamirs, seeking a route to India, and Britain captured Kanjut.

manualTranslations.zh: 中外方議戰，模謂：「將士能戡土匪，未能禦強敵。
manualTranslations.literal: China and foreign powers were debating war; Mo said: "Our officers and men can subdue bandits but cannot withstand powerful enemies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As China and foreign powers debated war, Mo said, "Our officers and men can subdue bandits but cannot withstand powerful enemies.

manualTranslations.zh: 軍資百物，運自內地，數月乃達。
manualTranslations.literal: Military supplies of every kind must be transported from the interior and take months to arrive.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Military supplies of every kind must be transported from the interior and take months to arrive.

manualTranslations.zh: 俄、英鐵軌，瞬息可至。
manualTranslations.literal: Russia and Britain have rail lines; they can reach us in an instant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Russia and Britain have rail lines and can reach us in an instant.

manualTranslations.zh: 新疆與俄相接幾五千里，增兵十倍未足固。
manualTranslations.literal: Xinjiang borders Russia for nearly five thousand li; even ten times the present garrison would not secure it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xinjiang borders Russia for nearly five thousand li; even ten times the present garrison would not secure it.

manualTranslations.zh: 當民窮財匱之時，不可輕言戰。
manualTranslations.literal: When the people are poor and the treasury is exhausted, one must not lightly speak of war.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the people are poor and the treasury is exhausted, one must not lightly speak of war.

manualTranslations.zh: 惟當購機砲，擴電線，飭邊將嚴為備。
manualTranslations.literal: We should only purchase machine-guns and artillery, expand telegraph lines, and order frontier generals to prepare defenses strictly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We should only purchase machine-guns and artillery, expand telegraph lines, and order frontier generals to prepare defenses strictly.

manualTranslations.zh: 羈坎巨提故酋無令北走，而撫其流民，與駐俄、英使臣合爭。」
manualTranslations.literal: Detain Kanjut's former chief so he cannot flee north, comfort the displaced people, and join the ministers stationed in Russia and Britain in pressing our claims."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Detain Kanjut's former chief so he cannot flee north, comfort the displaced people, and join the ministers stationed in Russia and Britain in pressing our claims."

manualTranslations.zh: 議未定，俄曰防英，英曰防俄，莫可究詰。
manualTranslations.literal: No decision was reached; Russia said it was guarding against Britain, Britain said it was guarding against Russia, and no one could get to the bottom of it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: No decision was reached. Russia said it was guarding against Britain, Britain said it was guarding against Russia, and no one could get to the bottom of it.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，二國兵益進，將吏咸憤激請戰，終不許。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year both countries advanced troops further; local officials were all stirred to demand war, but permission was never granted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year both countries advanced troops further. Local officials were all stirred to demand war, but permission was never granted.

manualTranslations.zh: 於是奏請廢黜坎巨提故酋。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon he memorialized asking that Kanjut's former chief be deposed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon he memorialized asking that Kanjut's former chief be deposed.

manualTranslations.zh: 會英人亦立其弟買賣提艾孜木，令鎮撫部民，歲納貢如故事，坎巨提事乃定。
manualTranslations.literal: Britain also installed his younger brother Maimaidi Aizimu to pacify the tribesmen and pay annual tribute as before, and the Kanjut affair was settled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Britain also installed his younger brother Maimaidi Aizimu to pacify the tribesmen and pay annual tribute as before, and the Kanjut affair was settled.

items.acceptedSourceText: 光緒十七年，授甘肅新疆巡撫。當蔥嶺西，有地曰帕米爾，乾隆間為我軍鋒所及，高宗嘗勒銘焉。蔥嶺東南有小部落曰坎巨提，歲納貢於我。模未至新疆，俄侵帕米爾，謀通印度，英攻破坎巨提。中外方議戰，模謂：「將士能戡土匪，未能禦強敵。軍資百物，運自內地，數月乃達。俄、英鐵軌，瞬息可至。新疆與俄相接幾五千里，增兵十倍未足固。當民窮財匱之時，不可輕言戰。惟當購機砲，擴電線，飭邊將嚴為備。羈坎巨提故酋無令北走，而撫其流民，與駐俄、英使臣合爭。」議未定，俄曰防英，英曰防俄，莫可究詰。明年，二國兵益進，將吏咸憤激請戰，終不許。於是奏請廢黜坎巨提故酋。會英人亦立其弟買賣提艾孜木，令鎮撫部民，歲納貢如故事，坎巨提事乃定。

sourceRange.text: 同治二年，擢山東按察使。會僧格林沁治兵魯、豫間，令擊河北宋景詩。旋劾其擅議招撫，部議降三級。又明年，遷布政使。僧格林沁戰歿曹州，坐法再乾議，皆得恩旨留任，於是言者復摭他款彈之，事下曾國籓，國籓白其無罪。巡撫閻敬銘夙高其能，至是乞休，舉以自代，遂拜巡撫之命。時捻趨海澨，李鴻章建議築牆膠萊河，寶楨會軍蹙之。六年，東捻走濰河，東軍王心安築壘方成，而堤牆未竣，捻長驅渡河，寶楨以聞。上怒，鴻章交部議，寶楨亦褫職留任。先是東軍守濰河，本皖將潘鼎新汛地。皖軍甫南移，而北路遽失。詔斬心安，寶楨抗辯，乃宥心安而責鴻章；寶楨复屢疏相詆，於是上益責鴻章忌刻縱寇矣。明年，西捻趨定州，近畿震動。寶楨聞警，即馳至東昌，率騎旅千、精卒三千，齎五日糧，倍道北援，捻遂南潰。是役也，朝廷遣宿衛之旅出國門備寇，統兵諸將帥皆獲譴讓，而上獨以寶楨一軍猝出寇前，轉戰雄、任、深、祁、高、肅間，复饒陽，功最盛，數降敕褒嘉，加太子少保。寶楨治軍善乘勢，不主畫疆自守，以故諸軍會集，東西二渠率皆就殲山東。

context.afterSource: 而其誅安得海事尤著人口。

manualTranslations.zh: 同治二年，擢山東按察使。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he was promoted to judicial commissioner of Shandong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi (1863) he was promoted to judicial commissioner of Shandong.

manualTranslations.zh: 會僧格林沁治兵魯、豫間，令擊河北宋景詩。
manualTranslations.literal: When Sengge Rinchen was organizing troops between Shandong and Henan, he ordered him to strike Song Jingshi in northern Hebei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sengge Rinchen was organizing troops between Shandong and Henan, he ordered Baozhen to attack Song Jingshi in northern Hebei.

manualTranslations.zh: 旋劾其擅議招撫，部議降三級。
manualTranslations.literal: He was soon impeached for having unauthorized talks about surrender and pacification; the ministry recommended demotion by three ranks.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was soon impeached for unauthorized talks about surrender and pacification, and the ministry recommended demotion by three ranks.

manualTranslations.zh: 又明年，遷布政使。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he was transferred to provincial treasurer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to provincial treasurer.

manualTranslations.zh: 僧格林沁戰歿曹州，坐法再乾議，皆得恩旨留任，於是言者復摭他款彈之，事下曾國籓，國籓白其無罪。
manualTranslations.literal: Sengge Rinchen died in battle at Caozhou; legal proceedings were opened twice, each time an imperial edict kept him in office; critics then dredged up other charges, and the case was sent to Zeng Guofan, who declared him innocent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Sengge Rinchen fell at Caozhou, legal proceedings were opened twice, each time an imperial edict kept Baozhen in office. Critics then dredged up other charges, and the case was sent to Zeng Guofan, who declared him innocent.

manualTranslations.zh: 巡撫閻敬銘夙高其能，至是乞休，舉以自代，遂拜巡撫之命。
manualTranslations.literal: Governor Yan Jingming had long valued his ability; now he asked to retire and recommended him as his successor, and he received appointment as governor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Governor Yan Jingming had long valued his ability. He now asked to retire and recommended Baozhen as his successor, and Baozhen received appointment as governor.

manualTranslations.zh: 時捻趨海澨，李鴻章建議築牆膠萊河，寶楨會軍蹙之。
manualTranslations.literal: The Nian were then pressing toward the coast; Li Hongzhang proposed building walls along the Jiao-Lai River, and Baozhen joined forces to hem them in.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Nian were then pressing toward the coast. Li Hongzhang proposed building walls along the Jiao-Lai River, and Baozhen joined forces to hem them in.

manualTranslations.zh: 六年，東捻走濰河，東軍王心安築壘方成，而堤牆未竣，捻長驅渡河，寶楨以聞。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth year the eastern Nian fled to the Wei River; Wang Xin'an of the eastern army had just finished building stockades, but the embankment wall was not complete; the Nian rode straight across the river, and Baozhen reported it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the eastern Nian fled to the Wei River. Wang Xin'an of the eastern army had just finished building stockades, but the embankment wall was not complete, and the Nian rode straight across the river. Baozhen reported the breach.

manualTranslations.zh: 上怒，鴻章交部議，寶楨亦褫職留任。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor was furious; Li Hongzhang was referred to the ministry for investigation, and Baozhen was also stripped of office yet retained on duty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious. Li Hongzhang was referred to the ministry for investigation, and Baozhen was also stripped of office yet retained on duty.

manualTranslations.zh: 先是東軍守濰河，本皖將潘鼎新汛地。
manualTranslations.literal: Earlier, when the eastern army held the Wei River, the sector had been the post of Anhui general Pan Dingxin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the eastern army held the Wei River, the sector had been the post of Anhui general Pan Dingxin.

manualTranslations.zh: 皖軍甫南移，而北路遽失。
manualTranslations.literal: The Anhui army had only just shifted south when the northern route was suddenly lost.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Anhui army had only just shifted south when the northern route was suddenly lost.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔斬心安，寶楨抗辯，乃宥心安而責鴻章；
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered Wang Xin'an beheaded; Baozhen argued against it, and Xin'an was pardoned while Li Hongzhang was blamed;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Wang Xin'an beheaded. Baozhen argued against it, and Xin'an was pardoned while Li Hongzhang was blamed;

manualTranslations.zh: 寶楨复屢疏相詆，於是上益責鴻章忌刻縱寇矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Baozhen again sent repeated memorials attacking Li Hongzhang, and the court increasingly blamed Li for narrow jealousy that allowed the bandits to roam free.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Baozhen again sent repeated memorials attacking Li Hongzhang, and the court increasingly blamed Li for narrow jealousy that allowed the bandits to roam free.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，西捻趨定州，近畿震動。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year the western Nian pushed toward Dingzhou, shaking the capital region.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year the western Nian pushed toward Dingzhou and shook the capital region.

manualTranslations.zh: 寶楨聞警，即馳至東昌，率騎旅千、精卒三千，齎五日糧，倍道北援，捻遂南潰。
manualTranslations.literal: Hearing the alarm, Baozhen raced to Dongchang, led a thousand cavalry and three thousand elite troops with five days' rations, and rushed north by forced marches; the Nian then broke south in rout.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hearing the alarm, Baozhen raced to Dongchang, led a thousand cavalry and three thousand elite troops with five days' rations, and rushed north by forced marches. The Nian then broke south in rout.

manualTranslations.zh: 是役也，朝廷遣宿衛之旅出國門備寇，統兵諸將帥皆獲譴讓，而上獨以寶楨一軍猝出寇前，轉戰雄、任、深、祁、高、肅間，复饒陽，功最盛，數降敕褒嘉，加太子少保。
manualTranslations.literal: In this campaign the court sent palace guard regiments beyond the capital to meet the threat, and every commanding general was censured; only Baozhen's army, suddenly appearing ahead of the bandits, fought through Xiong, Ren, Shen, Qi, Gao, and Su, recovered Raoyang, and won the greatest honors; he received repeated imperial commendations by decree and was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In this campaign the court sent palace guard regiments beyond the capital to meet the threat, and every commanding general was censured. Only Baozhen's army, suddenly appearing ahead of the bandits, fought through Xiong, Ren, Shen, Qi, Gao, and Su, recovered Raoyang, and won the greatest honors. He received repeated imperial commendations by decree and was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 寶楨治軍善乘勢，不主畫疆自守，以故諸軍會集，東西二渠率皆就殲山東。
manualTranslations.literal: Baozhen commanded troops by seizing momentum rather than guarding fixed boundaries, and so when forces gathered, the eastern and western Nian bands were both largely destroyed in Shandong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Baozhen commanded troops by seizing momentum rather than guarding fixed boundaries, and so when forces gathered, the eastern and western Nian bands were both largely destroyed in Shandong.

items.acceptedSourceText: 同治二年，擢山東按察使。會僧格林沁治兵魯、豫間，令擊河北宋景詩。旋劾其擅議招撫，部議降三級。又明年，遷布政使。僧格林沁戰歿曹州，坐法再乾議，皆得恩旨留任，於是言者復摭他款彈之，事下曾國籓，國籓白其無罪。巡撫閻敬銘夙高其能，至是乞休，舉以自代，遂拜巡撫之命。時捻趨海澨，李鴻章建議築牆膠萊河，寶楨會軍蹙之。六年，東捻走濰河，東軍王心安築壘方成，而堤牆未竣，捻長驅渡河，寶楨以聞。上怒，鴻章交部議，寶楨亦褫職留任。先是東軍守濰河，本皖將潘鼎新汛地。皖軍甫南移，而北路遽失。詔斬心安，寶楨抗辯，乃宥心安而責鴻章；寶楨复屢疏相詆，於是上益責鴻章忌刻縱寇矣。明年，西捻趨定州，近畿震動。寶楨聞警，即馳至東昌，率騎旅千、精卒三千，齎五日糧，倍道北援，捻遂南潰。是役也，朝廷遣宿衛之旅出國門備寇，統兵諸將帥皆獲譴讓，而上獨以寶楨一軍猝出寇前，轉戰雄、任、深、祁、高、肅間，复饒陽，功最盛，數降敕褒嘉，加太子少保。寶楨治軍善乘勢，不主畫疆自守，以故諸軍會集，東西二渠率皆就殲山東。

sourceRange.text: 光緒二年，率師東渡，頓基隆，顧北路。其時後山阿綿、納納社番畔服靡忄互，開華領所部抵成廣澳，量地勢，察番情，進駐水母丁。悍番分路迎拒，開華麾軍鏖戰，陣斬數人，餘敗潰。師入高崁，直搗其巢。潰番併入阿綿，其地水湍急，聳巘巉崗，砲台錯列，備奧阻。開華轟擊之，縱以火箭，复繞道攻其後，番駭走，遂克之，擒其魁馬腰兵等梟於市。九日三捷，論功，賞黃馬褂。四年，霆慶軍統將宋國永卒，開華接統其眾。會加禮宛、巾老耶畔，據鵲子城，師攻不克。總督何璟以軍事棘，令開華進新城，許便宜行事。開華浮戰艦入自花黎，襲攻後山背。四日悉夷諸社，斬二百數十級。番乞款，縛姑乳鬥玩以獻，寘之法。台北平，被賞賚。明年，內渡，再署提督，秋，复渡台。九年，回任。已，復出辦台北防務。

context.beforeSource: 募勇成捷勝軍，赴台北、蘇澳營辦開山，詔署陸路提督。
context.afterSource: 十年，法人來犯，時劉銘傳主軍事。

manualTranslations.zh: 光緒二年，率師東渡，頓基隆，顧北路。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he led his army east across the sea, halted at Keelung, and watched the northern route.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Guangxu year two he crossed to Taiwan, camped at Keelung, and guarded the northern route.

manualTranslations.zh: 其時後山阿綿、納納社番畔服靡戾，開華領所部抵成廣澳，量地勢，察番情，進駐水母丁。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the eastern-hills Amian and Nan'na tribes on the border were rebellious and unruly; Kaihua led his division to Chengguang'ao, surveyed the terrain, observed the tribes' disposition, and advanced to garrison Shuimuding.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Eastern-hills Amian and Nan'na tribes were then unruly on the frontier; Sun led his men to Chengguang'ao, surveyed the ground and tribal mood, and advanced to Shuimuding.

manualTranslations.zh: 悍番分路迎拒，開華麾軍鏖戰，陣斬數人，餘敗潰。
manualTranslations.literal: Fierce tribes met him on separate roads; Kaihua commanded the army in bitter fighting, slew several men in battle, and the rest fled in defeat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fierce tribes met him on several roads; Sun fought hard, killed several in battle, and routed the rest.

manualTranslations.zh: 師入高崁，直搗其巢。
manualTranslations.literal: The army entered Gaokan and struck straight at their lair.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His force entered Gaokan and struck their stronghold.

manualTranslations.zh: 潰番併入阿綿，其地水湍急，聳巘巉崗，砲台錯列，備奧阻。
manualTranslations.literal: The defeated tribes merged into Amian; the place had swift water, towering steep cliffs, batteries arrayed in confusion, and defenses deep and obstructive.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Defeated tribes fled into Amian, where swift water, steep cliffs, and scattered batteries made the place hard to storm.

manualTranslations.zh: 開華轟擊之，縱以火箭，復繞道攻其後，番駭走，遂克之，擒其魁馬腰兵等梟於市。
manualTranslations.literal: Kaihua bombarded them, loosed fire-arrows, and again attacked from the rear by a detour; the tribes fled in terror, and he took the place, seizing their chiefs Mayaobing and others and displaying them in the market.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun shelled them, fired rockets, and circled to attack from the rear; the tribes fled, he took the place, and had chiefs including Mayaobing executed in public.

manualTranslations.zh: 九日三捷，論功，賞黃馬褂。
manualTranslations.literal: In nine days came three victories; for merit he was rewarded with a yellow riding jacket.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Three victories in nine days won him a yellow riding jacket.

manualTranslations.zh: 四年，霆慶軍統將宋國永卒，開華接統其眾。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year Song Guoyong, commanding general of the Tingqing Army, died, and Kaihua took command of his force.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Tingqing commander Song Guoyong died and Sun took over his troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 會加禮宛、巾老耶畔，據鵲子城，師攻不克。
manualTranslations.literal: At the same time Jialiyuan and Jinlaoye rebelled, held Quezicheng, and the army attacked without success.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Jialiyuan and Jinlaoye rebelled, held Quezicheng, and resisted attack.

manualTranslations.zh: 總督何璟以軍事棘，令開華進新城，許便宜行事。
manualTranslations.literal: Governor-General He Jing, finding military affairs critical, ordered Kaihua to advance on Xincheng and allowed him discretionary authority.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Governor-General He Jing, pressed by the crisis, ordered Sun to advance on Xincheng with full discretion.

manualTranslations.zh: 開華浮戰艦入自花黎，襲攻後山背。
manualTranslations.literal: Kaihua sailed warships in from Huali and struck the rear of the eastern hills.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun brought warships in by way of Huali and attacked the eastern hills from behind.

manualTranslations.zh: 四日悉夷諸社，斬二百數十級。
manualTranslations.literal: In four days he leveled all the communities and beheaded more than two hundred.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In four days he subdued every settlement and took more than two hundred heads.

manualTranslations.zh: 番乞款，縛姑乳鬥玩以獻，寘之法。
manualTranslations.literal: The tribes sued for peace, bound Gurudouwan and presented him, and he was put to law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The tribes sued for peace, handed over Gurudouwan bound, and he was executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 台北平，被賞賚。
manualTranslations.literal: When Taipei was pacified he received rewards.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When northern Taiwan was pacified he was rewarded.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，內渡，再署提督，秋，復渡台。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he crossed inland, was again appointed military governor, and in autumn crossed to Taiwan again.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year he returned to the mainland, was again made governor, and crossed back to Taiwan that autumn.

manualTranslations.zh: 九年，回任。
manualTranslations.literal: In the ninth year he returned to his post.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he resumed his post.

manualTranslations.zh: 已，復出辦台北防務。

items.acceptedSourceText: 光緒二年，率師東渡，頓基隆，顧北路。其時後山阿綿、納納社番畔服靡戾，開華領所部抵成廣澳，量地勢，察番情，進駐水母丁。悍番分路迎拒，開華麾軍鏖戰，陣斬數人，餘敗潰。師入高崁，直搗其巢。潰番併入阿綿，其地水湍急，聳巘巉崗，砲台錯列，備奧阻。開華轟擊之，縱以火箭，復繞道攻其後，番駭走，遂克之，擒其魁馬腰兵等梟於市。九日三捷，論功，賞黃馬褂。四年，霆慶軍統將宋國永卒，開華接統其眾。會加禮宛、巾老耶畔，據鵲子城，師攻不克。總督何璟以軍事棘，令開華進新城，許便宜行事。開華浮戰艦入自花黎，襲攻後山背。四日悉夷諸社，斬二百數十級。番乞款，縛姑乳鬥玩以獻，寘之法。台北平，被賞賚。明年，內渡，再署提督，秋，復渡台。九年，回任。已，復出辦台北防務。

sourceRange.text: 有為上書請改革，廣仁謂當先變科舉，庶人才可出。其後罷鄉會試、製藝，而歲科試未變，廣仁激勵言官抗疏論之，得旨俞允。於是廣仁語有為：「今科舉既廢，宜且南歸興學專教育，俟養成多數有用才，數年後乃可云改革也。」有為不忍去。及初聞變，廣仁復趣有為歸。有為走，廣仁被逮。在獄言笑自若，臨刑猶言曰：「中國自強之機在此矣！」論曰：戊戌變法，德宗發憤圖強，用端棻等言，召用新進。百日維新，中外震仰，黨爭遽起，激成政變。銳、光第、嗣同、旭及深秀、廣仁同日被禍，世稱「六君子」，皆悲其志。

sourceRange.text: 陳寶箴，字右銘，江西義寧人。少負志節，詩文皆有法度，為曾國籓所器。以舉人隨父偉琳治鄉團，禦粵寇。已而走湖南，參易佩紳戎幕，軍來鳳、龍山間。石達開來犯，軍飢疲，走永順募糧，糧至不絕，守益堅，寇稍稍引去。寶箴之江西，為席寶田畫策殲寇洪福瑱，事寧，敘知府，超授河北道。創致用精舍，遴選三州學子，延名師教之。遷浙江按察使，坐事免。湖南巡撫王文韶薦其才，光緒十六年，召入都，除湖北按察使，署布政使。二十年，擢直隸布政使，入對，時中東戰亟，見上形容憂悴，請日讀聖祖御纂周易，以期變不失常。

sourceRange.text: 袁昶、許景澄之死，舉國稱冤，而桐則曰：「是死且有餘辜！」時其子承煜監刑，揚揚頗自得。承煜，字楠士。拔貢。以戶部小京官晉遷郎中，累官刑部左侍郎。已，聯軍入，桐倉皇失措，承煜請曰：「父芘拳匪，外人至，必不免，失大臣體。盍殉國？兒當從侍地下耳！」桐乃投繯死，年八十有二矣。而承煜遂亡走，為日軍所拘，置之順天府尹署，與啟秀俱明年正月正法。命下，日軍官置酒為餞，傳詔旨，承煜色變，口呼冤，痛詆西人不已。翼日，備輿送至菜市，監刑官出席禮之，已昏不知人矣，尋就戮。和議成，褫桐職，奪卹典，旋論棄市，以先死議免。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had entered by senior licentiate recommendation.

manualTranslations.literal: Before long the allied armies entered; Xu Tong was flustered and at a loss, and Chengyu urged: "Father sheltered the Boxer bandits; when foreigners arrive you cannot escape and will lose the dignity of a great minister.

manualTranslations.zh: 盍殉國？
manualTranslations.literal: Why not die for the state?

manualTranslations.zh: 兒當從侍地下耳！
manualTranslations.literal: Your son will follow and attend you in the grave!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your son will follow you to the grave!"

manualTranslations.literal: " Xu Tong then hanged himself; he was eighty-two.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Xu Tong hanged himself at the age of eighty-two.

manualTranslations.zh: 而承煜遂亡走，為日軍所拘，置之順天府尹署，與啟秀俱明年正月正法。
manualTranslations.literal: Chengyu then fled, was seized by the Japanese army, and was placed in the yamen of the prefect of Shuntian; he and Qi Xiu were both executed by lawful punishment in the first month of the following year.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chengyu fled but was seized by Japanese troops and held at the Shuntian prefect's yamen; he and Qi Xiu were executed the following first month.

manualTranslations.zh: 命下，日軍官置酒為餞，傳詔旨，承煜色變，口呼冤，痛詆西人不已。
manualTranslations.literal: When the order came down, a Japanese officer set out wine to send him off and transmitted the edict; Chengyu changed color, cried out his innocence, and bitterly denounced Westerners without cease.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the order came, a Japanese officer offered wine and read the edict; Chengyu turned pale, cried injustice, and bitterly denounced the Westerners.

manualTranslations.zh: 翼日，備輿送至菜市，監刑官出席禮之，已昏不知人矣，尋就戮。
manualTranslations.literal: The next day a carriage was prepared to send him to Caishikou; the supervising execution officer came out to salute him, but he was already unconscious; soon he was put to death.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next day he was taken to Caishikou; the execution officer saluted him, but he was already unconscious when he was killed.

manualTranslations.zh: 和議成，褫桐職，奪卹典，旋論棄市，以先死議免。
manualTranslations.literal: When peace was concluded Xu Tong's offices were stripped and mourning honors revoked; soon decapitation and public display were debated, but because he had died first the sentence was waived.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After peace was made Xu Tong's offices and mourning honors were revoked; public execution was debated but waived because he had already died.

sourceRange.text: 裕祿，字壽山，喜塔臘氏，滿洲正白旗人，湖北巡撫崇綸子。以刑部筆帖式歷官郎中。出為熱河兵備道，累遷安徽布政使。同治十三年，擢巡撫，年甫逾三十。前江南提督李世忠本降寇，罷職家居，所為橫恣，裕祿疏請誅之。會以事詣安慶，召飲署中，酒行，出密旨，麾眾縛斬之，而仍卹其家，人以是高其能。光緒十三年，遷湖廣總督，調兩江，復還鄂。廷議修鐵路，起盧溝訖漢口，下群臣議，裕祿力陳不可，忤旨。十五年，徙為盛京將軍。十七年，熱河奸民騷動，毀教堂，殺蒙人，裕祿會師朝陽，擊平之，予優敘。二十年秋，朝鮮亂起，奉天戒嚴，坐安東、鳳凰失守，數被議。明年，調福州，改授四川總督。二十四年，召為軍機大臣、禮部尚書兼總理各國事務衙門。會徵榮祿入樞廷，遂代之督直隸。義和拳起山東，入直境。初，義和會源出八卦教乾坎二系，聚黨直、魯間，為臨清郜生文餘孽，後稱團，專仇教。裕祿初頗持正論，主剿，捕其酋姚洛奇置之法。逾歲，開州傳舉烽，言匪復至，擒渠率斬以徇。居無何，毓賢撫山東，縱匪，匪散入河間、深、冀，而裕祿承風指，忽主撫。袁世凱方將武衛軍，語裕祿：「盍不請嚴旨捕治？」裕祿曰：「拳民無他伎，緩則自消，激則生變。且此委璅事，何煩瀆天聽邪？」已而毓賢去，世凱代之，自興兵疾擊，以故匪不敢近山東，而紛紛入畿疆矣。吳橋知縣勞乃宣禁傳習，為書上裕祿，格不行。時直隸官吏多信拳，布政使廷杰獨力主剿辦，嚴定州縣查緝拳匪懲戒辦法。遽奉詔開缺回京，匪愈橫。張德成居獨流，稱「舉國第一壇」，曹福田為津匪魁，二人者炫神術，為妄妖言相煽誘，裕祿不之問。已，复致書請餉二十萬，自任滅外人，裕祿馳檄召之，於是二人出入節署，與裕祿抗禮。當是時，津城拳匪至可三萬人，呼嘯周衢市，又以紅燈照熒眾，每入夜，家家懸紅燈，謂「迎仙姑」。頃之，各國兵艦大集，匪猶群聚督轅求槍砲，裕祿命詣軍械所任自擇，盡攫以去。而聯軍絡繹登岸，索大沽砲台，裕祿懼，疏告急，請敕董福祥來援。聯軍索益堅，提督羅榮光不允，戰失利，而裕祿且上天津團民殺敵狀，於是朝廷以團民為可恃，宣戰詔書遂下，而不知大沽已先數日失矣。裕祿又報大捷，盛張拳匪功，發帑金十萬犒團，更薦德成、福田於朝，飾戰狀，獲賞頭品秩、花翎、黃馬褂。事急，官軍戰車站，敗績，裕祿退保北倉。閱三日，城陷，德成、福田挾貲走，卒係而罪之。裕祿飛章自劾，詔革職留任。踰月，北倉失，裕祿又退楊村，遂自殺。

manualTranslations.zh: 裕祿，字壽山，喜塔臘氏，滿洲正白旗人，湖北巡撫崇綸子。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Lu, styled Shoushan, of the Xitala clan, was a man of the Plain White Banner of the Manchus and son of Hubei Governor Chonglun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Lu, whose style was Shoushan, of the Xitala clan, came from the Plain White Banner; his father was Hubei Governor Chonglun.

manualTranslations.zh: 以刑部筆帖式歷官郎中。
manualTranslations.literal: Starting as a clerk in the Ministry of Justice, he rose through the posts to director.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He rose from clerk in the Ministry of Justice to director.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為熱河兵備道，累遷安徽布政使。
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as military intendant of Rehe and was promoted step by step to provincial treasurer of Anhui.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He served as military intendant of Rehe, then rose to provincial treasurer of Anhui.

manualTranslations.zh: 同治十三年，擢巡撫，年甫逾三十。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tongzhi he was promoted to governor; he had just passed thirty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1874 he was appointed governor at just over thirty.

manualTranslations.zh: 前江南提督李世忠本降寇，罷職家居，所為橫恣，裕祿疏請誅之。
manualTranslations.literal: Former Jiangnan Regional Commander Li Shizhong had originally been a surrendered bandit; dismissed and living at home, his conduct was violent and overbearing, and Yu Lu memorialized requesting his execution.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Former Jiangnan commander Li Shizhong, a former surrendered rebel living in retirement, behaved with violent arrogance; Yu Lu memorialized for his execution.

manualTranslations.zh: 會以事詣安慶，召飲署中，酒行，出密旨，麾眾縛斬之，而仍卹其家，人以是高其能。
manualTranslations.literal: When he happened to go to Anqing on business, Li was summoned to drink in the yamen; as the wine was served a secret edict was produced and the crowd was ordered to bind and behead him, yet his family was still granted relief; people therefore admired his ability.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yu Lu visited Anqing on business, Li was summoned to the yamen; wine was served, a secret edict produced, and Li was bound and beheaded—yet his family still received relief, and people admired Yu Lu's resolve.

manualTranslations.zh: 光緒十三年，遷湖廣總督，調兩江，復還鄂。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu he was transferred to Viceroy of Huguang, then to the Two Jiangs, and then returned again to Hubei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1887 he became viceroy of Huguang, was transferred to the Two Jiangs, then returned to Hubei.

manualTranslations.zh: 廷議修鐵路，起盧溝訖漢口，下群臣議，裕祿力陳不可，忤旨。
manualTranslations.literal: The court debated building a railway from Lugou Bridge to Hankou and referred it to all officials for discussion; Yu Lu strongly argued it could not be done and offended the throne.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the court debated a railway from Lugou Bridge to Hankou, Yu Lu strongly opposed it and offended the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 十五年，徙為盛京將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was moved to be general of Mukden.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1889 he was transferred to general of Mukden.

manualTranslations.zh: 十七年，熱河奸民騷動，毀教堂，殺蒙人，裕祿會師朝陽，擊平之，予優敘。
manualTranslations.literal: In the seventeenth year ruffians in Rehe stirred up trouble, destroyed churches, and killed Mongols; Yu Lu gathered troops at Chaoyang, struck and pacified them, and received preferential commendation.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1891 Rehe ruffians destroyed churches and killed Mongols; Yu Lu assembled troops at Chaoyang, suppressed them, and earned commendation.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十年秋，朝鮮亂起，奉天戒嚴，坐安東、鳳凰失守，數被議。
manualTranslations.literal: In the autumn of the twentieth year turmoil broke out in Korea and Fengtian was placed under martial law; because Andong and Fenghuang were lost he was repeatedly criticized.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the autumn of 1894 Korean turmoil led to martial law in Fengtian; the loss of Andong and Fenghuang brought repeated censure.

manualTranslations.zh: 明年，調福州，改授四川總督。
manualTranslations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Fuzhou and then appointed Viceroy of Sichuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The following year he was posted to Fuzhou, then made viceroy of Sichuan.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十四年，召為軍機大臣、禮部尚書兼總理各國事務衙門。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was summoned as Grand Councilor, Minister of Rites, and concurrently head of the Zongli Yamen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1898 he was recalled as grand councilor, Minister of Rites, and head of the Zongli Yamen.

manualTranslations.zh: 會徵榮祿入樞廷，遂代之督直隸。
manualTranslations.literal: When Ronglu was summoned into the Grand Council, Yu Lu replaced him as Viceroy of Zhili.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Ronglu entered the Grand Council, Yu Lu replaced him as viceroy of Zhili.

manualTranslations.zh: 義和拳起山東，入直境。
manualTranslations.literal: The Boxers rose in Shandong and entered Zhili territory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Boxers rose in Shandong and entered Zhili.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，義和會源出八卦教乾坎二系，聚黨直、魯間，為臨清郜生文餘孽，後稱團，專仇教。
manualTranslations.literal: At first the Boxer association sprang from the Qian and Kan branches of the Eight Trigrams teaching, gathered followers between Zhili and Shandong, were remnants of Gao Shengwen of Linqing, and later styled themselves militia, specializing in hatred of Christianity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The movement sprang from the Qian and Kan branches of the Eight Trigrams teaching, gathered followers in Zhili and Shandong, descended from Gao Shengwen of Linqing, and styled themselves militia devoted to anti-Christian violence.

manualTranslations.zh: 裕祿初頗持正論，主剿，捕其酋姚洛奇置之法。
manualTranslations.literal: At first Yu Lu rather held correct views, favored suppression, captured their chieftain Yao Luoqi, and put him to the law.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first Yu Lu favored suppression, captured chieftain Yao Luoqi, and executed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 逾歲，開州傳舉烽，言匪復至，擒渠率斬以徇。
manualTranslations.literal: After a year Kaizhou reported beacon fires, saying the bandits had returned; the leaders were seized and beheaded as a warning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A year later Kaizhou reported bandits returning; leaders were seized and beheaded as a warning.

manualTranslations.zh: 居無何，毓賢撫山東，縱匪，匪散入河間、深、冀，而裕祿承風指，忽主撫。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long Yu Xian governed Shandong and indulged the bandits; the bandits scattered into Hejian, Shenzhou, and Jizhou, and Yu Lu, following the prevailing wind, suddenly favored appeasement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon Yu Xian governed Shandong and indulged the Boxers; they spread into Hejian, Shenzhou, and Jizhou, and Yu Lu suddenly turned to appeasement.

manualTranslations.zh: 袁世凱方將武衛軍，語裕祿：「盍不請嚴旨捕治？
manualTranslations.literal: Yuan Shikai was then commanding the Wuwei Army and said to Yu Lu: "Why not request a stern edict to capture and punish them?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yuan Shikai, commanding the Wuwei Army, asked Yu Lu: "Why not request a stern edict to capture and punish them?

manualTranslations.zh: 」裕祿曰：「拳民無他伎，緩則自消，激則生變。
manualTranslations.literal: " Yu Lu said: "The Boxer people have no other skills; if treated gently they will dissipate on their own, but if provoked they will breed disorder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Yu Lu replied: "The Boxers have no other arts; if handled gently they will fade, but provocation will breed disorder.

manualTranslations.zh: 且此委璅事，何煩瀆天聽邪？
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover this is a petty trifling matter—why trouble Heaven's ear?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Besides, this petty matter hardly warrants troubling the throne."

manualTranslations.zh: 」已而毓賢去，世凱代之，自興兵疾擊，以故匪不敢近山東，而紛紛入畿疆矣。
manualTranslations.literal: " Before long Yu Xian left and Yuan Shikai replaced him; he himself raised troops and struck swiftly, so the bandits did not dare approach Shandong but poured into the capital region.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Yu Xian departed and Yuan Shikai replaced him, striking hard so the Boxers avoided Shandong but flooded the capital region.

manualTranslations.zh: 吳橋知縣勞乃宣禁傳習，為書上裕祿，格不行。
manualTranslations.literal: Lao Naixuan, magistrate of Wuqiao, forbade transmission and practice and wrote a letter to Yu Lu, but it was blocked and not carried out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wuqiao Magistrate Lao Naixuan forbade Boxer practice and wrote to Yu Lu, but the letter was blocked.

manualTranslations.zh: 時直隸官吏多信拳，布政使廷杰獨力主剿辦，嚴定州縣查緝拳匪懲戒辦法。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time most officials in Zhili believed in the Boxers; only the provincial treasurer Ting Jie alone insisted on suppression and strictly fixed methods for counties and prefectures to search out and punish Boxer bandits.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Most Zhili officials then believed in the Boxers; only Provincial Treasurer Ting Jie insisted on suppression and laid down strict county-level measures to hunt and punish them.

manualTranslations.zh: 遽奉詔開缺回京，匪愈橫。
manualTranslations.literal: He was suddenly ordered by edict to vacate his post and return to the capital; the bandits grew still more arrogant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict suddenly recalled him to Beijing, and the Boxers grew bolder still.

manualTranslations.zh: 張德成居獨流，稱「舉國第一壇」，曹福田為津匪魁，二人者炫神術，為妄妖言相煽誘，裕祿不之問。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang Decheng dwelt at Duliang, styled "the foremost altar in the realm," and Cao Futian was chieftain of the Tianjin bandits; the two men boasted of divine arts and incited one another with wild demonic talk, yet Yu Lu did not question them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang Decheng at Duliang styled himself head of "the foremost altar in the realm," and Cao Futian led the Tianjin Boxers; they traded boasts of magic and sedition, and Yu Lu looked the other way.

manualTranslations.zh: 已，复致書請餉二十萬，自任滅外人，裕祿馳檄召之，於是二人出入節署，與裕祿抗禮。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long they again wrote requesting two hundred thousand taels in funds, undertaking themselves to destroy the foreigners; Yu Lu sent urgent dispatches summoning them, and thereafter the two men came and went at the governor's yamen, treating him as an equal in ceremony.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They soon demanded two hundred thousand taels, promising to destroy the foreigners; Yu Lu summoned them by urgent dispatch, and thereafter they came and went at his yamen as his equals.

manualTranslations.zh: 當是時，津城拳匪至可三萬人，呼嘯周衢市，又以紅燈照熒眾，每入夜，家家懸紅燈，謂「迎仙姑」。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the Boxers in Tianjin may have reached thirty thousand; they roared through the streets and markets; moreover the Red Lantern Society inflamed the masses, and each night every household hung red lamps, saying they were "welcoming the Immortal Maiden."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Boxers in Tianjin may have numbered thirty thousand, roaring through the streets; the Red Lantern Society stirred the crowds, and every night households hung red lamps to "welcome the Immortal Maiden."

manualTranslations.zh: 頃之，各國兵艦大集，匪猶群聚督轅求槍砲，裕祿命詣軍械所任自擇，盡攫以去。
manualTranslations.literal: Before long the warships of the various nations gathered in force; the bandits still thronged the governor's yamen demanding guns and cannon; Yu Lu ordered them to the arsenal to choose as they pleased, and they seized everything and left.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Soon foreign warships massed offshore, yet the Boxers still crowded the governor's yamen demanding arms; Yu Lu sent them to the arsenal to take what they wanted, and they carried everything away.

manualTranslations.zh: 而聯軍絡繹登岸，索大沽砲台，裕祿懼，疏告急，請敕董福祥來援。
manualTranslations.literal: Meanwhile the allied armies landed in an unbroken stream and demanded the Dagu forts; Yu Lu was afraid, memorialized in urgent alarm, and requested an edict summoning Dong Fuxiang to aid.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Allied troops landed in force and demanded the Dagu forts; terrified, Yu Lu sent urgent memorials begging the throne to summon Dong Fuxiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 聯軍索益堅，提督羅榮光不允，戰失利，而裕祿且上天津團民殺敵狀，於是朝廷以團民為可恃，宣戰詔書遂下，而不知大沽已先數日失矣。
manualTranslations.literal: The allies pressed their demands more firmly; Regional Commander Luo Rongguang refused; battle was lost; and Yu Lu moreover reported the Tianjin militia's enemy kills, whereupon the court regarded the militia as reliable and the declaration of war was issued—not knowing Dagu had already fallen several days earlier.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The allies pressed harder; Regional Commander Luo Rongguang refused and was defeated; Yu Lu reported Tianjin militia kills, and the court issued a declaration of war—unaware Dagu had already fallen days before.

manualTranslations.zh: 裕祿又報大捷，盛張拳匪功，發帑金十萬犒團，更薦德成、福田於朝，飾戰狀，獲賞頭品秩、花翎、黃馬褂。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Lu again reported a great victory, lavishly extolled the Boxers' merit, disbursed one hundred thousand taels from the treasury to reward the militia, further recommended Decheng and Futian to the court, embellished battle reports, and they received rewards of first-rank titles, peacock feathers, and yellow riding jackets.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Lu reported great victory, lavished rewards on the Boxers, recommended Decheng and Futian to the court, and they received top honors.

manualTranslations.zh: 事急，官軍戰車站，敗績，裕祿退保北倉。
manualTranslations.literal: As matters grew urgent government troops fought at the railway station and were defeated; Yu Lu retreated to defend Beicang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Government troops fought at the railway station and were defeated; Yu Lu retreated to Beicang.

manualTranslations.zh: 閱三日，城陷，德成、福田挾貲走，卒係而罪之。
manualTranslations.literal: After three days the city fell; Decheng and Futian fled with their loot but were eventually seized and punished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Three days later the city fell; Decheng and Futian fled with their loot but were eventually seized and punished.

manualTranslations.zh: 裕祿飛章自劾，詔革職留任。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Lu sent a flying memorial impeaching himself; an edict stripped him of office but kept him on duty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Lu urgently memorialized to impeach himself; the throne stripped his rank but left him in post.

manualTranslations.zh: 踰月，北倉失，裕祿又退楊村，遂自殺。
manualTranslations.literal: After a month Beicang was lost; he retreated again to Yangcun, and then committed suicide.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A month later Beicang fell; he retreated to Yangcun and took his own life.

sourceRange.text: 官至烏魯木齊都統，以講學為桐所傾服。方太后議廢帝，立端王載漪子溥儁為「大阿哥」，桐主之甚力，實皆豫師本謀也。既而桐被命照料，益親載漪。各國不慊載漪等所為，漪恚甚，圖報復。二十六年，義和拳起釁仇外，載漪大喜，導之入都。桐謂：「中國當自此強矣！

localRange.text: 官至都統，以講學為所傾服。方太后議廢帝，立子為「大阿哥」，主之甚力，實皆本謀也。既而被命照料，益親。各國不慊等所為，恚甚，圖報復。二十六年，起釁仇外，大喜，導之入都。謂：「當自此強矣！

sourceRange.text: 匪浸熾，法使詰總署，乃徵還。至則謁端王載漪、莊王載勛、大學士剛毅，盛言拳民忠勇得神助。俄拜山西巡撫之命，於是拳術漸被山西。平陽府縣上書言匪事，毓賢痛斥之，匪益熾。毓賢更命製鋼刀數百，賜拳童令演習，其酋出入撫署，款若上賓。居無何，朝旨申命保教民，毓賢陽遵旨，行下各縣文書稠疊，教士咸感悅。

localRange.text: 匪浸熾，使詰總署，乃徵還。至則謁、、大學士，盛言民忠勇得神助。俄拜巡撫之命，於是術漸被。府縣上書言匪事，痛斥之，匪益熾。更命製鋼刀數百，賜拳童令演習，其酋出入撫署，款若上賓。居無何，朝旨申命保教民，陽遵旨，行下各縣文書稠疊，教士咸感悅。

sourceRange.text: 廷雍，字邵民，滿洲正紅旗人。以貢生累官直隸布政使。裕祿死，護總督。聯軍入保定，被執，並及諸士紳。各軍訊其事，雍曰：「保紳夙從令，可釋，事皆由我。今至此，斧鉞由汝，奚問為？」遂見殺。郡人尚多哀之。毓賢，字佐臣，內務府正黃旗漢軍。監生。以同知納貲為山東知府。光緒十四年，署曹州，善治盜，不憚斬戮。以巡撫張曜奏薦，得實授，累遷按察使，權布政使。二十四年，調補湖南，署江寧將軍。裁革陋規萬餘兩，上聞而嘉之。是時李秉衡撫山東，適有大刀會仇西教，秉衡獎借之，戕德國二教士。廷議以毓賢官魯久，諳河務，擢代之。既蒞事，護大刀會尤力。匪首朱紅燈搆亂，倡言滅教。毓賢令知府盧昌詒按問，匪擊殺官軍數十人，自稱義和拳。

localRange.text: 是時撫，適有仇西教，獎借之，戕二教士。廷議以官久，諳河務，擢代之。既蒞事，護尤力。匪首搆亂，倡言滅教。令知府按問，匪擊殺官軍數十人，自稱。

manualTranslations.zh: 廷雍，字邵民，滿洲正紅旗人。
manualTranslations.literal: Ting Yong, styled Shaomin, was a man of the Plain Red Banner of the Manchus.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ting Yong, whose style was Shaomin, came from the Plain Red Banner of the Manchus.

manualTranslations.zh: 以貢生累官直隸布政使。
manualTranslations.literal: A senior licentiate, he rose through the posts to provincial treasurer of Zhili.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A senior licentiate, he rose to provincial treasurer of Zhili.

manualTranslations.zh: 裕祿死，護總督。
manualTranslations.literal: When Yu Lu died he acted as governor-general.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yu Lu died he served as acting governor-general.

manualTranslations.zh: 聯軍入保定，被執，並及諸士紳。
manualTranslations.literal: When the allied armies entered Baoding he was seized, and gentry and scholars were implicated as well.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the allies entered Baoding he was seized along with local gentry and scholars.

manualTranslations.zh: 各軍訊其事，雍曰：「保紳夙從令，可釋，事皆由我。
manualTranslations.literal: The various armies interrogated him about the affair; Yong said: "The Baoding gentry have long followed orders and may be released; the affair is all my doing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The allied commanders interrogated him; Ting Yong said: "The Baoding gentry have long obeyed orders and may go free; the blame is mine alone.

manualTranslations.zh: 今至此，斧鉞由汝，奚問為？
manualTranslations.literal: Now that I have come to this, the axe is in your hands—why ask further?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I am here; the axe is yours—what more is there to ask?"

manualTranslations.zh: 」遂見殺。
manualTranslations.literal: " He was then killed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " He was then executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 郡人尚多哀之。
manualTranslations.literal: People of the prefecture still largely mourned him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Many in the prefecture mourned him.

manualTranslations.zh: 毓賢，字佐臣，內務府正黃旗漢軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Xian, styled Zuochen, was of the Plain Yellow Banner Han Chinese in the Imperial Household Department.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Xian, whose style was Zuochen, served in the Imperial Household Department as a member of the Plain Yellow Banner Han Chinese.

manualTranslations.zh: 監生。
manualTranslations.literal: A student of the Imperial University.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He held student status at the Imperial University.

manualTranslations.zh: 以同知納貲為山東知府。
manualTranslations.literal: By purchasing office as subprefect he became prefect of Shandong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He purchased office as subprefect and became prefect of Shandong.

manualTranslations.zh: 光緒十四年，署曹州，善治盜，不憚斬戮。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu he acted as prefect of Caozhou, was skilled at controlling bandits, and did not shrink from execution.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1888 he served as acting prefect of Caozhou, suppressed bandits effectively, and did not shrink from executions.

manualTranslations.zh: 以巡撫張曜奏薦，得實授，累遷按察使，權布政使。
manualTranslations.literal: Because Governor Zhang Yao memorialized recommending him, he received substantive appointment and was promoted step by step to surveillance commissioner and acting provincial treasurer.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Governor Zhang Yao recommended him for substantive appointment; he rose to surveillance commissioner and acting provincial treasurer.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十四年，調補湖南，署江寧將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to Hunan and acted as general of Jiangning.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1898 he was transferred to Hunan and acted as general of Jiangning.

manualTranslations.zh: 裁革陋規萬餘兩，上聞而嘉之。
manualTranslations.literal: He abolished corrupt customary fees totaling more than ten thousand taels; when the throne heard of it he was commended.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He abolished corrupt customary fees exceeding ten thousand taels and earned imperial praise.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時李秉衡撫山東，適有大刀會仇西教，秉衡獎借之，戕德國二教士。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Li Bingheng was governor of Shandong; there happened to be hostility toward Western religion in the Big Sword Society, and he encouraged and indulged it, killing two German missionaries.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Bingheng was then governor of Shandong; anti-Christian sentiment ran high in the Big Sword Society, and he encouraged it, resulting in the killing of two German missionaries.

manualTranslations.zh: 廷議以毓賢官魯久，諳河務，擢代之。
manualTranslations.literal: The court considered that Yu Xian had long served in Shandong and understood river works, and promoted him to replace him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court judged Yu Xian's long service in Shandong and knowledge of river works qualified him, and appointed him in Li's place.

manualTranslations.zh: 既蒞事，護大刀會尤力。
manualTranslations.literal: Once he took up affairs he protected the Big Sword Society with especial force.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once in office he shielded the Big Sword Society more zealously than ever.

manualTranslations.zh: 匪首朱紅燈搆亂，倡言滅教。
manualTranslations.literal: The bandit chieftain Zhu Hongdeng stirred disorder and preached destroying Christianity.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The rebel leader Zhu Hongdeng stirred up trouble and preached the extermination of Christianity.

manualTranslations.zh: 毓賢令知府盧昌詒按問，匪擊殺官軍數十人，自稱義和拳。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu Xian ordered Prefect Lu Changyi to investigate; the bandits killed several dozen government troops and styled themselves the Boxer militia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Xian ordered Prefect Lu Changyi to investigate; the rebels killed dozens of government troops and proclaimed themselves the Boxer militia.

sourceRange.text: 及事敗，各國議懲首禍，徐桐等皆不能免。

sourceRange.text: 道光三十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。坐修改中卷干磨勘，罷職。咸豐十年，特賞檢討，協修文宗實錄。同治初，命在上書房行走，奉懿旨番講治平寶鑑，入直弘德殿，累遷侍講學士。先後疏請習政事、勤修省，成大學衍義體要以進。數擢至禮部侍郎。念外人麕集京師，和議難恃，宜壹意修攘圖自強；因條上簡才能、結民心、裕度支、修邊備四策。光緒初，授禮部尚書，加太子少保。主事吳可讀請豫定大統，以屍諫，桐與翁同龢等謂其未悉本朝家法：「當申明列聖不建儲彝訓，俾知他日紹膺大寶之元良，即為承繼穆宗之聖子。揆諸前諭則合，準諸家法則符。」疏入，詔存毓慶宮備覽。時崇厚擅訂俄約，下群臣議，乃條摘其不可行者：曰伊、塔各城定界；曰新疆、蒙古通商；

manualTranslations.zh: 徐桐，字蔭軒，漢軍正藍旗人，尚書澤醇子。
manualTranslations.literal: Xu Tong, styled Yinxuan, was a man of the Plain Blue Banner of the Han Chinese Banners and son of Minister Ze Chun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xu Tong, whose style was Yinxuan, came from the Plain Blue Banner of the Han Chinese Banners; his father was Minister Ze Chun.

manualTranslations.zh: 道光三十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
manualTranslations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Daoguang he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a bachelor of the Hanlin, and appointed compiler.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1850 he took his jinshi degree, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed compiler.

manualTranslations.zh: 坐修改中卷干磨勘，罷職。
manualTranslations.literal: Because he altered the middle scroll in an examination and was caught in a review, he was dismissed from office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was dismissed after altering an examination middle scroll and being caught in a review.

manualTranslations.zh: 咸豐十年，特賞檢討，協修文宗實錄。
manualTranslations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he was specially granted the post of reviser and helped compile the Veritable Records of Emperor Wenzong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 1860 he was specially made a reviser and helped compile the Veritable Records of Emperor Wenzong.

manualTranslations.zh: 同治初，命在上書房行走，奉懿旨番講治平寶鑑，入直弘德殿，累遷侍講學士。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Tongzhi he was ordered to serve in the Upper Study Halls, received an empress-dowager edict to lecture on the Mirror of Governance and Tranquility, entered duty at Hongde Hall, and was promoted step by step to expositor of the Hanlin Academy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Tongzhi reign he served in the Upper Study Halls, lectured on the Mirror of Governance and Tranquility by empress-dowager order, entered duty at Hongde Hall, and rose to expositor of the Hanlin Academy.

manualTranslations.zh: 先後疏請習政事、勤修省，成大學衍義體要以進。
manualTranslations.literal: He repeatedly memorialized to study state affairs and practice diligent self-examination, and completed the Essentials of the Great Learning in Outline to present.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He repeatedly urged study of government and diligent self-examination, and presented his Essentials of the Great Learning in Outline.

manualTranslations.zh: 數擢至禮部侍郎。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted several times to Vice Minister of Rites.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted several times to Vice Minister of Rites.

manualTranslations.zh: 念外人麕集京師，和議難恃，宜壹意修攘圖自強；
manualTranslations.literal: Reflecting that foreigners thronged the capital and peace negotiations could not be relied on, he held that one should concentrate on strengthening defenses and plotting self-strengthening;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Seeing foreigners massed in the capital and treaties unreliable, he argued the court should focus on defense and self-strengthening;

manualTranslations.zh: 因條上簡才能、結民心、裕度支、修邊備四策。
manualTranslations.literal: he therefore itemized four policies: selecting talent, binding popular hearts, expanding revenue, and repairing frontier defenses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he proposed four policies: appointing capable men, winning popular support, strengthening finances, and repairing frontier defenses.

manualTranslations.zh: 光緒初，授禮部尚書，加太子少保。
manualTranslations.literal: At the beginning of Guangxu he was appointed Minister of Rites and given the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in the Guangxu reign he became Minister of Rites with the additional title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

manualTranslations.zh: 主事吳可讀請豫定大統，以屍諫，桐與翁同龢等謂其未悉本朝家法：「當申明列聖不建儲彝訓，俾知他日紹膺大寶之元良，即為承繼穆宗之聖子。
manualTranslations.literal: Principal Clerk Wu Kedu requested that the succession be settled in advance and remonstrated with his corpse; Xu Tong and Weng Tonghe and others said he did not understand the house law of the dynasty: "The instruction of successive sages not to establish an heir in advance ought to be declared, so that people may know the heir apparent who will one day receive the great treasure is the sage son who will succeed Emperor Muzong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Principal Clerk Wu Kedu petitioned to settle the succession in advance and died remonstrating, Xu Tong and Weng Tonghe argued he misunderstood dynastic law: "The ancestral rule against naming an heir in advance should be reaffirmed, so all would know the heir who one day receives the throne is the son who succeeds Emperor Muzong.

manualTranslations.zh: 揆諸前諭則合，準諸家法則符。
manualTranslations.literal: Measured against earlier edicts it accords; judged by house law it conforms.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That accords with prior edicts and with house law.

manualTranslations.zh: 」疏入，詔存毓慶宮備覽。
manualTranslations.literal: " When the memorial entered, an edict ordered it kept in the Palace of Accumulated Celebration for reference.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " The memorial was filed and the throne ordered it kept in the Palace of Accumulated Celebration for reference.

manualTranslations.zh: 時崇厚擅訂俄約，下群臣議，乃條摘其不可行者：曰伊、塔各城定界；
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Chonghou had arbitrarily concluded a treaty with Russia; when it was referred to the court for discussion among all officials, [Xu Tong] itemized what could not be accepted: namely, fixing boundaries for the cities of Ili and Tarbagatai;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Chonghou took it upon himself to negotiate the Russian treaty, the matter was laid before the full court. Xu Tong listed the terms that could not be accepted: delimiting the cities of Ili and Tarbagatai;

manualTranslations.zh: 曰新疆、蒙古通商；
manualTranslations.literal: namely, opening trade in Xinjiang and Mongolia;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: opening trade in Xinjiang and Mongolia;

items.acceptedSourceText: 徐桐 剛毅 趙舒翹 啟秀 英年 裕祿 毓賢。徐桐，字蔭軒，漢軍正藍旗人，尚書澤醇子。道光三十年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。坐修改中卷干磨勘，罷職。咸豐十年，特賞檢討，協修文宗實錄。同治初，命在上書房行走，奉懿旨番講治平寶鑑，入直弘德殿，累遷侍講學士。先後疏請習政事、勤修省，成大學衍義體要以進。數擢至禮部侍郎。念外人麕集京師，和議難恃，宜壹意修攘圖自強；因條上簡才能、結民心、裕度支、修邊備四策。光緒初，授禮部尚書，加太子少保。主事吳可讀請豫定大統，以屍諫，桐與翁同龢等謂其未悉本朝家法：「當申明列聖不建儲彝訓，俾知他日紹膺大寶之元良，即為承繼穆宗之聖子。揆諸前諭則合，準諸家法則符。」疏入，詔存毓慶宮備覽。時崇厚擅訂俄約，下群臣議，乃條摘其不可行者：曰伊、塔各城定界；曰新疆、蒙古通商；

sourceRange.text: 聯軍既陷天津，毓賢請勤王，未及行，朝旨趣之再。兩宮已西幸，毓賢遇諸塗，遂隨扈行。和議成，聯軍指索罪魁，中外大臣復交章論劾，始褫職，戍新疆。十二月，行抵甘肅，而正法命下。時李廷簫權甘督。廷簫，籍湖北黃安。以進士累官山西布政使，嘗附毓賢縱匪。至是得旨，持告毓賢，毓賢曰：「死，吾分也，如執事何？」廷簫慮譴及，元旦仰藥死。蘭州士民為毓賢呼冤，將集眾代請命，毓賢移書止之。其母留太原，年八十餘矣。一妾從行，令自裁。逾數日，伏誅未殊，連呼求速死，有僕助斷其頸，為斂而葬之。論曰：戊戌政變後，廢立議起，患外人為梗，遂欲仇之，而庚子拳匪之亂乘機作矣。

localRange.text: 聯軍既陷，請勤王，未及行，朝旨趣之再。兩宮已西幸，遇諸塗，遂隨扈行。和議成，聯軍指索罪魁，中外大臣復交章論劾，始褫職，戍。十二月，行抵，而正法命下。時權督。論曰：戊戌政變後，廢立議起，患外人為梗，遂欲仇之，而庚子匪之亂乘機作矣。

context.beforeSource: 遽出，坐堂皇，呼七十餘人者至，令自承悔教，教民不肯承，乃悉率出斬之，婦孺就死，呼號聲不忍聞。
context.afterSource: 太后信其術，思倚以鋤敵而立威。

manualTranslations.zh: 聯軍既陷天津，毓賢請勤王，未及行，朝旨趣之再。
manualTranslations.literal: After the allied armies took Tianjin Yu Xian requested to come to the throne's aid; before he could set out, imperial orders urged him twice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Tianjin fell Yu Xian asked to march to the emperor's aid; before he could depart, urgent orders from the court summoned him twice.

manualTranslations.zh: 兩宮已西幸，毓賢遇諸塗，遂隨扈行。
manualTranslations.literal: The two palaces had already gone west; he met them on the road and then followed the imperial procession.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The court had already fled west; he met the procession on the road and joined the flight.

manualTranslations.zh: 和議成，聯軍指索罪魁，中外大臣復交章論劾，始褫職，戍新疆。
manualTranslations.literal: When peace was concluded the allied armies pointed out and demanded the chief culprits; Chinese and foreign ministers again submitted joint memorials of impeachment; only then was he stripped of office and banished to Xinjiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After peace was made the allies demanded the ringleaders; Chinese and foreign ministers memorialized again; only then was he stripped of rank and exiled to Xinjiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月，行抵甘肅，而正法命下。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, as he reached Gansu on the journey, the order for lawful execution was issued.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, as he reached Gansu, the execution order came down.

manualTranslations.zh: 時李廷簫權甘督。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Li Tingxiao was acting governor of Gansu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Tingxiao was then acting governor of Gansu.

manualTranslations.zh: 廷簫，籍湖北黃安。
manualTranslations.literal: Tingxiao was a native of Huang'an in Hubei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Tingxiao was a native of Huang'an in Hubei.

manualTranslations.zh: 以進士累官山西布政使，嘗附毓賢縱匪。
manualTranslations.literal: A jinshi, he rose through the posts to provincial treasurer of Shanxi and had once abetted Yu Xian in indulging the bandits.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A jinshi, he rose to provincial treasurer of Shanxi and had once abetted Yu Xian in indulging the Boxers.

manualTranslations.zh: 至是得旨，持告毓賢，毓賢曰：「死，吾分也，如執事何？
manualTranslations.literal: At this time he received the order, took it and informed Yu Xian; Yu Xian said: "Death is my portion—what of your office?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He received the order and informed Yu Xian; Yu Xian said: "Death is my lot—what fault is yours?

manualTranslations.zh: 」廷簫慮譴及，元旦仰藥死。
manualTranslations.literal: " Tingxiao feared punishment would reach him and on New Year's Day took poison and died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Fearing punishment, Li Tingxiao took poison on New Year's Day and died.

manualTranslations.zh: 蘭州士民為毓賢呼冤，將集眾代請命，毓賢移書止之。
manualTranslations.literal: Gentry and commoners of Lanzhou cried injustice for Yu Xian and were about to gather a crowd to plead for his life; Yu Xian sent a letter stopping them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lanzhou gentry and commoners protested Yu Xian's innocence and were about to petition for his life; he sent a letter stopping them.

manualTranslations.zh: 其母留太原，年八十餘矣。
manualTranslations.literal: His mother remained in Taiyuan, more than eighty years old.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His mother remained in Taiyuan, over eighty years old.

manualTranslations.zh: 一妾從行，令自裁。
manualTranslations.literal: One concubine accompanied him on the journey; he ordered her to take her own life.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: One concubine accompanied him; he ordered her to kill herself.

manualTranslations.zh: 逾數日，伏誅未殊，連呼求速死，有僕助斷其頸，為斂而葬之。
manualTranslations.literal: After several days execution had not yet finished him; he repeatedly cried out begging for swift death; a servant helped break his neck, and he was laid out and buried.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Days later the execution had not finished him; he begged for swift death; a servant broke his neck, and he was buried.

manualTranslations.zh: 論曰：戊戌政變後，廢立議起，患外人為梗，遂欲仇之，而庚子拳匪之亂乘機作矣。
manualTranslations.literal: The commentator says: After the coup of 1898, debate over deposing the emperor and installing an heir arose; fearing foreigners as an obstruction, they wished to make them enemies, and the Boxer disturbance of 1900 seized the opportunity to break out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The historian comments: After the coup of 1898, the struggle over deposing the emperor revived; seeing foreigners as the obstacle, the court turned toward hostility, and the Boxer rising of 1900 erupted in that moment.

sourceRange.text: 二十二年，拜體仁閣大學士。桐崇宋儒說，守舊，惡西學如仇。門人言新政者，屏不令入謁。二十四年政變後，太后以其耆臣碩望，頗優禮，朝請令近侍扶掖以寵之。有豫師者，字錫之，內務府漢軍。

localRange.text: 二十二年，拜大學士。有者，字，內務府。

manualTranslations.zh: 二十二年，拜體仁閣大學士。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was appointed Grand Secretary of the Hall of Embodied Benevolence.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (1896) he was made grand secretary of the Hall of Embodied Benevolence.

manualTranslations.zh: 桐崇宋儒說，守舊，惡西學如仇。
manualTranslations.literal: Xu Tong revered Song Neo-Confucian doctrine, clung to the old ways, and hated Western learning as he would an enemy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xu Tong revered Song Neo-Confucianism, clung to the old ways, and hated Western learning like a mortal foe.

manualTranslations.zh: 門人言新政者，屏不令入謁。
manualTranslations.literal: Disciples who spoke of new policies he barred and would not receive in audience.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He barred disciples who advocated reform from his audience.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十四年政變後，太后以其耆臣碩望，頗優禮，朝請令近侍扶掖以寵之。
manualTranslations.literal: After the coup of the twenty-fourth year the Empress Dowager, because he was an aged minister of great reputation, treated him with especial favor and ordered attendants to support him at court as a mark of grace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After the 1898 coup the Empress Dowager favored this venerable statesman, ordering attendants to support him at court.

manualTranslations.zh: 有豫師者，字錫之，內務府漢軍。
manualTranslations.literal: There was Yu Shi, styled Xizhi, of the Han Chinese Banner in the Imperial Household Department.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yu Shi, whose style was Xizhi, served in the Imperial Household Department as a member of the Han Chinese Banner.

manualTranslations.zh: 權衡重輕，天人交迫，不得已允如所奏，於宣統九年1917年五月十三日臨朝聽政，收回大權，與民更始。
manualTranslations.literal: Weighing what is heavy and light, pressed by Heaven and men alike, We have no choice but to grant the request as memorialized; on the thirteenth day of the fifth month in the ninth year of Xuantong (1917) We shall attend court and resume rule, reclaim great authority, and make a new beginning with the people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Weighing what matters most, pressed by Heaven and men alike, I have no choice but to grant the request as memorialized; on the thirteenth day of the fifth month in the ninth year of Xuantong (1917) I shall attend court and resume rule, reclaim supreme authority, and make a new beginning with the people.

sourceRange.text: 宣統三年，鄂變作，始開黨禁，戊戌政變獲咎者悉原之，於是有為出亡十餘年矣，始謀歸國。時民軍決行共和，廷議主立憲，而有為創虛君共和之議，以「中國帝制行已數千年，不可驟變，而大清得國最正，歷朝德澤淪浹人心，存帝號以統五族，弭亂息爭，莫順於此」。內閣總理大臣袁世凱徇民軍請，決改共和，遂下遜位之詔。有為知空言不足挽阻，思結握兵柄者以自重，頗遊說當局，數年無所就。丁巳民國六年，1917，張勛復辟，以有為為弼德院副院長。勳議行君主立憲，有為仍主虛君共和。事變，有為避美國使館，旋脫歸上海。甲子民國十三年，1924，移宮事起，修改優待條件，有為馳電以爭，略曰：「優待條件，系大清皇帝與民國臨時政府議定，永久有效，由英使保證，並用正式公文通告各國，以昭大信，無異國際條約。

localRange.text: 甲子，移宮事起，修改優待條件，有為馳電以爭，略曰：「優待條件，系大清皇帝與民國臨時政府議定，永久有效，由英使保證，並用正式公文通告各國，以昭大信，無異國際條約。

manualTranslations.zh: 宣統三年，鄂變作，始開黨禁，戊戌政變獲咎者悉原之，於是有為出亡十餘年矣，始謀歸國。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, when the Hubei revolt broke out, the ban on political associations was first lifted; all who had been punished in the Wuxu coup were pardoned; thus Kang Youwei, who had been in exile for more than ten years, now planned to return home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuantong (1911), when the Hubei uprising broke out, the ban on political associations was lifted and all those punished in the Wuxu coup were pardoned. Kang Youwei, who had been in exile for more than ten years, now planned to return home.

manualTranslations.zh: 時民軍決行共和，廷議主立憲，而有為創虛君共和之議，以「中國帝制行已數千年，不可驟變，而大清得國最正，歷朝德澤淪浹人心，存帝號以統五族，弭亂息爭，莫順於此」。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the revolutionary armies resolved on a republic; court debate favored constitutional monarchy; Kang Youwei proposed the doctrine of republic with a powerless monarch, arguing: "China's imperial system has lasted for thousands of years and cannot be changed abruptly; yet the Great Qing gained the realm most rightfully, and the virtue of successive reigns has permeated the people's hearts. To preserve the imperial title to unite the five peoples and quell strife is the most fitting course."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the time the revolutionary armies resolved on a republic while court debate favored constitutional monarchy, Kang Youwei advanced the plan of a republic under a powerless monarch, arguing: "China's imperial system has lasted for thousands of years and cannot be changed abruptly; yet the Great Qing gained the realm most legitimately, and the virtue of successive reigns has permeated the people's hearts. Preserving the imperial title to unite the five peoples and still contention is the most fitting course."

manualTranslations.zh: 內閣總理大臣袁世凱徇民軍請，決改共和，遂下遜位之詔。
manualTranslations.literal: Prime Minister Yuan Shikai of the Grand Council yielded to the revolutionary armies' request, decided to adopt a republic, and issued the abdication edict.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor and Prime Minister Yuan Shikai yielded to the revolutionary armies' demand, decided to adopt a republic, and issued the abdication edict.

manualTranslations.zh: 有為知空言不足挽阻，思結握兵柄者以自重，頗遊說當局，數年無所就。
manualTranslations.literal: Kang Youwei knew empty words could not hold back the tide; he thought to ally with those who held military power to strengthen his position, and frequently lobbied those in authority, but for several years achieved nothing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kang knew that words alone could not hold back the tide. He sought alliances with military leaders to strengthen his position and lobbied those in power for years, but achieved nothing.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁巳民國六年，1917，張勛復辟，以有為為弼德院副院長。
manualTranslations.literal: In the dingsi year, the sixth year of the Republic, 1917, Zhang Xun restored the throne; Kang Youwei was made vice president of the Palace Lectures Institute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the dingsi year, the sixth year of the Republic (1917), Zhang Xun restored the monarchy and made Kang Youwei vice president of the Palace Lectures Institute.

manualTranslations.zh: 勳議行君主立憲，有為仍主虛君共和。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhang argued for constitutional monarchy; Kang still advocated republic under a powerless monarch.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhang argued for constitutional monarchy; Kang still advocated a republic under a powerless monarch.

manualTranslations.zh: 事變，有為避美國使館，旋脫歸上海。
manualTranslations.literal: When the affair collapsed, Kang took refuge in the American legation, then escaped and returned to Shanghai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the restoration collapsed, Kang took refuge in the American legation, then escaped and returned to Shanghai.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲子民國十三年，1924，移宮事起，修改優待條件，有為馳電以爭，略曰：「優待條件，系大清皇帝與民國臨時政府議定，永久有效，由英使保證，並用正式公文通告各國，以昭大信，無異國際條約。
manualTranslations.literal: In the jiazi year, the thirteenth year of the Republic, 1924, when the palace removal arose and the terms of favorable treatment were revised, Kang sent an urgent telegram in protest, which in summary read: "The terms of favorable treatment were agreed between the Great Qing emperor and the provisional government of the Republic, permanently valid, guaranteed by the British minister, and formally notified to all countries by official document to manifest great faith, no different from an international treaty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the jiazi year, the thirteenth year of the Republic (1924), when the palace was to be moved and the terms of favorable treatment were revised, Kang sent an urgent telegram of protest. In essence he wrote: "The terms of favorable treatment were agreed between the Qing emperor and the Republic's provisional government. They were meant to remain permanently valid, guaranteed by the British minister and formally notified to all nations—no different from an international treaty.

sourceRange.text: 伯行自有傳，沐見〈循吏傳〉，克勤附〈李來章傳〉。黃宗羲，字太沖，餘姚人，明御史黃尊素長子。尊素為楊、左同志，以劾魏閹死詔獄，事具明史。思宗即位，宗羲入都訟冤。至則逆閹已磔，即具疏請誅曹欽程、李實。會廷鞫許顯純、崔應元，宗羲對簿，出所袖錐錐顯純，流血被體；又毆應元，拔其鬚歸祭尊素神主前；又追殺牢卒葉咨、顏文仲，蓋尊素絕命於二卒手也。時欽程已入逆案，實疏辨原疏非己出，陰致金三千求宗羲弗質，宗羲立奏之，謂：「實今日猶能賄賂公行，其所辨豈足信？」於對簿時復以錐錐之。獄竟，偕諸家子弟設祭獄門，哭聲達禁中。思宗聞之，歎曰：「忠臣孤子，甚惻朕懷。」歸，益肆力於學。憤科舉之學錮人，思所以變之。既，盡發家藏書讀之，不足，則鈔之同里世學樓鈕氏、澹生堂祁氏，南中則千頃堂黃氏、絳雲樓錢氏，且建續鈔堂於南雷，以承東發之緒。山陰劉宗周倡道蕺山，以忠端遺命從之遊。而越中承海門周氏之緒，援儒入釋，姚江之緒幾壞。宗羲獨約同學六十餘人力排其說。故蕺山弟子如祁、章諸子皆以名德重，而御侮之功莫如宗羲。弟宗炎、宗會，並負異才，自教之，有「東浙三黃」之目。戊寅，南都作防亂揭攻阮大鋮。東林子弟推無錫顧杲居首，天啟被難諸家推宗羲居首。大鋮恨之刺骨，驟起，遂按揭中一百四十人姓氏，欲盡殺之。時宗羲方上書闕下而禍作，遂與杲並逮。母氏姚歎曰：「章妻、滂母乃萃吾一身耶？」駕帖未行，南都已破，宗羲踉蹌歸。會孫嘉績、熊汝霖奉魯王監國，畫江而守。宗羲糾里中子弟數百人從之，號世忠營。授職方郎，尋改御史，作監國魯元年大統曆頒之浙東。馬士英奔方國安營，眾言其當誅，熊汝霖恐其挾國安為患也，好言慰之。宗羲曰：「諸臣力不能殺耳！春秋之孔子，豈能加於陳恆，但不謂其不當誅也。」汝霖謝焉。又遺書王之仁曰：「諸公不沉舟決戰，蓋意在自守也。
