manualTranslations.zh: 乾隆二十四年八月，回酋博羅尼都、霍集占兄弟敗奔巴達克山，富德率師至其地，以博羅尼都、霍集占逆狀諭示巴酋素爾坦沙，令擒獻。
manualTranslations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year of Qianlong, the Muslim chiefs Burhanid and the brothers Khoja Jahan were defeated and fled to Badakhshan; Fude led troops to the place and showed their treason to Badakhshan chief Sultan Shah, ordering capture and surrender.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Qianlong 24, the Muslim chiefs Burhanid and the brothers Khoja Jahan were beaten and fled to Badakhshan; Counsellor Fude marched there, laid their crimes before Sultan Shah, and ordered the rebels seized and handed over.

manualTranslations.zh: 時二賊竄入巴達克山之錫克南村，詭稱假道往墨克祖國，大肆劫掠。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time the two rebels slipped into Shighnan village in Badakhshan, falsely claiming passage to the Mecca homeland while plundering on a great scale.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The two rebels hid in Shighnan in Badakhshan, claiming they needed passage to the holy land of Mecca while looting the countryside.

manualTranslations.zh: 素爾坦沙縛博羅尼都，而以兵攻霍集占於阿爾渾楚哈嶺。
manualTranslations.literal: Sultan Shah bound Burhanid and attacked Khoja Jahan with troops at Arhuntaqa Ridge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sultan Shah bound Burhanid and sent troops against Khoja Jahan at Arhuntaqa Ridge.

manualTranslations.zh: 霍集占退保齊那爾河，不能支，傷背及乳，擒之，囚於柴劄布。
manualTranslations.literal: Khoja Jahan retreated to hold the Chinar River, could not sustain himself, was wounded in the back and breast, was captured, and imprisoned at Chizab.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Khoja Jahan fell back to the Chinar River but could not hold; wounded in the back and breast, he was taken and held at Chizab.

manualTranslations.zh: 柴劄布者，系囚處也。
manualTranslations.literal: Chizab was the place of confinement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chizab was the place where prisoners were kept.

manualTranslations.zh: 素爾坦沙遣使詣軍門投款，且報擒二賊。
manualTranslations.literal: Sultan Shah sent envoys to the army gate to submit and also reported the capture of the two rebels.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sultan Shah sent envoys to the army camp to submit and report that both rebels had been taken.

manualTranslations.zh: 富德令獻俘，進軍瓦罕城以待。
manualTranslations.literal: Fude ordered the prisoners presented and advanced the army to Wakhan city to wait.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fude ordered the prisoners delivered and marched to Wakhan to await them.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時溫都斯坦方以兵臨巴達克山，謀劫霍集占兄弟。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Watan was just pressing Badakhshan with troops, plotting to seize the brothers Khoja Jahan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Watan was then massing troops against Badakhshan, intending to seize the Khoja brothers.

manualTranslations.zh: 霍集占陰通巴達克山仇國塔爾巴斯。
manualTranslations.literal: Khoja Jahan secretly communicated with Badakhshan's enemy state Tarbas.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Khoja Jahan secretly colluded with Tarbas, Badakhshan's enemy.

manualTranslations.zh: 會謀泄，素爾坦沙遷霍集占兄弟密室，以二百人圍而殺之，刃其馘以獻，並率其部落十萬戶及鄰部博羅爾三萬戶以降。
manualTranslations.literal: When the plot leaked, Sultan Shah moved the brothers Khoja Jahan to a secret room, surrounded them with two hundred men and killed them, presented their severed heads, and led his hundred thousand households and the neighboring Bolor division of thirty thousand households to submit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the plot came out, Sultan Shah moved the brothers to a secret room, had two hundred men surround and kill them, sent their severed heads as tribute, and submitted with his hundred thousand households and thirty thousand Bolor households nearby.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十五年，遣額莫爾伯克朝京師，貢刀斧及八駿馬。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he sent Emir Beg to court at the capital, presenting axes and eight fine horses as tribute.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he sent Emir Beg to the capital with tribute of axes and eight fine horses.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十七年，再遣使來朝。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he again sent envoys to court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he sent envoys to court again.

manualTranslations.zh: 二十八年，貢馬、犬、鳥槍、腰刀。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he presented tribute of horses, dogs, muskets, and waist knives.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he sent horses, dogs, muskets, and waist knives as tribute.

manualTranslations.zh: 後其國為愛烏罕所並。
manualTranslations.literal: Later the state was annexed by Afghanistan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later the country was absorbed into Afghanistan.

manualTranslations.zh: 巴達克山酋所居地曰維薩巴特，在喀克察河上。
manualTranslations.literal: The Badakhshan chief's seat was called Visabart, on the Kakhcha River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Badakhshan chief resided at Visabart on the Kakhcha River.

manualTranslations.zh: 噴赤河自瓦罕帕米爾流入境，繞其東北，喀克察河西流入之，下流為阿母河。
manualTranslations.literal: The Panj River entered the border from Wakhan Pamir, circled its northeast; the Kakhcha River flowed west to join it; downstream was the Amu River.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Panj entered from Wakhan Pamir and curved around the northeast; the Kakhcha joined it from the west; downstream lay the Amu River.

manualTranslations.zh: 唐書言竭盤陀國治蔥嶺負徙多河，即巴達克山地也。
manualTranslations.literal: The Tang History says the state of Qiabantuo governed Congling, leaning on the Wudo River—that is Badakhshan territory.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Tang History places Qiabantuo on the Pamirs above the Wudo River—the ground of Badakhshan.

sourceRange.text: 乾隆二十三年，參贊大臣富德追捕哈薩克沙喇至其地，遣使往撫，軍於莽格特城外待之。時吐爾占方與哈薩克戰河上，因諭以睦鄰守土之義，皆感悟釋兵，和好如初。乃遣其屬默尼雅斯奉表求內屬，曰：「臣莫爾多薩木什恭奉諭音，若開瞽昧。蠢茲邊末，敢備外籓，罔或有二心。謹以準孽額什木劄布獻之闕下。外臣草莽，冀瞻聖容，躬服彝訓，同歸怙冒，永永無極。」額什木劄布者，阿睦爾撒納兄子也。帝宥而遣之。吐爾占亦貢馬稱臣，遣子入覲。塔什干至是自通於中國，列籓臣焉。嘉慶中，塔什干附浩罕，為浩罕八城之一。同治三年，俄人以伐浩罕之師奪塔什干，開錫爾達利亞省，於是塔什干部遂亡。塔什干居納林河流域之中樞，扼中亞細亞通道。納林河今又名錫爾河，西北流入鹹海。由塔什干西南行，逾錫爾河至薩馬爾罕，又逾阿母河，分入印度、波斯。北出屙倫不爾厄，越烏拉山脈達歐俄，而東行可至伊黎河以通中國，故俄人置土耳其斯坦總督駐之。塔什干山泉暢流，其乞爾乞河、卡拉蘇河、安噶連河皆發源雪山，灌溉農田，地宜五穀，故人民常有餘糧。樹木叢雜，多果木。宜蠶桑，而棉花產額尤鉅云。

context.beforeSource: 吐爾占逐之，與哈薩克構兵。
context.afterSource: 巴達克山，在葉爾羌西千餘里，居蔥嶺右偏。
context.beforeLocal: 吐爾占逐之，與哈薩克構兵。
context.afterLocal: 巴達克山，在葉爾羌西千餘里，居蔥嶺右偏。

manualTranslations.zh: 乾隆二十三年，參贊大臣富德追捕哈薩克沙喇至其地，遣使往撫，軍於莽格特城外待之。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Qianlong, Participating Minister Fude pursued the Kazakh Shala to the place, sent envoys to pacify them, and encamped outside Mangget city to await them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 23, Participating Minister Fude pursued the Kazakh Shala to Tashkent, sent envoys to win them over, and camped outside Mangget to await them.

manualTranslations.zh: 時吐爾占方與哈薩克戰河上，因諭以睦鄰守土之義，皆感悟釋兵，和好如初。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time Turzhan was just fighting the Kazakhs on the river; Fude instructed them in the principle of neighborly peace and guarding the land; all were moved, laid down arms, and were friendly as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Turzhan was then fighting the Kazakhs on the river; Fude urged neighborly peace and respect for territory, and both sides were moved to lay down arms and restore friendship.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃遣其屬默尼雅斯奉表求內屬，曰：「臣莫爾多薩木什恭奉諭音，若開瞽昧。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon he sent his follower Meniyas with a memorial requesting to submit inward, saying: "Your subject Mordosamush respectfully receives the imperial instruction, as if opening blind eyes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Mordosamush then sent his follower Meniyas with a memorial seeking submission: "Your subject Mordosamush receives your instruction as one who had been blind.

manualTranslations.zh: 蠢茲邊末，敢備外籓，罔或有二心。
manualTranslations.literal: This stupid border remnant dares to stand as an outer vassal and will never harbor a second heart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I, a crude frontier people, dare to serve as an outer vassal and will never waver in loyalty.

manualTranslations.zh: 謹以準孽額什木劄布獻之闕下。
manualTranslations.literal: I reverently present the Zungar rebel Išmuzab to Your Majesty's court.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I reverently present the Zungar rebel Išmuzab to the throne.

manualTranslations.zh: 外臣草莽，冀瞻聖容，躬服彝訓，同歸怙冒，永永無極。」
manualTranslations.literal: An outer minister of the wilds, I hope to behold the sacred countenance, personally receive the constant instruction, and together return to sheltering grace forever without end."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A humble frontier subject, I hope to behold the sacred countenance, receive your instruction in person, and live forever under your sheltering grace."

manualTranslations.zh: 額什木劄布者，阿睦爾撒納兄子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Išmuzab was the nephew of Amursana.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Išmuzab was Amursana's nephew.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝宥而遣之。
manualTranslations.literal: The Emperor pardoned him and sent him away.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Emperor pardoned him and sent him off.

manualTranslations.zh: 吐爾占亦貢馬稱臣，遣子入覲。
manualTranslations.literal: Turzhan also presented horses and declared himself a subject, sending his son to audience.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Turzhan too sent horses, declared himself a subject, and sent his son to court.

manualTranslations.zh: 塔什干至是自通於中國，列籓臣焉。
manualTranslations.literal: From this Tashkent opened communication with China and was listed among the vassal ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From then on Tashkent was in direct contact with China and counted among the vassal states.

manualTranslations.zh: 嘉慶中，塔什干附浩罕，為浩罕八城之一。
manualTranslations.literal: In the Jiaqing reign Tashkent attached itself to Kokand and became one of Kokand's eight cities.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Under Jiaqing Tashkent fell under Kokand as one of its eight cities.

manualTranslations.zh: 同治三年，俄人以伐浩罕之師奪塔什干，開錫爾達利亞省，於是塔什干部遂亡。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, Russians with an army against Kokand seized Tashkent, opened the Syr Darya province, and thus the Tashkent tribe perished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3 Russian troops campaigning against Kokand took Tashkent, established the Syr Darya province, and the Tashkent khanate was extinguished.

manualTranslations.zh: 塔什干居納林河流域之中樞，扼中亞細亞通道。
manualTranslations.literal: Tashkent stood at the hub of the Narin River basin, controlling the routes of Central Asia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tashkent stood at the heart of the Narin basin and commanded the routes of Central Asia.

manualTranslations.zh: 納林河今又名錫爾河，西北流入鹹海。
manualTranslations.literal: The Narin River is now also called the Syr River; it flows northwest into the Aral Sea.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Narin is now called the Syr River and flows northwest into the Aral Sea.

manualTranslations.zh: 由塔什干西南行，逾錫爾河至薩馬爾罕，又逾阿母河，分入印度、波斯。
manualTranslations.literal: From Tashkent southwest, crossing the Syr to Samarkand, then crossing the Amu River, routes divide toward India and Persia.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Southwest from Tashkent one crossed the Syr to Samarkand, then the Amu, with routes branching toward India and Persia.

manualTranslations.zh: 北出屙倫不爾厄，越烏拉山脈達歐俄，而東行可至伊黎河以通中國，故俄人置土耳其斯坦總督駐之。
manualTranslations.literal: Northward through Orenburg, crossing the Urals to reach Europe, and eastward one could reach the Ili River to communicate with China; therefore the Russians stationed a Turkestan governor there.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Northward lay Orenburg and the Urals to Europe; eastward the Ili River led to China—so Russia posted a governor-general of Turkestan there.

manualTranslations.zh: 塔什干山泉暢流，其乞爾乞河、卡拉蘇河、安噶連河皆發源雪山，灌溉農田，地宜五穀，故人民常有餘糧。
manualTranslations.literal: Tashkent had mountain springs flowing freely; the Chirchiq, Karasu, and Angren rivers all rose in snowy mountains, irrigated farmland, and the soil suited the five grains, so the people often had surplus grain.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Springs flowed freely at Tashkent; the Chirchiq, Karasu, and Angren rose in the snow peaks, irrigated the fields, and the land yielded grain in abundance.

manualTranslations.zh: 樹木叢雜，多果木。
manualTranslations.literal: Trees grew in dense clusters; fruit trees were many.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Woods were thick and fruit trees plentiful.

manualTranslations.zh: 宜蠶桑，而棉花產額尤鉅云。
manualTranslations.literal: It suited mulberry silkworms, and cotton production was especially great.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Silk mulberries thrived there, and cotton output was especially large.
